articleTitle: No title
abstract: As the Cloud Computing model evolves over the next decade data centers will scale from tens of thousands of servers to 100's of thousands of servers. Server performance will also scale with the adoption of high performance multicore processors that will drive the need for high speed networking to provide them the data for their applications. Currently 10G Ethernet is emerging as the interconnect that meets current needs. As servers move to 40G connections, the need for 100G Ethernet will come to the forefront. This talk will explore the data center networking evolution and how 100G Ethernet can meet its future needs. It will also review current standards efforts and emerging technologies that may address the cost and performance that is required.

articleTitle: A 40-Gb/s, 850-nm, VCSEL-based full optical link
abstract: We report a complete VCSEL optical link operating at 40-Gb/s (BER<;10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup>) with an eye opening of 0.56 UI and 6 dB of link margin. Transmitter pre-distortion enables substantial improvements in speed, jitter, and link margin.

articleTitle: Impact of intra-superchannel spectral constraints on the throughput of the elastic WDM networks
abstract: Within the frame of elastic WDM network carrying superchannels, we investigate how subcarrier power equalization along the transmission related to the WSS spectral granularity and mitigation of subcarriers crosstalk impact the whole network capacity.

articleTitle: A regenerative variable optical buffer for NRZ and RZ packets
abstract: A re-circulating-loop optical memory exploiting regenerative amplification by crossgain- compression in a SOA is reported. Hundred circulations with maximum delay of 130μs with 0.5dB power penalty every 10 rounds are obtained with 10Gbps NRZ and RZ-packets.

articleTitle: Numerical investigation of performance variability for WDM transmission systems using PDM-QPSK channels
abstract: We numerically investigate the nonlinear transmission performance variability as a function of the time delay between channels and their initial states of polarization, also pointing out the values yielding the best or worst transmission performances.

articleTitle: Free-space beam steering in two dimensions using a silicon optical phased array
abstract: We report an independently tuned 16-channel optical phased array fabricated in silicon for 2D free-space beam steering. The phased array was composed of silicon-on-insulator waveguide surface gratings integrated with thermo-optic phase tuners and was operated both using a control algorithm together with automated real-time far field image analysis to target and shape the beam, and using a lookup table without real-time feedback. The device exhibited 1.6° × 0.6° beam width and 10 dB background suppression in the far field across a 20° × 14° field of view. We show that by increasing the waveguide width from 1 μm to 3 μm we can suppress the side-lobe peaks by a factor of 2.

articleTitle: Adaptive spectral phase and amplitude modulation employing an optimized MEMS spatial light modulator
abstract: We present a new Micro-Electro-Mechanical-System (MEMS) spatial light modulator with micromirrors designed to piston. This diffractive MEMS modulator is used for independently applying amplitude attenuation and phase control along one-dimensional spectrally-resolved frequency components of light.

articleTitle: Microresonator-based optical frequency combs for high-bitrate WDM data transmission
abstract: A nonlinear high-Q SiN microresonator is used as a frequency comb generator for data transmission at 170.8 Gbit/s. The main sources for signal impairment are identified. Further dispersion engineering is crucial for Terabit/s transmission.

articleTitle: Simultaneous and adaptive DPSK dense WDM monitoring using sequential ultrafast field sampling
abstract: We introduce a dual-channel sampling technique for WDM signal observation that uses sequential ultrafast field sampling to observe DPSK WDM signals. An 8 channel × 25 Gbit/s signal is successfully observed for the first time.

articleTitle: Optical burst-mode coherent receiver with a fast tunable LO for receiving multi-wavelength burst signals
abstract: We propose a coherent burst-mode receiver structure for receiving multi-wavelength short PDM-QPSK optical bursts. Data-aided algorithms are employed for fast-tunable LO transients compensation and channel estimation to facilitate rapid data recovery.

articleTitle: Suppression of transients in an EDFA chain using feed-forward pump control and a high-speed VOA
abstract: We report on an error-free operation of the survivor channel during instantaneous load and unload of a 7-ms burst signal with 16-dB dynamic range, in cascaded six fast feed-forward AGC-EDFAs assisted by a fast VOA.

articleTitle: High performance, low cost, colorless ONU for WDM-PON
abstract: We give an overview of key technologies for realizing WDM-PON. In particular, we highlight promising developments and directions in widely tunable laser technologies for achieving a high performance, colorless ONU at the cost points required for access networks.

articleTitle: Chirp monitoring and fine tuning system for optical pulses based on variable dispersion compensator and peak power monitor
abstract: We developed a chirp monitoring and fine tuning system for chirp-free pulse generation by using a variable dispersion compensator and a peak power monitor. A correlation between the pulsewidth and the peak power was confirmed.

articleTitle: Mobile backhaul for PON: A case study
abstract: This Case Study will detail Bright House Networks' end-to-end mobile backhaul deployment with a focus on EPON in the first-mile. It will cover both many of the benefits and many of the challenges of EPON.

articleTitle: Generalized L-out-of-K pulse position modulation for improved power efficiency and spectral efficiency
abstract: By combining multi-pulse pulse position modulation (PPM) with polarisation-switched QPSK (PS-QPSK) one can increase the spectral efficiency over simple PPM-PS-QPSK, or both the spectral efficiency and the asymptotic power efficiency over pure PS-QPSK.

articleTitle: OTN pit-stop in wavelength switched optical networks
abstract: A flexible “pit-stop” station for lightpaths is proposed for dynamic WSONs. It is based on a detour of the wavelengths that need 3R regeneration towards an external OTN switch connected to pairs of electronic interfaces.

articleTitle: Survivable inter-domain routing with Suurballe-based intra-domain disjointness information in multi-domain optical networks
abstract: We propose an algorithm to find a pair of disjoint inter-domain paths with minimum total cost based on a matrix for each domain that includes information generated by Suurballe's algorithm between the intra-domain aggregated links.

articleTitle: Low-complexity duobinary signaling and detection for sensitivity improvement in Nyquist-WDM coherent system
abstract: With complexity-reduced digital signal processing, duobinary signaling and detection are proposed for Nyquist-WDM coherent systems. Best sensitivity is experimentally demonstrated i n 25GHz-grid 5×112-Gb/s PM-QPSK WDM systems.

articleTitle: Dipole radiation model for surface roughness scattering in hollow-core fibers
abstract: We propose a physical model based on dipole radiation to estimate surface roughness scattering loss in microstructured and hollow-core photonic bandgap fibers. Angular distribution of scattered power and overall loss values can be calculated.

articleTitle: Cycle-slips in 100G DP-QPSK transmission systems
abstract: We present real-time measurements of the cycle-slip probabilities of a 100G DP-QPSK transceiver using a Viterbi-and-Viterbi carrier recovery. ASE and non-linear phase noise generated Poisson distributed slip events with mean probabilities between 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup> to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>.

articleTitle: 1G/10G-EPON compliant scheme combining ONU energy efficiency with QoS performance
abstract: We propose a hybrid fixed/dynamic downstream scheduling scheme for 1G-EPON and 10G-EPON which enables ONU sleep mode operation for more than 90% of the time, at minor delay performance penalty and independently of network traffic.

articleTitle: Optical network evolving towards smart network in Korea
abstract: Fixed and wireless convergence service environment is generating a huge amount of traffic, fostering the evolution of the optical network capacity and reach. The greatest portion in the traffic increase is occupied by the video traffic. In order to deal with the traffic increase and improve the network profitability, optical network is evolving towards the smart network. This paper explains about the concept and the direction of the fiber based smart network deployment in Korea.

articleTitle: Hierarchical multi-granular switching in flexible grid WDM networks
abstract: We propose a hierarchical multi-granular switch architecture in FWDM networks, and investigate the routing, spectrum allocation, and waveband assignment problem. Hierarchical switching can improve cost and energy efficiencies while marginally sacrificing spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Cascaded injection of Fabry-Perot lasers for improved performance in ASE seeded WDM PONs
abstract: Cascaded injection of Fabry-Perot lasers is proposed for improved performance in ASE seeded WDM PONs. Experimental results demonstrated better than 10dB improvement in power budget margin when ASE injection power is low.

articleTitle: Fractionally-spaced statistical equalizer for fiber nonlinearity mitigation in digital coherent optical systems
abstract: We propose a fractionally-spaced equalizer with trained second-order statistics to deal with nonlinear impairment in coherent optical communications. The proposed 3-tap equalizer improves Q-factor by more than 2 dB for long-haul transmissions of 5,230 km.

articleTitle: Novel all-optical switching device for dynamic wavelength routing in 100G coherent systems
abstract: An innovative integrated all-optical device for 100G coherent systems able to simultaneously perform selective data erasing and wavelength conversion from input data is demonstrated. It enables flexible network resource optimization introducing negligible OSNR penalty.

articleTitle: On the benefits of elastic transponders in optical metro networks
abstract: We investigate the benefits of using elastic transponders with distance-adaptive data-rate in optical metro networks: experimental results show a significant reduction in terms of number of transponders and spectrum utilization.

articleTitle: Variable all-optical buffering for DQPSK packets
abstract: All-optical buffering of 56Gbps DQPSK packets based on a SOA-boosted recirculating fiber loop is demonstrated. The scheme effectiveness is proven by BER measurements for a maximum delay of 25μs. Crosstalk impairment is also investigated.

articleTitle: Link power budget advantage of GI-core polymer optical waveguide for waveguide-based optical link
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that GI-core polymer optical waveguides provide a 3.4-dB advantage in power budget of optical link composed of waveguides and MMF, compared to SI-core polymer optical waveguides.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical functions in crystalline and amorphous Silicon-on-Insulator nanowires
abstract: Silicon-on-Insulator nanowires provide an excellent platform for nonlinear optical functions in spite of the two-photon absorption at telecom wavelengths. Work on both crystalline and amorphous silicon nanowires is reviewed, in the wavelength range of 1.5 to 2.5 μm.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of optical switch using gradient optical force
abstract: A novel optical switch driven by gradient optical force is demonstrated, allowing weak light to switch a strong one. The proposed optically controlled switch achieves an extinction ratio of 28 dB with ~ns switching speed.

articleTitle: Flexible grid multi-line fiber ring laser with an intra-cavity filter using a phase LCoS modulator
abstract: We demonstrate a tunable multi-line fiber ring laser with 2D-dispersion filtering arrangement by crossing a 100GHz WGR and a 1200gr/mm bulk grating. An LCoS modulator selects multiple arbitrary lasing wavelengths with 180 MHz addressability.

articleTitle: Extended temperature (−40/+90°C) Ultra Low Power consumption with high average output power (>+3 dBm) 1.55μm TOSA module for up to 11.3 Gb/s 100 km dispersion compensation free transmission Metro applications
abstract: We first report on a high average output power (>;3dBm) 1.55μm EML TOSA able to address industrial environment temperature range [-40/+90°C] with Ultra-Low Power consumption (0.8W) and power penalty <;2dB over 100km SMF fiber transmission.

articleTitle: Mode and propagation effects of optical orbital angular momentum (OAM) modes in a ring fiber
abstract: Single-ring fiber can support 10 OAM modes while maintaining radially sing-mode condition. The crosstalk between the modes is less than -20 dB even in a 1%-ellipticity fiber. OAM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0,4</sub> can propagate 500-km with <;10-ps mode walk-off.

articleTitle: White noise filtered C-band tunable laser for coherent transmission systems
abstract: The white frequency noise of a C-band tunable laser is suppressed significantly by optical filtering with a multi-channel ultra-narrowband fiber Bragg grating. This noise suppression is shown to improve the performance of 5-Gbaud PDM-64QAM by 1.7 dB.

articleTitle: Dynamic stabilization of a microring modulator under thermal perturbation
abstract: We demonstrate the first active stabilization of a microring-based device within a thermally volatile environment. The proposed design is CMOS integratable and leverages low-speed power monitoring and a feedback loop circuit for dynamic thermal correction.

articleTitle: Fault localization in passive optical networks using OTDR trace correlation analysis
abstract: A cost-effective and practical method is proposed for localization of the possible fiber faults in a passive optical network via correlation between the measured OTDR trace and a set of pre-measured reference OTDR traces.

articleTitle: Transmission performance of chirp-controlled signal emitted by electroabsorption modulator laser integrated with a semiconductor optical amplifier
abstract: Control of chirp parameter in a fully integrated EML-SOA chip based on InGaAlAs MQW technology is investigated. Transmission at 10 Gbit/s over 100 km of conventional SMF was obtained by optimizing signal chirp at emission.

articleTitle: Conversion of phase modulated signals from optical network to wireless domain using resonant tunneling diode optoelectronic integrated circuits
abstract: A simplified transceiver architecture based on resonant tunneling diodes is used to convert phase modulated signals from optical to wireless domain. Conversion of digital and analog modulation is demonstrated at a frequency of 3.2 GHz.

articleTitle: SNR and BER degradation of upstream RFoG signals due to accumulated RIN and shot noise of off-state R-ONUs
abstract: Recent SCTE presentations have suggested that the SNR power penalties can be greater than 7dB for off-state R-ONU power levels of -30dBm. Our experimental and modeling results show power penalties far smaller than this.

articleTitle: Highly efficient interfacing of silicon-on-insulator and localized surface plasmon waveguides
abstract: Plasmonics implementation in optical circuits and interconnects requires interfacing with dielectric optical waveguides. We show here metallic nanoparticles chain mode excitation from SOI waveguide with a record distance lower than 600 nm at telecom wavelength.

articleTitle: Coherent photonic RF channelizer by optical frequency combs and I/Q demodulation
abstract: Two-optical-frequency-comb-based RF channelizer is proposed to slice RF band seamlessly and downconvert to multiple IF bands, with rectangular response in each channel. Without special optical filters, 7-channel 500-MHz-step channelizer is reported.

articleTitle: DWDM optical line-side interoperability
abstract: Line-side interoperability of colored 100G transponders in DWDM systems between two different vendors will become a reality in the near future. With modern modulation formats (phase, polarization and post processing) and existing standards, optical interface technologies can deliver reliable transmission over more than 600km. That is the sweet spot for most of the metro and regional deployments.

articleTitle: Terabit/s optical superchannel with flexible modulation format for dynamic distance/route transmission
abstract: A superchannel transmitter with fixed 1-Tb/s net data rate and flexible modulation format suitable for dynamic distance/route transmission is proposed. System reach between 800 and 6,000km was achieved with spectral efficiency from 6.15b/s/Hz and 3.33b/s/Hz.

articleTitle: Experimental study on multimode fiber amplifier using modal reconfigurable pump
abstract: A two-mode erbium-doped fiber amplifier is experimentally characterized. Mode dependent gain is measured for different pump modes, and the results are compared with theory. We verified that higher-order pumping can help reduce mode-dependent gain.

articleTitle: Long variable delay and distributed sensing using stationary and localized Brillouin dynamic gratings
abstract: Stationary and localized Brillouin dynamic gratings are generated using phase modulation of both pump waves by a pseudo-random bit sequence. The gratings are applied to long variable delay of pulses and to cm-level distributed sensing.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Photonic Integrated Wavelength Converter on a Silicon-on-Insulator Substrate
abstract: We present fabrication and testing of a wavelength converter integrated on a silicon-on-insulator substrate. The chip employs a hybrid integrated SOA and delay-interferometers integrated on 4μm SOI. We demonstrate 40Gb/s error-free performance.

articleTitle: Phase estimation in coherent optical fiber communication systems with advanced modulation formats
abstract: The performance of decision-aided maximum likelihood (DA ML) phase estimation is investigated for different modulation formats, and Gardner-timing-based frequency offset estimation is demonstrated which achieves an estimation range of ±0.5 times the system symbol rate.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 103-Gb/s per subscriber RSOA-based WDM PON using CWDM technique
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a long-reach WDM PON capable of providing 100-Gb/s service to each subscriber. This network utilizes four directly-modulated RSOAs (operating at 25 Gb/s) at each ONU and CWDM technique.

articleTitle: Advanced ROADM networks
abstract: We discuss the growing list of features being proposed for reconfigurable optical add/drop multiplexers (ROADMs), including colorless, directionless, contentionless, and gridless operation. Is ‘less’ always more for network operators?

articleTitle: Analysis of back-propagation and RF pilot-tone based nonlinearity compensation for a 9×224Gb/s POLMUX-16QAM system
abstract: We investigate the joint implementation of back-propagation and RF-pilot tone for fiber nonlinear compensation in POLMUX-16QAM and show that the nonlinear tolerance is drastically improved when compared to OFDM system.

articleTitle: Real-time 11.25Gb/s optical OFDM transmission over 2000m legacy MMFs utilizing directly modulated VCSELs
abstract: Real-time 11.25 Gb/s optical OFDM transmissions over 2000 m OM1/OM2 legacy MMFs with optical power penalties of <;0.5 dB are experimentally demonstrated, for the first time, in directly modulated 3.63 GHz VCSEL-based IMDD systems subject to central launch.

articleTitle: A low-complexity sliding-window turbo equalizer for nonlinearity compensation
abstract: We propose a low-complexity turbo equalizer consisting of a sliding window MAP estimator, and a low overhead LDPC decoder. By utilizing 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> order statistics, we obtain 2.5-4dB gain with additional improvement with turbo loop.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation on nonlinear distortions with perturbation back-propagation algorithm in 224 Gb/s DP-16QAM transmission
abstract: We investigate the impact of perturbation back-propagation algorithm on distribution of nonlinear noise in 224 Gb/s DP-16QAM transmission over large-A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub> pure silica core fiber and show the distribution approaches to Gaussian by the nonlinear compensation.

articleTitle: Temperature insensitive racetrack resonators for near infrared applications
abstract: We report a record low temperature dependent wavelength shift of 0.2 pm/K for silicon-on-insulator strip racetrack resonators at a 1550 nm wavelength using a polymer cladding. A significant reduction of propagation losses is also achieved.

articleTitle: Reduced complexity back-propagation for optical communication systems
abstract: In this work, a significant reduction of the computational complexity of the back-propagation algorithm applied to dispersion managed links is proposed, without degrading the system performance.

articleTitle: Large-effective-area uncoupled 10-core fiber with two-pitch layout
abstract: Characteristics of a 10-core fiber with two-pitch layout were investigated. A core pitch was optimized by simulation. The fabricated fiber realized A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub> larger than 115 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and low-crosstalk characteristics with about 200-μm cladding diameter.

articleTitle: CMOS photonic integrated circuits
abstract: A platform for Systems-on-Chip with photonic input and output is presented. Electronic-photonic integrated circuits within existing state-of-the-art CMOS foundries are explored with applications ranging from multiprocessor interconnects to coherent communications.

articleTitle: Power efficiency in passive optical networks
abstract: Energy usage of five different PON architectures is compared under the assumption of sleep mode control. Conventional systems with flexible PON boundaries can be the most energy-optimized among others while WDM PON follows closely.

articleTitle: A novel type of hybrid plasmonic waveguide with low-loss and high confinement
abstract: A novel type of plasmonic waveguide consists of periodic metallic gratings sandwiched at the core-cladding interfaces is proposed. Long propagation distances over hundreds of micrometer, subwavelength mode width and high confinement factor are achieved.

articleTitle: Overview of the common electrical interface (CEI) specification for next generation 25 Gb/s serial interfaces
abstract: OIF recently published the CEI 3.0 Implementation Agreement which includes new clauses for 25-28 Gbaud/s serial electrical interfaces. This paper presents an overview and historical context for this document.

articleTitle: Microwave photonic filters
abstract: We have reviewed the basic concepts behind microwave photonic filtering and signal processing.Recent advances in the field have been described reporting the salient techniques developed to overcome a series of limitations. Complex-valued coefficients, Tunability, Reconfigurability, enhanced quality & selectivity etc. Evaluation of their figures of merit. New evolution towards integration is definitely the next step in the filed. A wide variety of novel applications are currently under active research and many more are expected to come in the near future.

articleTitle: OFC tutorial: III-V and silicon photonic integrated circuit technologies
abstract: Technologies can change rapidly and profoundly: • Traditional drivers for photonic integration: — Cost, size, power reduction for “stable configurations” (telelcom) — Also opportunities/drivers where role changes to critical enabling technology • Higher level modulation formats & coherent solutions, low-power transceivers/arrays; • Si photonics will be increasingly powerful, but will still have to compete for a spot with high performance incumbent InP PIC technology • But… new markets & drivers on the horizon with potential for dramatic change in technology and market dynamics of photonic integration: — Enabling the scaling of electronic functionality in client applications — New requirements drives new performance metrics • Need for ultra high density, ultra-low power, while maintaining high digital signal fidelity — Need for unprecedented intimacy between photonics and electronics

articleTitle: Amplification in extended transmission bands
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: extended transmission bands; bismuth doped glasses; NIR centers; NIR luminescence; bismuth doped fibre lasers; and optical amplifiers.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optics on the silicon platform
abstract: Silicon represents a mature, affordable platform for fabricating electronic and optical signal processing devices. We discuss all-optical 170 Gbit/s switching, a 42 Gbit/s electro-optic modulator, and proof-of-concept results for a surface plasmon polariton absorption modulator.

articleTitle: There is no file available for this presentation
abstract: The document was not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: 140-krad/s, 254-Gigaradian endless optical polarization tracking, independent of analyzed output polarization
abstract: We report record-fast endless polarization tracking over 643 hours, at maximum (mean) polarization scrambling speeds of 140 (110) krad/s. Mean (maximum) polarization error was 0.131 (0.358) rad. Total trajectory was 254 Grad long.

articleTitle: Optical interconnect opportunities in supercomputers and high end computing
abstract: A collection of slides from the author's seminar presentation is given. The following topics are discussed: optical interconnect; supercomputers; high end computing; power efficiency; copper cables; optical cables; data center networking; InfiniBand; HPC systems networking; strategic directions; IBM research; exascale systems.

articleTitle: Spectrally efficient four-dimensional modulation
abstract: We quantify the performance of regular four-dimensional constellations with high spectral efficiency, and compare the sensitivity gain relative to rectangular QAM. Gains up to 1.51 and 1.97 dB over the corresponding QAM formats can be achieved.

articleTitle: Transmission of 448-Gb/s dual-carrier POLMUX-16QAM over 1230 km with 5 flexi-grid ROADM passes
abstract: We show the compatibility of 448-Gb/s dual-carrier POLMUX-16QAM modulation with a 87.5-GHz flexi-grid channel spacing in the presence of cascaded optical filtering, enabling transmission over 1230 km and 5 ROADM passes with 4.8-b/s/Hz spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Minimizing the disaster risk in optical telecom networks
abstract: Regional failures caused by disasters precipitate huge amount of loss and jeopardize many connections. A risk model for disasters, considering differentiated services, is introduced and a disaster-aware provisioning scheme is proposed to reduce the risk.

articleTitle: Space-division multiplexed transmission over 4200-km 3-core microstructured fiber
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate multiple-input-multiple-output transmission of a combined 3-space-, and 2-polarization-, and 5-wavelength-division multiplex in a 3-core microstructured fiber over 4200 km. This is the record transmission distance for spatial-division multiplexing in a fiber.

articleTitle: Optical amplifiers for multi mode / multi core transmission
abstract: Optical amplifier concepts based on multi mode and multi core active fibers are compared. From an amplifier perspective, the multi mode fiber type has a better potential for cost and energy efficient spatial division multiplexing.

articleTitle: Push-pull technique for defragmentation in flexible optical networks
abstract: An efficient defragmentation technique based on optical channel re-tuning is proposed for flexible optical networks. Effective defragmentation with no traffic disruption is achieved without additional spare transponders or re-equalization operations.

articleTitle: Efficient multiplexing and demultiplexing of free-space orbital angular momentum using photonic integrated circuits
abstract: We present a silicon photonic integrated circuit for multiplexing and demultiplexing beams with orbital angular momentum (OAM) into single-mode waveguides. Successful demultiplexing of nine azimuthally polarized OAM modes show potential for spatial multiplexing.

articleTitle: Interworking between OpenFlow and PCE for dynamic wavelength path control in multi-domain WSON
abstract: We experimentally present the seamless interworking between OpenFlow and PCE for dynamic wavelength path control in multi-domain WSON, assessing the overall feasibility and quantitatively evaluating both the path computation and lightpath provisioning latencies.

articleTitle: Measuring distributed mode scattering in long, few-moded fibers
abstract: We present measurements of higher-order modes in lengths of few-moded fibers up to 0.5 km long using Spatially and Spectrally resolved (S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) imaging. Both discrete scattering events and mode-mixing due to distributed scattering are measured.

articleTitle: Traffic trends: Drivers and measures of cost-effective and energy-efficient technologies and architectures for backbone optical networks
abstract: We examine trends and characteristics of the traffic, systems, and architectures of backbone optical networks to illustrate baselines, future requirements, and possible metrics to gauge the relative performance of capabilities and concepts being researched today.

articleTitle: Transmission impairment compensation using broadband channel sounding in multi-format OFDM-based long-reach PONs
abstract: A centralized impairment compensation technique using outband RF-pilots in OFDM-based long-reach PONs supporting quadruple-play services is proposed. With this technique, a 6.7dB EVM improvement is achieved, and all signals are EVM-compliant after 100km of SSMF.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient high-speed short-cavity VCSELs
abstract: The energy efficiency of short-cavity VCSELs is examined for static and dynamic device operation. Record-high modulation bandwidths beyond 18GHz, conversion efficiencies of 23% and energy-efficient large-signal modulation at 10Gbps over 17.3km fiber-line are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a 40Gb/s time and Wavelength Division Multiplexed passive optical network prototype system
abstract: We demonstrate a TWDM-PON prototype system with 40Gb/s downstream and 10Gb/s upstream bandwidth. It supports 20km distance with a 1:512 split ratio. It also coexists with commercially deployed G-PON and XG-PON systems.

articleTitle: 112-Gb/s InP DP-QPSK modulator integrated with a silica-PLC polarization multiplexing circuit
abstract: We fabricated an ultra-compact InP-based DP-QPSK modulator by the hybrid integration of an InP twin-IQ modulator and a PLC polarization multiplexing circuit for the first time. 112-Gb/s DP-QPSK modulation is successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Multi-carrier approaches for next-generation transmission: Why, where and how?
abstract: The presentation of slides covers the following topics: next generation transmission; DWDM channel; OFDM; matched filter; coherent WDM transmitter; coherent WDM receiver; laser phase noise; channel estimation; and multicarrier modulation.

articleTitle: Asymmetric parallel waveguide with mode conversion for mode and wavelength division multiplexing transmission
abstract: An asymmetric parallel waveguide realizes low-loss mode conversion and MUX/DEMUX simultaneously over a wide wavelength range. MDM and WDM transmission is achieved with a low insertion loss of <;1.6dB for LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> and LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> modes.

articleTitle: Hybrid DWDM-TDMA PONs for next generation access
abstract: We present hybrid DWDM-TDMA PONs as a means for integration of access and metro networks, and review results from recent system demonstrations. Results on a novel burst-mode receiver specifically designed for such systems are provided.

articleTitle: 28 Gb/s silicon microring modulation beyond the linewidth Limit by coupling modulation
abstract: A silicon-on-insulator microring modulator with a linewidth of ~ 7 GHz is operated at 28Gb/s by modulation of the microring-bus waveguide coupler. The modulator was driven with pre-emphasized signals with a maximum swing of 1.5V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pp</sub>.

articleTitle: WDM performance and multiple-path interference tolerance of a real-time 120 Gbps Pol-Mux QPSK transceiver with soft decision FEC
abstract: We report the measured WDM performance of a real-time 120 Gbps coherent PM-QPSK MSA transceiver with industry-first integrated ADC, DSP and SD-FEC in a 40nm CMOS ASIC. We also evaluate MPI induced OSNR penalty.

articleTitle: 100 Gb/s single VCSEL data transmission link
abstract: 100 Gb/s optical fiber transmission link with a single 1.5 um VCSEL has been experimentally demonstrated using 4-level pulse amplitude modulation.

articleTitle: Terabit/sec VCSEL-based parallel optical module based on holey CMOS transceiver IC
abstract: We report a 24 TX + 24 RX transceiver underpinned by a “holey” CMOS IC. All channels operate at 20 Gb/s (BER <;10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup>, 7.3 pJ/bit) achieving record aggregate bidirectional bandwidth for parallel transceivers: 0.48 Tb/s.

articleTitle: Optical interconnect architecture for servers using high bandwidth optical mid-plane
abstract: We describe an interconnect architecture that utilizes high bandwidth optical mid-plane. Enabling technologies for high density optical mid-plane are discussed. We developed a prototype to determine the feasibility. The results showed proposed architecture is practical.

articleTitle: Comparison of optical spectrum utilization between flexgrid and fixed grid on a real network topology
abstract: Using network simulations, real network efficiency gains of Flexgrid compared to inverse multiplexing on a 50GHz fixed grid are presented. Results show Flexgrid will be beneficial for future networks, supporting up to 208% more traffic.

articleTitle: Differential mode delay managed transmission line for wide-band WDM-MIMO system
abstract: We propose a differential mode delay (DMD) managed transmission line consisting of positive and negative DMD sections for a WDM-MIMO system. A fabricated 20.4km-long fiber shows maximum 111ps total absolute DMD within the C-L band.

articleTitle: Mode-multiplexed 6×20-GBd QPSK transmission over 1200-km DGD-compensated few-mode fiber
abstract: Low differential group delay (DGD) between the modes of a graded-index few-mode fiber is obtained by combining segments with DGD of opposite sign. Transmission of mode-multiplexed 6×20-GBd QPSK over a record distance of 1200 km is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Light source independent linewidth reduction of lasers
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate linewidth reduction of a commercially available DFB laser from 7.5MHz to 1.8KHz using an electro-optical feed-forward scheme. The proposed scheme performs linewidth reduction independent of the light source and is compatible with the light source tunibility. Continuous linewidth reduction over 40nm tuning range is measured without any electrical or optical adjustments.

articleTitle: Homodyne dual-quadrature coherent receiver with injection-locked monolithically integrated local oscillator
abstract: We demonstrate a homodyne dual-quadrature coherent receiver using a monolithically integrated, injection-locked local oscillator. For BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> and 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>, the required OSNR is improved by 1.5 dB and 5 dB, respectively, compared to a free-running local oscillator.

articleTitle: Field trial of 79.5-dB loss budget, 100-km reach 10G-EPON system using ALC burst-mode SOAs and EDC
abstract: This paper reports the world's first field trial of a 100-km reach symmetric-rate 10G-EPON that uses optical-amplifier-based PON repeaters; bidirectional real-time uncompressed HDTV signal transmission over installed SMF links with 40-km span length is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Up to 10 Gbit/s transmission in WDM-PON architecture using external cavity laser based on self-tuning ONU
abstract: An external cavity laser is demonstrated with a RSOA at ONU and a mirror at the RN which can be 5km away. A record transmission of 10Gbits/s is shown and compared with performance at 1.25, 2.5, 5Gbit/s.

articleTitle: 40 Gb/s RoF signal transmission with 10 m wireless distance at 60 GHz
abstract: We demonstrate a 40-Gb/s OFDM radio-over-fiber system with 10-m wireless distance at 60-GHz by employing simple IM-DD modulation with DSP-based bit-loading and I/Q imbalance compensation. Spectral efficiency of 6-bit/s/Hz was achieved with BER of 9×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>.

articleTitle: Pattern effect suppression technique of synchronized gain-clamping light injection for downstream SOA in optically-amplified PON systems
abstract: Simple technique that combines synchronized-GC light injection with complementary signal pattern is proposed to completely suppress the pattern effect and greatly improve the extinction ratio in the downstream SOA of an optically-amplified PON system.

articleTitle: Fast and robust chromatic dispersion estimation using auto-correlation of signal power waveform for DSP based-coherent systems
abstract: We propose chromatic dispersion (CD) estimation technique by using auto-correlation of signal power waveform for DSP based-coherent systems. Simulation results demonstrate 10-fold estimation time reduction with comparable CD range and estimation precision reported to date.

articleTitle: Compact wavelength tunable filter fabricated on a PLC chip that construct colorless/directionless/contentionless drop function in optical cross-connect
abstract: We demonstrate efficient Colorless/Directionless/Contentionless add/drop configuration utilizing newly proposed tunable filters to develop flexible OXCs/ROADMs. The filter is compactly fabricated on a 15×70 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> PLC chip and the performance was verified.

articleTitle: Enhanced digital polarization demultiplexation via CMA step size adaptation for PM-QPSK coherent receivers
abstract: Fixed step size CMA can exhibit serious penalties due to rapid channel variations during coherent receiver polarization demultiplexing. We propose and experimentally demonstrate two CMA gain adaptation methods that improve dynamic equalizer tracking and convergence.

articleTitle: Power saving techniques for optical access
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: power saving; TDMA; PON; power shedding; dozing; cyclic sleep; and WDM technology.

articleTitle: Simulations of a service velocity network employing regenerator site concentration
abstract: We use Monte Carlo simulations of quasi-static traffic growth to study concentration of regenerator sites in dynamic photonic networks supporting service velocity. Idle regenerators can be reduced by >60% compared to unrestricted regeneration sites.

articleTitle: Spectral shaping in ultra-dense WDM systems: Optical vs. electrical approaches
abstract: This paper reviews spectral shaping techniques allowing to increase the spectral efficiency of WDM optical systems by reducing the spacing between subchannels. Two different approaches are compared, based on shaping in optical or electrical domain.

articleTitle: 102.3-Tb/s (224 × 548-Gb/s) C- and extended L-band all-Raman transmission over 240 km using PDM-64QAM single carrier FDM with digital pilot tone
abstract: We demonstrate 102.3 Tb/s transmission over 3×80 km of PSCF by employing 548-Gb/s PDM-64QAM single-carrier frequency-division-multiplexing (SC-FDM) signals with pilot tone and 11.2-THz ultra-wideband low-noise amplification in the C- and extended L-bands.

articleTitle: On concentrating regenerator sites in ROADM networks
abstract: Concentrating optical regenerators in a subset of nodes provides significant savings. We present a heuristic for choosing this subset. In the studied cases our results have 1 or 2 more sites than the minimum.

articleTitle: Polymer optical waveguide having unique refractive index profiles for ultra high-density interconnection
abstract: We have developed a novel and cost-competitive method to fabricate optical waveguides having graded index profiles in all directions. High-speed data transmission more than 10Gbps is achieved through parallel-aligned 12 channels with low cross talk.

articleTitle: Delivering scale out data center networking with optics — Why and how
abstract: Vast majority of computation, storage, and communication will take place in data centers in the years ahead. Building balanced systems today requires Pb/sec networks. Exabit/sec networks are not far behind. Tremendous opportunity for optics to define what it means to perform communication in the data center is presented.

articleTitle: Survivable provisioning in Mixed-Line-Rate networks using multipath routing
abstract: We investigate a computationally-efficient multipath routing scheme for survivable provisioning in Mixed-Line-Rate networks. Our approach exploits heterogeneity of multiple rates and guarantees that a specified fraction of the requested bandwidth survives any single-link failure.

articleTitle: High-speed visible light communications: State-of-the-art
abstract: Communication via visible light is constantly gaining attention in R&D, driven by progress on LED technology for solid-state lighting. This paper reviews the state-of-the-art in VLC and points out its potentials in various application environments.

articleTitle: Wideband WDM coherent optical MIMO transmission over GI-MMF by using selective mode excitation
abstract: We demonstrate C- and L-band WDM coherent optical MIMO transmission with mode group diversity over 10-km GI-MMF under selective mode excitation conditions, which enables us to reduce MIMO DSP complexity over a wide wavelength range.

articleTitle: Efficiency of adaptive and mixed-line-rate IP over DWDM networks regarding CAPEX and power consumption
abstract: Optimization of IP over DWDM USA-core network is studied under constraints of energy consumption and CAPEX. Population related IP traffic mapped to the optical DWDM layer together with leased lines are analyzed for MLR and reach/bandwidth adaptive networks.

articleTitle: 25.8Gbps Direct Modulation AlGaInAs DFB lasers with Ru-doped InP Buried Heterostructure for 70°C operation
abstract: 25.8Gbps Direct Modulation AlGaInAs DFB lasers with Ru-doped InP Buried Heterostructure were fabricated for the first time. The lasers achieved high output power and clear eye opening at 70°C and are promising for uncooled operation.

articleTitle: Dynamic network resource allocation for inter-data centers communications
abstract: A management platform for dynamic inter-data center connectivity set-up is presented. Network resource allocation with QoS guarantees is carried out considering IT traffic priority. Different allocation policies are compared in terms of requests blocking probability.

articleTitle: Grooming and RWA in translucent dynamic mixed-line-rate WDM networks with impairments
abstract: This paper develops a scheme to dynamically make grooming, regenerator placement, and routing and wavelength assignment (RWA) decisions for translucent mixed-line-rate optical networks. We consider physical impairments and compare to the no-grooming case.

articleTitle: Optical FlowVisor: An OpenFlow-based optical network virtualization approach
abstract: A novel impairment aware optical network virtualization mechanism (Optical FlowVisor) based on software defined networking (OpenFlow-based) paradigm is experimentally demonstrated. End-to-end flow setup time and the performance of virtual switches and OpenFlow controller are reported.

articleTitle: 20Gb/s hybrid TDM/WDM PONs with 512-split using self-seeded reflective semiconductor optical amplifiers
abstract: Hybrid TDM/WDM PON using self-seeded reflective semiconductor optical amplifiers is proposed for high-capacity and large-splitting access services. Experimental results demonstrate a 512-split hybrid PON with aggregated upstream capacity of 20 Gb/s.

articleTitle: 19-core fiber transmission of 19×100×172-Gb/s SDM-WDM-PDM-QPSK signals at 305Tb/s
abstract: A novel free-space coupling system combined with a multi-core fiber enables up-scaling to a record space-division-multiplexed (SDM) channel number of 19. We achieve 305-Tb/s transmission over 10.1 km using 19-SDM, 100-WDM PDM-QPSK signals.

articleTitle: Superimposition and detection of frequency modulated tone for light path tracing employing digital signal processing and optical filter
abstract: We propose a novel method for light path tracing and demonstrate it in 112Gb/s DP-16QAM transmission. The S/N of the detected label exceeds 24dB after 20span transmission. No crosstalk was observed in neighboring DWDM channels.

articleTitle: Experimental IM/DD OFDMA transmission with scalable receiver frontend for PON scenarios
abstract: We propose a technique to reduce the electrical hardware effort in an OFDMA-PON by reducing the ADC and DSP complexity and therefore the costs of the ONUs and show its feasibility experimentally.

articleTitle: Dynamically reconfigurable photonic resources for optically connected data center networks
abstract: A modular, traffic-adaptable data center network architecture leveraging unique reconfigurable optical functionalities is presented. Optical multicasting and subnet formation is demonstrated between four ports at up to 80 Gb/s per port.

articleTitle: Resource requirements in mixed-line rate and elastic dynamic optical networks
abstract: We estimate through a probabilistic model and simulations the sharing potential of rate-adaptive transponders in dynamic optical networks and draw comparisons with mixed-line-rate networks, showing up to 40% saving potential for adaptive solutions.

articleTitle: Energy efficiency and scalability of multi-plane optical interconnection networks for computing platforms and data centers
abstract: Multi-plane optical interconnection networks are proposed as scalable architectures with optimized energy-efficiency for large computing platforms. The space-time architecture is found to have scalable energy consumption greater than both the space-wavelength architecture and single-plane architecture.

articleTitle: Partial protection in networks with backup capacity sharing
abstract: We develop a novel network protection scheme that guarantees a minimum grade of service upon a link failure by utilizing backup capacity sharing between demands. Our scheme achieves up to 83% reductions in protection resources.

articleTitle: First field trial of an OpenFlow-based unified control plane for multi-layer multi-granularity optical networks
abstract: We report a world first field trial of an OpenFlow-based unified control plane for multilayer multi-granularity optical networks, verifying its overall feasibility and efficiency, and quantitatively evaluating the latencies for end-to-end path creation and restoration.

articleTitle: 3760km, 100G SSMF transmission over commercial terrestrial DWDM ROADM systems using SD-FEC
abstract: We report error-free, 47×80km transmission of a real-time, 120Gbps, coherent PM-QPSK MSA transceiver with soft-decision forward-error-correction. Two cascaded commercial systems included 40G neighbors and ten ROADMs. The transceiver compensated 60,000ps/nm and had 2.5dB remaining margin.

articleTitle: Coherent multi-pattern correlator and all-optical equalizer enabling simultaneous equalization, wavelength conversion and multicasting
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a tunable and reconfigurable optical correlator in conjugation with coherent detection to simultaneously search multiple patterns in BPSK/QPSK symbols at both 20 Gbaud and 31Gbuad symbol rates. We also demonstrated simultaneous equalization and 3-fold multicasting of coherent QPSK/8PSK signals after transmitting through 25-km SMF-28 fiber, in one system.

articleTitle: LDPC convolutional codes using layered decoding algorithm for high speed coherent optical transmission
abstract: We successfully realized layered decoding for LDPC convolutional codes designed for application in high speed optical transmission systems. A relatively short code with 20% redundancy was FPGA-emulated with a Q-factor of 5.7dB at BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-15</sup>.

articleTitle: Space-division multiplexing and all-optical MIMO demultiplexing using a photonic integrated circuit
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon photonic integrated circuit for all-optical demultiplexing of and selective coupling to the six spatial and polarization modes of a few-mode fiber (FMF). We successfully demultiplex all six modes after transmission through 30 km of FMF.

articleTitle: Very high-speed GaN-based cyan light emitting diode on patterned sapphire substrate for 1 Gbps plastic optical fiber communication
abstract: We demonstrate novel cyan light-emitting-diodes (LEDs) on patterned-sapphire substrate with record-high electrical-to-optical bandwidth (0.38 GHz) among visible LEDs. 0.93Gbps error-free transmission in plastic-optical-fiber can be achieved by using such device under only 20mA bias current.

articleTitle: 4+G mobile backhaul over OFDMA/TDMA-PON to 200 cell sites per fiber with 10Gb/s upstream burst-mode operation enabling < 1ms transmission latency
abstract: The first downstream/upstream OFDMA/TDMA-PON achieving >;100Mb/s per-cell mobile backhaul and burst-mode operation using off-the-shelf APDs is demonstrated over 1.645km for 200 cells. The new approach enables <;1ms transmission latency and 3dB burst-mode dynamic range tolerance.

articleTitle: Super-splits 10G-EPON system: 256 ONU passive splits with 240 ns dual-rate burst-mode 3R synctime and bi-directionally extended 35.9 dB loss budgets
abstract: This first super-splits 10G-EPON demonstration achieved the largest loss budget of 35.9 dB and a fast dual-rate synctime of 240 ns supporting 256 ONU splits with 8.0 Gb/s upstream throughput, highlighting novel self-switching AGC based XFP, 82.5 GS/s CDR and ONU SFP+.

articleTitle: A novel full-duplex testbed demonstration of converged all-band 60-GHz radio-over-fiber access architecture
abstract: We demonstrate a novel full-duplex 60-GHz RoF system architecture to offer converged wireless services including multi-gigabit wireless data access. Successful provision of four-band downlink/uplink at 60-GHz is achieved over 50-km SSMF and 4-m radio propagation.

articleTitle: Universal QAM encoder/converter using fully tunable complex-coefficient optical tapped-delay line
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a tunable and reconfigurable optical scheme for encoding and converting of QAM symbols. 20/31 Gbaud QPSK signals are encoded/converted to higher order QAMs, including 64-QAM in an all-optical tunable tapped delay line. The OSNR penalty at 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> BER is measured to be ~2 dB and ~8 dB for conversions of 31 Gbaud BPSK to 15.5 Gbaud QPSK and 31 Gbaud QPSK to 15.5 Gbaud 16-QAM, respectively.

articleTitle: Cross Stratum Optimization of application and network resource based on global load balancing strategy in dynamic optical networks
abstract: We present a novel architecture for Cross Stratum Optimization of application and network resource with OpenFlow protocol. Several global load balancing strategies are proposed and demonstrated by experiments on Optical as a Service (OaaS) testbed.

articleTitle: The impact of differential mode delay on mode-division multiplexed coherent optical OFDM transmission
abstract: We analyze two-mode transmission for 402-Gb/s 3MDM-PM-QPSK-OFDM modulation and different DMD values. We show that only with low-DMD fiber it is possible to effectively equalize mode coupling and bridge long-haul transmission distances.

articleTitle: Flat and broad amplification by quasi-phase-matched fiber optical parametric amplifier
abstract: We find that quasi-phase-matching by periodic insertions of pump-phase-shifters into a highly nonlinear fiber enables parametric gain flat and broad. The insertion of the shifter broadens 0.3-dB gain bandwidth to 30 nm from 9 nm.

articleTitle: 854 Gb/s superchannel InP transmitter and receiver photonic integrated circuits utilizing real-time detection of PM-8QAM
abstract: We demonstrate 854.4 Gb/s, polarization multiplexed 8QAM, superchannel monolithic InP transmitter and receiver photonic integrated circuits (10 wavelengths at 14.24 Gbaud) with real-time detection, using coherent ASICs.

articleTitle: Demonstration of translucent elastic optical network based on virtualized elastic regenerator
abstract: We propose a translucent elastic optical network based on a virtualized elastic regenerator. Using a real-time 128-Gb/s spectrum-selective subchannel regenerator, we verify the concept through mixed-rate superchannel regeneration and frequency-slot merger with spectrum conversion.

articleTitle: A multi-lane optical receiver with integrated photodiodes in 90nm standard CMOS
abstract: A multi-lane optical receiver with integrated photodiodes is fabricated in a 90nm CMOS process, the first in a standard CMOS node below 100nm. It has a sensitivity of -3.7dBm at a 3.125Gbps data rate and consumes 46.3mW per lane from a 1.2V supply.

articleTitle: Optimum architecture for M×N multicast switch-based colorless, directionless, contentionless, and flexible-grid ROADM
abstract: Targeting on flexible-grid/CDC ROADM for coherent systems, we present an M×N multicast switch-based architecture which can reduce the cost of a conventional architecture by up to 50%.

articleTitle: Partially self-pumped fiber fuse propagation through a white tight-buffered single-mode optical fiber
abstract: The propagation threshold power through a white tight-buffered fiber was found to be 3% less than that through an acrylate-coated fiber because the pigments in the buffer backscatter the visible emission that pumps a fuse.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 10 Gbit/s colorless coherent PON incorporating tunable DS-DBR lasers and low-complexity parallel DSP
abstract: The feasibility of a colorless coherent PON operating at 10 Gbit/s is verified using monolithically integrated C-band tunable lasers as sources for the signal and local oscillator. Using parallel digital postprocessing, a sensitivity below -36 dBm is demonstrated.

articleTitle: 4000km transmission of 50GHz spaced, 10×494.85-Gb/s hybrid 32–64QAM using cascaded equalization and training-assisted phase recovery
abstract: Employing time-domain hybrid QAM, training-assisted phase recovery and cascaded equalization, we successfully transmitted ten 494.85Gbit/s PDM-32/64QAM DWDM signals at 8.25b/s/Hz net spectral efficiency (SE) over 40×100km, achieving a record terrestrial SE⋅distance product of 33,000-km b/s/Hz.

articleTitle: 1.3 μm, 56-Gbit/s EML module target to 400GbE
abstract: We developed 1.3 μm, EML module built in EML driver IC for both 50 and 56 Gbit/s. 40-km SMF transmission with clear eye openings under 56 Gbit/s operation were demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Nondestructive measurement of mode couplings along a multi-core fiber using a multi-channel OTDR
abstract: A new method for measuring mode-couplings along a multi-core fiber (MCF) is proposed that uses a multi-channel OTDR technique. Using a synchronous seven-channel OTDR, we have successfully measured the mode-couplings along a 2.9 km-long MCF.

articleTitle: 480Mb/s UWB distribution over large-core POF based bus and tree P2MP systems for in-home networks

authors.preferredName: H. P. A. van den Boom

abstract: We report large-core POF based P2MP in-home networks employing bus and tree topologies distributing 480Mb/s UWB signals to 3 (bus) and 4 (tree) terminals. Up to 55m transmission distance in both configurations is successfully achieved.

articleTitle: Double-sided-mount card-edge-connected optical transceiver module using cost-effective FPC-OE optical engine
abstract: We developed an 8-channel optical transceiver that achieves high density and low cost by adopting cost-effective FPC-OEs on both surfaces of a card-edge module. Clear eye-openings and error-free operation up to 14 Gb/s were obtained.

articleTitle: Exploring the antenna lambda connection
abstract: Radio access network advances enable close relationship between individual radio antenna-carriers and wavelengths. Low cost WDM-PON opens for entirely new ways of designing, deploying and operating advanced radio and mobile transport networks.

articleTitle: Benefits of OTN switching introduction in 100Gb/s optical transport networks
abstract: In this paper we analyze the impact of introducing electrical OTN switching on top a WDM layer in two 100Gb/s optical networks. We evaluate cost and network efficiency improvements granted by OTN when using a multi-layer approach for the design. We demonstrate that OTN is a key ingredient for efficient 100Gb/s optical networking.

articleTitle: Analysis of mode-dependent gain in Raman amplified few-mode fiber
abstract: We present a theory for Raman amplification in few-mode fibers based on the real (non LP) waveguide modes of the fiber. The condition for minimal mode-dependent gain is analyzed and reported for a few-mode fiber supporting 12 polarization- and spatial modes. The results are in agreement with recent experimental demonstrations.

articleTitle: Analyzing a new mechanism of air holes to suppress micro-bending loss
abstract: A new functionality of air holes, reduction of micro-bending loss, was analyzed and discussed. The optimum air-hole diameter arranged around the fiber edge to minimize microbending loss was also investigated.

articleTitle: Quantitative mode discrimination and bending crosstalk of four-core homogeneous coupled multi-core fiber
abstract: A quantitative discrimination method of coupled modes of homogeneous coupled multi-core fiber was developed by measuring the visibility of FFPs under small wavelength change. The mode conversion due to bending is investigated using this technique.

articleTitle: High performance 40GHz InP Mach-Zehnder modulator
abstract: A novel design was used to fabricate a Telcordia-qualified 40GHz InP Mach-Zehnder modulator. Record low loss, record high extinction ratio, and low-voltage single-end drive over a 40nm wavelength band with open-loop phase/bias control was achieved.

articleTitle: 10-Gb/s operation of RSOA for WDM PON using return-to-zero modulation format
abstract: We directly modulate an RSOA at 10 Gb/s in RZ format and achieve the error-free transmission over 20-km long SMF without using any electronic equalization techniques.

articleTitle: Thermal decay of ArF-excimer-laser fabricated fiber Bragg gratings in Bi-Al-doped optical fibers
abstract: Fiber Bragg Gratings were fabricated using a 193-nm-ArF-excimer laser with ac index changes of 0.6×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> and 2.2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> in pristine and H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-loaded Bi-Al-SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> fibers. Thermal annealing of the FBGs was investigated using continuous isochronal annealing.

articleTitle: Beyond 100G optical channel noise modeling for optimized soft-decision FEC performance
abstract: Deviations away from ideal AWGN statistics degrading FEC performance are demonstrated caused by the nonlinear optical channel and by receiver-side DSP. An according noise model is demonstrated for FEC test and optimization.

articleTitle: 250Gb/s real-time PIC-based super-channel transmission over a gridless 6000km terrestrial link
abstract: A 250Gb/s super-channel using Photonic Integrated Circuits (PIC) was transmitted over 6000km along with a 500Gb/s super-channel and conventional 40Gb/s and 100Gb/s channels. The linear terrestrial line system uses FlexWSS multiplexing technologies and Hybrid RamanEDFA amplifiers.

articleTitle: First demonstration of active plasmonic device in true data traffic conditions: ON/OFF thermo-optic modulation using a hybrid silicon-plasmonic asymmetric MZI
abstract: We demonstrate the first system-level evaluation of an active plasmonic device in 10Gb/s data traffic conditions. Thermo-optic ON/OFF modulation with 3μs response time and 10mW power consumption is presented using an asymmetric MZI silicon-plasmonic gate.

articleTitle: Shared-path protection in OFDM-based optical networks with elastic bandwidth allocation
abstract: Compared with backup sharing in WDM networks, it is more complex and challenging to share backup resources in OFDM-based optical networks with elastic bandwidth allocation. We propose and evaluate conservative and aggressive backup sharing policies.

articleTitle: A hybrid photonic integrated wavelength converter on a silicon-on-insulator substrate
abstract: We present fabrication and testing of a wavelength converter integrated on a silicon-on-insulator substrate. The chip employs a hybrid integrated SOA and delay-interferometers integrated on 4μm SOI. We demonstrate 40Gb/s error-free performance.

articleTitle: Multi-core fibers for high capacity transmission
abstract: Various approaches for suppressing inter-core crosstalk of multi-core fiber and state-of-the-art low-crosstalk multi-core fiber feasible to ultra-long-haul transmission are reviewed. Additionally, preferable way to improve spatial spectral efficiency is discussed.

articleTitle: Clock recovery and jitter sources in coherent transmission systems
abstract: Jitter sources in a coherent system are identified. Amongst them, chromatic dispersion and LO FM noise induced jitter is found to be significant. Conventional digital clock recovery schemes using over-sampled signals are reviewed.

articleTitle: N×M wavelength selective crossconnect with flexible passbands
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel compact N×M wavelength selective cross connect based on a single LCOS array with flexible pass bands. Prototype with 5 fully connected ports was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Field observations of optical parameters using integrated performance monitoring
abstract: We present field observations on the state of polarization, polarization-mode-dispersion and polarization-dependent loss of three routes (6 fibers) monitored using coherent transponders. We observed that one fiber had a significantly more active state of polarization.

articleTitle: 30-Tb/s (3×12.84-Tb/s) signal transmission over 320km using PDM 64-QAM modulation
abstract: We demonstrate three-channel WDM transmission of 12.84-Tb/s/ch polarization division multiplexed (PDM) 64-QAM over 320-km SMF-28 with hybrid amplification spans. Each 10-Tb/s superchannel comprises one hundred Nyquist DWDM subchannels in 1275-GHz spectrum occupancy, yielding a spectral efficiency of 7.9 b/s/Hz. The BER of all channels after transmission over 320 km is measured smaller than 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>, the third generation FEC limit.

articleTitle: Eye-safe data transmission of 1.25 Gbit/s over 100-m SI-POF with four laser diodes in the visible range
abstract: For the first time we have proved 1.25-Gbit/s eye-safe transmission over 50-m and 100-m links of step-index polymer optical fiber with edge emitting direct injection laser diodes operating at 405 nm, 450 nm, 515 nm and 650 nm each.

articleTitle: UEP-BCH product code based hard-decision FEC for 100 Gb/s optical transport networks
abstract: We propose a novel hard-decision FEC based on an unequal error protection (UEP) BCH product code for OTU4 framers. A simulation indicates a net coding gain of 9.35dB with 7% redundancy.

articleTitle: High-speed wireless bridge at 220 GHz connecting two fiber-optic links each spanning up to 20 km
abstract: Record-speed wireless data bridging at 220 GHz is demonstrated with a 20 Gbit/s NRZ-OOK and a 9 Gbit/s OFDM signal. We connect the wireless gateways of two fiber spans, each with up to 20 km.

articleTitle: A cost-effective electrical tracing-assisted silicon microring biosensor
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a cost effective electrical tracing-assisted silicon microring sensor system which comprises one sensing microring and another thermo-optical-tunable tracing microring. Proof-of-principle demonstation by testing polyelectrolyte multilayer shows the sensitivity of 3.75 mW/ng·mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Dynamic optical routing and simultaneous generation of millimeter-wave signals for in-building access network
abstract: Two-stage optical routing using SOA and integrated micro-ring resonator, and remote generation of millimeter-wave signals by optical frequency multiplication is demonstrated for inbuilding network. Both 150Mb/s 64-QAM and 802.11a WLAN signal at 38GHz are transmitted.

articleTitle: Interferometric method for phase error measurement in an arrayed waveguide grating with a free space output
abstract: We demonstrate a simple phase error measurement technique for AWG that radiate to free-space. The pair-wise far-field interference pattern of adjacent waveguides is used to measure the relative phase shift, with 13mrad accuracy.

articleTitle: Spatial beam transformer for wavelength selective switch consisting of silica-based planar lightwave circuit
abstract: We propose a spatial beam transformer (SBT) for a wavelength selective switch, which is monolithically integrated on a silica-based planar lightwave circuit (PLC). The PLC-integrated SBT has advantages such as freedom from precise alignment and the elimination of expensive bulk optics. In addition, the aspect ratio can be freely designed simply by redesigning the layout of the SBT without adding any other optical components. We successfully tuned the aspect ratio from 7.9 to 87.5 simply by changing the PLC layout.

articleTitle: Integrated polarization-diversity coherent receiver on polymer PLC for QPSK and QAM signals
abstract: We present an integrated polarization-diversity coherent-receiver module which was fabricated on a polymer planar-lightwave circuit platform. The performance of the device is tested in system experiments with 16-QAM and QPSK modulation up to 112 Gb/s.

articleTitle: A 2N-bit bipolar photonic digital-to-analog converter based on multi-wavelength optical DQPSK modulation in combination with balanced detection
abstract: We put forward a 2N-bit bipolar photonic digital-to-analog converter (PDAC) scheme based on multi-wavelength optical DQPSK modulation in combination with balanced detection and demonstrate it in a 2.5GS/s 4-bit PDAC experiment.

articleTitle: Low-loss mid-IR microstructured optical fibers
abstract: Chalcogenide glasses are known for their large transparency in the mid-infrared and their high refractive index (>2). They present also a high non-linear coefficient (n<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>), 100 to 1000 times larger than for silica, depending on the composition. An original way to obtain single-mode fibers is to design microstructured optical fibers (MOFs). These fibers present unique optical properties thanks to the high degree of freedom in the design of their geometrical structure. A classical method to realize MOFs is the stack-and-draw technique. However, with chalcogenide glasses, that technique induces optical losses at the interfaces in the stack of capillaries. In consequence, we have developed a new casting method to fabricate the chalcogenide preform. This method permits to obtain optical losses less than 1 dB/m at 1.55 μm and 0.1 dB/m in the mid-IR region. Various chalcogenide microstructured fibers working in the IR range were prepared in order to take advantage of the non-linear properties of these glasses and of the original MOF properties. For example, fibers with small effective mode area (A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub> <; 10 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) have been realized to exacerbate the non-linear optical properties. Such fibers will find applications for signal regeneration in telecom, and for the generation of supercontinuum sources. On the contrary, for military applications in the 3-5 and 8-12 μm windows, large effective mode area and single mode fibers have been designed to permit the propagation of high-power Gaussian laser beams.

articleTitle: Realizing large effective area fibers
abstract: Performances of state-of-the-art large-A<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</inf> single-core fibers are presented. We explain how trench-assisted step-index structures allow to reach A<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</inf> up to 160μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with 125μm glass diameter. Extension to larger A<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</inf> is also discussed.

articleTitle: Evolution and status of forward error correction
abstract: An LDPC based soft-decision FEC having a NCG of 10.8dB has been implemented in a coherent ASIC. Greater gain and the interplay with nonlinearity equalizers are anticipated for the real deployment of 100G and beyond.

articleTitle: Low-loss photonic wire bond interconnects enabling 5 Tbit/s data transmission
abstract: Photonic wire bonding enables flexible single-mode chip-to-chip interconnects with average losses of only 2.5 dB over a spectral range from 1270 nm to 1580 nm. Flawless transmission is demonstrated for a 5.25 Tbit/s data stream.

articleTitle: Few mode transmission fiber with low DGD, low mode coupling and low loss
abstract: A transmission fiber for mode division multiplexing supporting LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> and LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> modes, with low differential group delay, low mode coupling and low loss for both modes is presented. S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> imaging is used for characterization.

articleTitle: Push-pull technique for defragmentation in flexible optical networks
abstract: An efficient defragmentation technique based on optical channel re-tuning is proposed for flexible optical networks. Effective defragmentation with no traffic disruption is achieved without additional spare transponders or re-equalization operations.

articleTitle: Non-intrusive simultaneous measurement of OSNR, CD and PMD on live WDM system
abstract: We report the first single-ended simultaneous measurement of OSNR, CD and PMD on a live optical link. We demonstrate successful troubleshooting of the in-service WDM system, showing the ability to diagnose faults without interrupting traffic.

articleTitle: Hollow core photonic bandgap fibers for telecommunications: Opportunities and potential issues
abstract: We discuss the potential advantages that hollow core photonic bandgap fibers may ultimately have over conventional all solid fibers and review the state-of-the-art, fundamental physical limits and the many technological challenges to be overcome.

articleTitle: Colorless/directionless/contentionless optical add/drop architecture applying waveband technologies and colorless mux/demux
abstract: This paper proposes a novel optical switch architecture that attains colorless/directionless/contentionless (C/D/C) capabilities. The proposed architecture combines simple switches and AWGs, and is easy to implement. We experimentally confirm its technical feasibility in an experiment.

articleTitle: Wavelength unbundling in existing GE-PON
abstract: New or alternative network providers' service overlay over GE-PON infrastructure by wavelength unbundling is studied using computer simulations. The results show that at least two network providers' wavelengths can be overlaid over the existing GE-PON.

articleTitle: A new teletraffic approach for network planning and evolution prediction
abstract: This paper outlines a new multi-layer optimization approach that considers stochastic traffic composed of heavy tailed flows for optimizing traffic engineering and grooming, network design, dimensioning and planning, and evolution prediction.

articleTitle: FEC and soft decision: Concept and directions
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: FEC code; channel coding; and low density parity-check codes.

articleTitle: Grooming and RWA in translucent dynamic mixed-line-rate WDM networks with impairments
abstract: This paper develops a scheme to dynamically make grooming, regenerator placement, and routing and wavelength assignment (RWA) decisions for translucent mixed-line-rate optical networks. We consider physical impairments and compare to the no-grooming case.

articleTitle: Ultra-fast optical signal processors based on fiber grating devices for applications in telecommunication systems
abstract: This communication reviews recent work on the development of fundamental optical signal processing devices, particularly ultra-fast photonic differentiators, using all-fiber (long-period and Bragg) gratings. Their application for pulse shaping, signal and device characterization, and all-optical switching will be also discussed.

articleTitle: Mode multiplexing at 2×20Gbps over 19-cell hollow-core photonic band gap fibre
abstract: This paper demonstrates the first mode-multiplexed system over 19-cell hollow-core photonic band gap fibre, at 2×20Gbps using the LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0,1</sub> and LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2,1</sub>-like modes.

articleTitle: Generation of 224-Gb/s multicarrier offset-QAM using a real-time transmitter
abstract: We present the first real-time transmitter generating a multicarrier offset-QAM signal at 224 Gb/s after polarization multiplexing. Low penalties are achieved in a back-to-back experiment using a novel FPGA platform including two high-speed DACs running at 32 GS/s.

articleTitle: A simple criterion for performance estimation of 112Gb/s PDM-QPSK WDM system over uncompensated links
abstract: A simple criterion for OSNR penalty prediction for WDM system over uncompensated links is introduced. Its effectiveness has been validated through both simulations and experiments in the 112Gb/s PDM-QPSK WDM systems.

articleTitle: Blind subcarrier equalization without pre-filtering for optical OFDM systems
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that fractionally-spaced digital equalization can simultaneously demultiplex and equalize OFDM subcarriers without needing digital pre-filters or training sequences. Only blind adaptive algorithms were used to optimize the equalizer.

articleTitle: Polarization independent self-seeding of Fabry-Peròt laser diodes for WDM-PONs
abstract: We obtain stable 1.25 Gb/s self-seeded operation of directly-modulated Fabry-Peròt laser diodes without polarization control, at several wavelengths. Benefits against self-seeded Reflective-SOAs are also discussed.

articleTitle: Successful experimental validation of an integrated burst mode receiver designed for 10G-GPON systems in a packet-OADM metro network
abstract: A burst mode receiver designed for 10G-GPON systems was tested in a packet-optical add/drop multiplexer metro network. Fast power dynamic range and OSNR tolerance recordings demonstrate that this receiver is compliant with metro network requirements.

articleTitle: 50-Gb/s Radio-over-Fiber system employing MIMO and OFDM modulation at 60 GHz
abstract: Record 50-Gb/s wireless signal transmission over 4 m is experimentally demonstrated using a 2×2 MIMO Radio-over-Fiber system at 60 GHz. MIMO spatial multiplexing and 16-QAM OFDM modulation were used to achieve a high combined spectral efficiency of up-to 8 b/s/Hz.

articleTitle: A novel multi-frequency coherent OTDR for fast fading noise reduction
abstract: We firstly propose and demonstrate a novel multi-frequency coherent OTDR, which inherently has the fast fading noise reduction capability. And 0.09-dB amplitude fluctuation is achieved with only 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">14</sup> averages by this novel Coherent OTDR.

articleTitle: Sensitivity to phase errors of fourier transforms using arrayed waveguide grating routers for optical OFDM
abstract: Simulations of a four-channel AWGR FFT show the mean signal quality is the inverse of the phase variance of the arrayed waveguides. The phase error should <; 15° for an 84% device yield.

articleTitle: WDM transmission of 127 Gb/s PM-QPSK signal over 3,350 km SMF-only line with chromatic dispersion compensation using real-time DSP-LSI
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated 127 Gb/s PM-QPSK signal transmission in 50 GHzspacing 5-channel WDM configuration over 3,350 km SMF-only line. 56,200 ps/nm of chromatic dispersion was compensated by overlap FDE implemented on real-time DSP-LSI.

articleTitle: Characterization of thermo-optical 2×2 switch configurations made of Dielectric Loaded Surface Plasmon Polariton Waveguides for telecom routing architecture
