abstract: We report on the characterization of thermo-optic switch structures based on Dielectric Loaded Surface Plasmon Polariton Waveguide for high data bit rate transfer. Performances are extracted by Leakage Radiation Microscopy and compared to numerical results.

articleTitle: High-power near-ballistic uni-traveling carrier photodiode with ultra-fast switching characteristic for millimeter-wave over fiber wireless communication
abstract: We review our work about near-ballistic uni-traveling carrier photodiode (NBUTC-PD). By utilizing its ultra-fast switching and high output-power characteristics, a few cycle electrical pulse generation and extremely-high data rate wireless communication at W-band is achieved.

articleTitle: Adiabatically expanded single-mode optical fibers for reduced optical power density and enhanced reliability
abstract: Mode-field areas of standard and specialty single-mode fibers have been adiabatically expanded more than 14-fold from 85 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to 1195 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with <; 0.1 dB loss using the technique of reverse tapering to reduce potential failure mechanisms.

articleTitle: Full-duplex 60 GHz vector-signal radio-over-fiber system using heterodyne optical-carrier suppression
abstract: To overcome the fundamental limitation of conventional optical-carrier-suppression, we proposed a novel heterodyne optical-carrier-suppression to achieve centralized up/down-conversion in the radio-over-fiber system. Full-duplex 60-GHz BPSK transmission has been achieved after 25-km single-mode fibers.

articleTitle: Integrated phase-locked multi-THz comb for broadband offset locking
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated InGaAsP/InP 2.06 THz broadband comb for offset locking SG-DBR widely tunable lasers. The comb has 70 lasing lines and is generated using a hybrid mode-locked laser with intracavity gain flattening.

articleTitle: Laser coherence enhancement by extra-cavity parametric mixing
abstract: We introduce a novel approach for laser coherence enhancement through parametric multiplication of the instantaneous frequency variation, thus eliminating the use of highly-resonant cavities. A 300-fold linewidth reduction of a tunable laser is demonstrated.

articleTitle: MPLS-TP: Where are we?
abstract: This paper provides an introduction to MPLS-TP, how it differs from traditional IP/MPLS, an overview of its functionality, how it will be deployed, and its standardization status.

articleTitle: Highly birefringent biconical fiber tapers fabricated by hydrofluoric acid microdroplet flow etching
abstract: Biconical fiber tapers with asymmetric, micron-wide cross-sections were etched from standard single-mode fibers by hydrofluoric acid microdroplets. The tapers showed record-high group birefringences of B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G</sub> ~ 0.017 and insertion losses <; 0.7 dB.

articleTitle: Design energy efficient translucent optical networks with joint routing and wavelength assignment and mixed regenerator placement
abstract: We propose network design algorithms to improve energy-efficiency of a translucent network with joint optimization of RWA and mixed regenerator placement (MRP). Simulations show that the MRP schemes achieve effective energy-saving and low blocking probability.

articleTitle: Cost assessment of Next-Generation Passive Optical Access Networks on real-street scenario
abstract: We report a network-wide comparison of WDM-based Next-Generation PON access solutions, based on an infrastructure, power consumption and system cost analysis, of a real-world network deployment scenario.

articleTitle: Influence of channel spacing on ultra long-haul WDM transmission of 8×112 Gb/s PS-QPSK signals
abstract: We experimentally investigate 112-Gb/s polarization-switched quadrature phase-shift keying signals. In ultra long-haul wavelength-division multiplexing (WDM) transmission experiments, we compare the performance of WDM channels with 1.07×symbol rate spacing and a regular 50-GHz spacing.

articleTitle: 512-Gb/s DP-16-QAM field trial over 734 km installed SSMF with co-propagating 10 Gb/s NRZ neighbors incorporating soft-FEC decoding
abstract: We report on a 512-Gb/s dual-carrier DP-16-QAM long haul field trial over 734 km of dispersion compensated SSMF with 10-Gb/s neighbors. Soft FEC decoding was utilized in the receiver DSP confirming successful transmission.

articleTitle: Experimental comparison of no-guard-interval-OFDM and Nyquist-WDM superchannels
abstract: We experimentally compare the performance of NGI-OFDM and Nyquist-WDM superchannels with same spectral efficiency in both back-to-back and transmission cases. Because of lower inter-carrier interference, the Nyquist-WDM has better performance than the NGI-OFDM.

articleTitle: Clock distribution scheme using signal phase for channel identification in optical time division multiplexing
abstract: We propose to use signal phase for clock distribution in OTDM to enable stable clock recovery and channel identification using minimum bandwidth. A stable 43-GHz optical clock recovery has been successfully demonstrated from 215-Gb/s OTDM signal.

articleTitle: Data-aided frequency-domain 2×2 MIMO equalizer for 112 Gbit/s PDM-QPSK coherent transmission systems
abstract: Benefits of a low-complexity adaptive 32-tap 2×2 MIMO frequency-domain filter update by data-aided channel estimation over a time-domain filter with DD-LMS are shown. Superior stability and convergence speed is demonstrated with identical impairment tolerance.

articleTitle: ISI compensation up to Nyquist channel spacing for strongly filtered PDM RZ-QPSK using multi-tap CMA
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate inter-symbol interference (ISI) mitigation using a multi-tap constant modulus algorithm (CMA) for strongly filtered PDM RZ-QPSK and find it to be effective up to Nyquist channel spacing after transpacific transmission distances.

articleTitle: Migrating legacy PON equipment towards colorless ONU through hybrid integrated SOI all-optical λ-converter
abstract: We present an ONU featuring a “colorless” DML enabled by a wavelength converter integrated on a 4μm silicon-on-insulator substrate. The photonic chip employs a hybrid integrated SOA and delay-interferometers and supports operation beyond 10Gb/s.

articleTitle: A heuristic for minimizing SBRR homing costs
abstract: The shared backup router resources (SBRR) homing architecture leads to significant cost reductions compared to dual homing. We propose a novel heuristic approach and evaluate its performance for different network topologies and varying traffic demand.

articleTitle: Long-reach WDM-PON using directly modulated RSOAs and subcarrier multiplexing
abstract: We demonstrate 50-km upstream transmission of 2.5-Gbps RSOA signals carried at 6GHz subcarrier over a single-fiber loopback network. Subcarrier multiplexing reduces the deleterious effects of Rayleigh back-scattering, which is confirmed by comparison with baseband transmission.

articleTitle: Bandwidth of multimode fibers obtained from system performance
abstract: Recently demonstrated bandwidth measurement of multimode fibers through system level performance is studied using system modeling, which provides additional validation and insight. New method of calculating bandwidth from fibers with non-Gaussian response is illustrated.

articleTitle: A novel self-mixing duobinary RF receiver for millimeter-wave radio-over-fiber systems
abstract: We propose a novel self-mixing duobinary RF receiver structure for 60-GHz radio-over-fiber systems, which simultaneously downconverts and decodes RF duobinary signals at Nyquist limit. Error-free transmission at 4Gb/s over 25-km SMF-28 and 4-ft wireless is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Enhanced-performance BOTDA sensing through optimized pulse coding and low-RIN bidirectional Raman amplification
abstract: An enhanced-performance BOTDA sensor is presented combining low-RIN distributed Raman amplification and RZ Simplex-pulse coding. Results demonstrate for first time 1 m spatial resolution over 120 km distance with 1.3°C/26 με resolutions

articleTitle: 40-Fold 4-channel sub-picosecond pulse compression by Raman amplification and self-phase modulation
abstract: We realize 40-fold simultaneous compression for 4 WDM clock/data pulses to 500fs by distributed Raman amplifier and SPM-based compressor. BER measurements of compressed pulses show small penalties of 0.4dB in which SPM offers penalty-free operation.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable coherent transceivers for optical transmission capacity and reach optimization
abstract: Coherent transceivers in high capacity optical transmission systems have dramatically increased networking capabilities. Enhancing flexibility of these transceivers can enable dynamic optimization of DWDM signal characteristics to extract more capacity from optical networks.

articleTitle: Ultra-fast, high-resolution, and linear characterization of passive optical components via optical channel estimation
abstract: We extend the DSP-based optical channel estimation to ultra-fast, high-resolution, and linear characterization of passive optical components. In experiment, we realize sub-MHz resolution with a measurement time bounded by the theoretical limit.

articleTitle: 100G OTN technology and deployment for carrier networks
abstract: Transport equipment with MS-OTN switching & multiplexing and advanced 100G coherent optics provides optimal connectivity with efficient bandwidth management, thus is poised to meet the continuing relentless bandwidth demand at lower cost per transported bit.

articleTitle: Timing jitter of SOA-amplified intensity modulated optical pulses
abstract: The origin of timing jitter during SOA amplification of ps-long intensity modulated pulses is identified. Both experimental and analytical theoretical jitter results are presented, revealing an almost linear relationship between jitter and pulse intensity modulation.

articleTitle: Monolithic integration of silica-based AWG filter and germanium photodiodes for one-chip WDM receiver
abstract: Using low-temperature plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition, a silica-based arrayed-waveguide grating (AWG) filter has been monolithically integrated with germanium photodiodes on a silicon-based photonic platform. All the outputs of a 16-channel AWG with 200-GHz spacing have been equipped with germanium photodiodes. All wavelength channels of the integrated device were confirmed to function as a wavelength-division-demultiplexing receiver for 1.25-Gbps PRBS signals. In addition, we have successfully mounted multi-channel transimpedance amplifiers and limiting amplifiers on the integrated photonic device using flip-chip bonding technology.

articleTitle: 6∗40Gb/s all-optical RZ-DPSK amplitude regeneration based on XPM effect in a single SOA
abstract: We demonstrate parallel amplitude regeneration for 6*40Gb/s RZ-DPSK signals using the XPM effect in a single saturated SOA and subsequent narrow filtering. An average -1.3 dB power penalty can be achieved for all the channels.

articleTitle: A generic foundry model for InP-based photonic ICs
abstract: Europe is making significant investments in development of generic photonic foundry platform infrastructures for InP-based and Silicon Photonic ICs. Here we present the present status for the InP-based JePPIX platform.

articleTitle: Generation of flat and stable multi-carriers based on only integrated IQ modulator and its implementation for 112Gb/s PM-QPSK transmitter
abstract: We theoretically and numerically analyze the multi-carriers generation scheme based on only integrated IQ modulator. Flat and stable 11 carriers are obtained and 112Gb/s PM-QPSK experiment over a single subcarrier has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Experimental assessment of a combined PCE-RMA and distributed spectrum allocation mechanism for GMPLS elastic CO-OFDM optical networks
abstract: We design and deploy a GMPLS control plane for elastic CO-OFDM optical networks, detailing its functional architecture combining PCE routing and modulation assignment (RMA) with distributed spectrum allocation, the protocol extensions and the experimental validation.

articleTitle: Guided entropy mode Rayleigh scattering in optical fibers
abstract: We measure the Rayleigh scattering spectrum in an optical fiber. Our data suggest that the narrower gain bandwidth and frequency shift that we observe are due to guided entropy modes in the fiber.

articleTitle: 6×6 MIMO transmission over 50+25+10 km heterogeneous spans of few-mode fiber with inline erbium-doped fiber amplifier
abstract: We demonstrate mode-division multiplexed transmission using the LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> and LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> modes over three heterogeneous spans of few-mode fiber and investigate the impact of fusion splicing and free-space coupling on mode mixing.

articleTitle: 1.3μm hybrid silicon electroabsorption modulator with bandwidth beyond 67 GHz
abstract: Hybrid silicon electroabsorption modulators with bandwidth over 67GHz have been demonstrated for 1.3ìm transmission. An eye diagram measured after 16km transmission shows a 9.4dB dynamic extinction ratio at 50Gb/s with a 2.2Vpp drive voltage.

articleTitle: Silicon waveguide infrared photodiodes based on embedded nickel silicide particles
abstract: A novel CMOS-compatible infrared Si-waveguide photodetector, which utilizes photoemission from electrically floating metal silicide nanoparticles embedded in the space charge region of a Si p-n junction, is proposed. Numerical simulations show that absorption of infrared radiation in the particles can be dramatically enhanced due to resonant excitation of the localized surface plasmons on the particles, thus enabling to shrink the detector's footprint to a submicron scale. A proof-of-concept device is fabricated using standard CMOS technology, exhibiting a peak responsivity of ~30 mA/W and a 3-dB bandwidth of ~6 GHz.

articleTitle: Transmission of power-efficient CO-OFDM signals over 9360 km of ultra-large-area fiber
abstract: In this paper we introduced two power-efficient CO-OFDM systems and showed that both systems can have ~1-dB gain in receiving sensitivity (BER = 1e-3) and exhibit ~1.1-dB benefit in Q factor after 9360-km transmission when compared with the regular PDM-CO-OFDM.

articleTitle: Optimum balance between pre-planner and on the fly recovery in Packet-Optical transport networks
abstract: A network based on Packet-Optical integrated nodes is submitted to a survivability assessment to find the optimum balance between static and dynamic resiliency management. Extensive simulations on a metro network are reported.

articleTitle: Fiber optic interconnection reliability: Lead-in region fiber fracture experiment
abstract: This paper summarizes research of IEC SC86B, Reliability task group on fiber optic interconnection reliability. Experimental data of lead-in fiber fracture study after 8760 hours exposure and theoretical model for fiber tensile stress are presented.

articleTitle: Transmission of 3×224 Gbit/s DP-16QAM signals with (up to) 7.2 bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency in SMF-EDFA links
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 3×224 Gbit/s DP-16QAM transmission with spectral efficiencies (SEs) of 7.2(6.9) bit/s/Hz in 240(400)-km SMF-EDFA links. Such high-SE transmission is enabled by a digital post-filter and 4-state maximum likelihood sequence detection.

articleTitle: Feasibility of unretimed 100 GbE based on 4×25.78 GBd
abstract: We have demonstrated the feasibility of unretimed 100 GbE based on 4×25.78 GBd signaling, using a 40 nm CMOS SerDes interfaced to a 100 mm host PCB channel that includes a z-pluggable connector connected to a 100Gbase-LR4 ROSA.

articleTitle: Impairment-Aware routing and waveband assignment for efficient optical transport networks
abstract: We demonstrate the importance of considering physical impairments in waveband-based optical networks. We propose and evaluate an Impairment-Aware waveband-routing and waveband-assignment (IA-RWBA) algorithm achieving significant improvement in both impairment satisfaction rate and total network cost.

articleTitle: High spectrum narrowing tolerant 112 Gb/s dual polarization QPSK optical communication systems using digital adaptive channel estimation
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate high spectrum narrowing tolerant 112-Gb/s QPSK polarization multiplex system based on digital adaptive channel estimation method. The proposed algorithm is able to detect severe spectrum-narrowed signal even with 20GHz 3dB bandwidth.

articleTitle: Gain switched multi-carrier transmitter and pilot tone based receiver for long reach access networks
abstract: A novel and cost effective long reach PON downlink scenario is proposed employing a multi-carrier transmitter and pilot tone aided direct detection at the receiver. Error free performance with QPSK and 50km transmission is presented.

articleTitle: A self-reconfiguring constant modulus algorithm for proper polarization demultiplexing in coherent optical receivers
abstract: We propose a self-reconfiguring constant modulus algorithm (CMA) using a constrained mode followed by an unconstrained mode for solving the singularity issue of CMA equalizers in polarization-division-multiplexed coherent receivers.

articleTitle: Self-referenced Erbium fiber laser frequency comb at a GHz repetition rate
abstract: An Erbium fiber laser frequency comb operating at a GHz repetition rate is reported. The f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ceo</sub> and f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rep</sub> stabilized all-fiber system produces 2nJ sub-100fs pulses to seed octave-spanning supercontinuum generation spanning 1 μm-2.4 μm.

articleTitle: Photonic generation of millimeter waves and its applications
abstract: This paper describes recent advances in generation of millimeter waves based on photonic techniques, which provides wide bandwidth and high output power. Component technologies such as photodiodes and antennas, and applications to telecommunications are presented.

articleTitle: Impact of modal crosstalk and multi-path interference on few-mode fiber transmission
abstract: Crosstalk caused by random mode coupling can make mode-multiplexing infeasible. However, transmission of single mode over few-mode fibers is relatively insensitive to mode mixing and therefore they can be used as large-effective area fibers.

articleTitle: Novel trends in performance monitoring
abstract: We give an overview of parameter and performance monitoring based on traditional all-optical techniques and emerging methods enabled by transponders with digital equalization. In particular, challenges for OPM in coherent detection systems are discussed.

articleTitle: Polarization Hole Burning in EDFA
abstract: A new model for Polarization Hole Burning (PHB) in EDFA is derived from fundamental assumptions and is confirmed by experimental results for PHB of EDFA measured both over signal wavelength and power.

articleTitle: Accelerated method for transmitter eye-mask compliance testing
abstract: An accuracy metric is introduced allowing opportunities to significantly reduce the time and cost required to perform standards-based optical transmitter eye-mask tests.

articleTitle: Switching characteristics of 30μmx30μm compact optical switch with slowing light
abstract: Slowing light enables us to realize giant equivalent index changes. We demonstrated a 30μm×30μm slow light optical switch with a large bending angle of 30 degrees. The switching speed is as fast as 8.0 nsec.

articleTitle: Business services over PON
abstract: Verizon has done extensive deployment of PON technologies for its FiOS services. This paper describes Verizon vision and architecture of a converged access network for supporting business and residential services over a common PON based access network.

articleTitle: Producing known complex modulation signals for calibration of optical modulation analyzers
abstract: A family of optical modulation signals with known properties was generated using three phase-locked lasers for calibration of the complex measurement plane. Patterns predicted from first principles were measured with a real-time optical modulation analyzer.

articleTitle: Realizing high sensitivity at 40 Gbit/s and 100 Gbit/s
abstract: We experimentally investigate modulation formats for realizing high data rate and high power sensitivity using coherent reception with low noise-figure optical preamplification. 40 Gbit/s PS-QPSK exhibits a sensitivity of 4.3 photons/bit while 100 Gbit/s PDM-QPSK exhibits a sensitivity of 5.3 photons/bit at 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> BER.

articleTitle: Linearity improvement based on digital signal processing in intensity-modulated analog optical links incorporating photonic frequency downconversion
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a novel digital post compensation technique to suppress the third-order intermodulation distortion (IMD3) in intensity-modulated analog optical links incorporating photonic frequency downconversion.

articleTitle: Experimenting Hierarchical PCE architecture in a distributed multi-platform control plane testbed
abstract: A distributed control plane testbed, connecting four European institutions, is developed to enable interoperability testing among independent PCE platforms and evaluate inter-domain computation algorithms based on the Hierarchical PCE. Performance results are detailed and discussed.

articleTitle: Optimizing 2 mode fibers with Aeff of 170 m2 for LP01 mode and studying a possibility of realizing endlessly 2 mode operation using holey fibers
abstract: Two mode fibers for mode division multiplexing were optimized and fabricated to realize Aeff of 170μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> for fundamental mode. A possibility of realizing endlessly 2 mode operation using holey fibers will be also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Interaction of laser phase noise with differential-mode-delay in few-mode fiber based MIMO systems
abstract: We study electronic-equalization enhanced laser phase noise impairment in few-mode fiber based systems. For 16-QAM modulation with 100-kHz laser linewidth, the differential-mode-delay is limited to 160 ps/√(km) for 1000-km two-mode fiber with strong mode-coupling.

articleTitle: 10-Gbit/s direct modulation of electrically driven photonic crystal nanocavity laser
abstract: We demonstrate direct modulation of an electrically driven photonic crystal nanocavity laser for the first time. Employing ultracompact embedded active-region and lateral current injection structure, the device operates at 10 Gbit/s with ultra-low operating energy.

articleTitle: Plasmonic nanotips for on-chip nanoscale confinement of light
abstract: We demonstrate the on-chip nanoscale focusing of surface plasmons in metallic nanotip coupled to the silicon waveguide. Strong field enhancement is observed at the apex of the tip. Enhancing light matter interactions is discussed.

articleTitle: Analysis of inter-cell interference and crosstalk in carrier allocation based visible light communication
abstract: A RF carrier allocation in visible light communication is proposed to mitigate inter-cell interference for the application of indoor positioning systems. The reduction of inter-cell interference and crosstalk effect among cells are analyzed by experimentation.

articleTitle: Impact of intra-domain information in GMPLS-based WSONs with Hierarchical PCE
abstract: This paper first shows that Hierarchical PCE is a scalable and effective solution applicable in large multi-domain WSONs. Then, three schemes are proposed for understanding the impact of intra-domain information provided to the Parent PCE.

articleTitle: WDM-PON overlay for inter- and intra-network routing
abstract: An access architecture for optical intra-network transmission between different users is presented. We demonstrate a cognitive wavelength routing scheme and investigate its scalability.

articleTitle: Dynamic topology reconfiguration for energy efficient multi-layer network using extended GMPLS with link power control
abstract: This paper proposes an energy efficient multi-layer network using extended GMPLS with link power control. The experimental result shows that dynamic energy saving according to traffic volume is realized by layer-1 and layer-2 unified control.

articleTitle: Phase synchronization of a two-channel phase-sensitive amplifier based on optical injection-locking of InP quantum-dash mode-locked lasers
abstract: A synchronization scheme for a two-channel phase sensitive amplifier is implemented based on the injection-locking of single InP quantum-dash mode-locked laser. Error free performance with penalty <;1 dB is demonstrated for both channels.

articleTitle: End-to-end integrated multiservice packet network
abstract: An integrated multiservice network demonstrator, including two home networks, two PON systems and one double-ring metro network is reported. BER performance, signal quality analysis and high quality service transport demonstrate the potential of the solution.

articleTitle: Optimum signal constellation design for high-speed optical transmission
abstract: We describe an algorithm to determine the optimum signal constellation in MMSE-sense for channel capacity achieving source distribution, and demonstrate that the signal constellations obtained by this algorithm outperform conventional QAM constellations (~1 dB for 16-ary constellation at BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-8</sup>).

articleTitle: High sensitivity modulation formats
abstract: We review high sensitivity modulation formats and in particular, review the principle, implementation, and performance of formats based on the combined use of polarization-division-multiplexed quadrature phase-shift keying (PDM-QPSK, or PQ) and mary pulse-position modulation (m-PPM).

articleTitle: RZ to NRZ format conversion for two tributaries of a PDM signal simultaneously utilizing a single section of HNLF
abstract: All-optical RZ to NRZ format conversion for two tributaries of a PDM signals simultaneously is demonstrated through a single highly nonlinear fiber with polarization nonlinear loop mirror configuration. Less than 1-dB power penalty is achieved.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of a Virtual Optical Network Resource Broker and Compositor for dynamic GMPLS WSON infrastructure services
abstract: We present a Virtual Optical Network (VON) Resource Broker and Compositor architecture to dynamically configure and deploy independent instances of virtual GMPLS-controlled WSON. We evaluate its performance in ADRENALINE Testbed highlighting the service deployment time.

articleTitle: The Telefonica International Wholesale Services (TIWS) network
abstract: Telefonica International Wholesale Services, as many Internet Tier-1 Backbone operators, is dealing with traffic growth and its business sustainability. 2012 should be the year when 100GbE, coherent 100G transmission and Packet/OTN switching should become the cost effective solution.

articleTitle: Mechanically induced SOP variations in DSCMs related to fiber PMD
abstract: SOP variation speed in fiber-based dispersion compensating modules due to mechanical perturbations like shocks and forced vibrations are shown not increase with an increasing PMD level and thus the birefringence of the fiber.

articleTitle: CMOS-compatible plasmonic waveguide platform and ring resonator for nanoscale electronic-photonic integrated circuits
abstract: We present a novel plasmonic waveguide platform Cu/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/Si/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/Cu to build high-performance CMOS-compatible plasmonic devices. The platform is based on metal-silica-silicon hybrid plasmonic waveguides. The optical performance of the waveguide platform is investigated and analyzed extensively with various geometries both theoretically and experimentally. The propagation loss can be achieved as low as 0.4 dB/μm with a small cross section SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/Si/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> of 100×340 nm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. As an example, a plasmonic ring resonator with the ring radius of 0.91 μm is designed with the platform. Excellent optical performance is measured including a free spectral range of 130 nm, extinction ratio of 24 dB, and insertion loss of 2.5 dB. We believe this work will be useful for the integration of nanoscale electronic-photonic integrated circuits.

articleTitle: IQ-coupling-loss-free polarization-switched QPSK modulator
abstract: We devised and fabricated a simple polarization-switched QPSK modulator free from the 3-dB IQ-coupling loss. It consists of only three Mach-Zehnder BPSK modulators and a polarization-coupling circuit, and operated at 43 and 84 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Plasmonics for optical interconnection
abstract: Plasmonics is an exploding new field of science and technology in which the flow of light can be molded at the nanoscale using metallic nanostructures. This newly found ability is rapidly impacting every facet of optics and photonics and is enabling a myriad of exciting new technologies. Group IV photonics has also seen tremendous recent progress in the development of high performance light sources, waveguides, modulators, and detectors. As plasmonic devices can be fabricated using CMOS compatible nanofabrication techniques, it is worth exploring opportunities at the interface between group IV photonics and plasmonics. I will discuss recent progress in the development of hybrid devices that exploit the best of each technology to enable devices for optical interconnection.

articleTitle: Adaptive 6.25–40 Gb/s downstream rate using four-band OFDM channels within 10 GHz bandwidth for long-reach PON access
abstract: We propose an adaptive 6.25 to 40 Gb/s long-reach passive-optical-network (LR-PON) using four-band orthogonal-frequency-division-multiplexing (OFDM) signals with 10-GHz bandwidth depending on the different fiber transmission lengths of 20 and 100 km.

articleTitle: Routing and spectrum assignment by means of ant colony optimization in flexible bandwidth networks
abstract: We propose a dynamic ACO-based routing and spectrum assignment algorithm in the flexible bandwidth optical networks. Simulation results show that the novel strategy achieves a lower blocking probability with high adaptability to the traffic rate variation.

articleTitle: CAPEX study for grid dependent multi-layer IP/MPLS-over-EON using relative BV-WSS costs
abstract: The impact of the frequency grid on the CAPEX required to deploy a multi-layer IP/MPLS-over-EON is analyzed. Results showing significant savings at the electronic layer motivate the introduction of narrower grids with enhanced BV-WSS.

articleTitle: Pre-distortion method for intra-channel nonlinearity compensation with phase-rotated perturbation term
abstract: With proper phase rotation on perturbation terms, the enhanced intra-channel nonlinearity pre-distortion was proposed and demonstrated. The experiment shows that 1dB improvement is achieved and the performance is even better than back-propagation for RZ format.

articleTitle: A compact, high-optical-coupling-efficiency transceiver with lens-integrated optical devices and high-capacity 25-Gbps/ch × 12-ch flexible waveguides
abstract: A compact optical low-power (9 mW/Gbps) transceiver with lens integrated devices and 12-ch flexible waveguides for optical interconnects was developed. It provides high optical-coupling efficiency and large tolerances (>-2.5 dB and >+/-15 μm) and demonstrated 25-Gbps/ch error-free transmission.

articleTitle: A cognitive system for fast Quality of Transmission estimation in core optical networks
abstract: A cognitive system is proposed to quickly estimate the Quality of Transmission (QoT) of lightpaths in optical networks. It achieves more than 99% successful classifications of lightpaths into high or low QoT categories.

articleTitle: Accumulation rate of inter and intra-channel nonlinear distortions in uncompensated 100G PDM-QPSK systems
abstract: We show how intra- and inter-channel nonlinear distortions in uncompensated WDM systems accumulate at different rates with distance, explaining the difference in tolerance to the Kerr effect for a wide range of systems.

articleTitle: Silicon-based 2×2 colorless wavelength selective switch for optical interconnect application
abstract: We demonstrate a 4-channel 2×2 colorless WSS with channel spacing of 20nm, the total transmission loss of ~10dB, power consumption of ~2.5mW, and switching time of ~006μs. High-throughput data transmission of 80Gb/s is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Analytical PDF of decision statistic for coherent MPSK with electronic dispersion equalization
abstract: We extend previous analytical models for the decision statistic PDF of coherent MPSK with electronic dispersion compensation to include power law phase recovery; previous analysis used a phase estimate giving pessimistic bit error rate predictions.

articleTitle: The use of wavefront encoding to reduce crosstalk in a multicasting fiber telecom switch
abstract: A multicasting fiber optic switch employing a liquid crystal on silicon spatial light modulator is used to demonstrate wavefront encoding, a novel technique for crosstalk mitigation. Experimentally we reduce worst case crosstalk by 7.5dB.

articleTitle: Integrated optical buffer using InP 1×8 switch and silica-based delay line circuit
abstract: We demonstrate a compact optical buffer module, comprising an InP 1×8 phased-array switch and a silica-based delay line circuit. Tunable and uniform buffering of up to 21 ns is obtained with a 3-ns temporal resolution.

articleTitle: Stable generation of coherent and flattened optical frequency-locked multi-carriers using only cascaded phase modulators driven by asynchronous sinusoidal sources
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel scheme to generate a large number of flattened optical subcarriers at low insertion loss using only cascaded phase modulators driven by different frequencies asynchronous sinusoidal sources for Tb/s communication.

articleTitle: Narrow linewidth discrete mode laser diodes for advanced modulation formats
abstract: We report on discrete mode laser diodes with narrow linewidth and show comparable performance to an external cavity laser in a QPSK setup at baud rates as low as 2.5 Gbaud.

articleTitle: Electro-optic polymer modulators
abstract: Electro-optic polymer modulators are an exciting technology that offer many benefits compared to alternative modulator technologies. In this paper we discuss recent advances in polymer modulator technology and their implication to current and future optical networks. Current research efforts into high bandwidth modulators, >;100GHz, are also summarized.

articleTitle: Reduction of crosstalk by hole-walled multi-core fibers
abstract: Hole-walled multi-core fibers (HW-MCFs) are proposed to reduce the crosstalk with arrayed holes walling. We have fabricated a HW-MCF with an effective area larger than 130 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and crosstalk of less than -30 dB/100 km.

articleTitle: Advanced optical monitoring technologies for passive optical network architecture and the future
abstract: This paper describes optical fiber cable monitoring technologies employing advanced fiber measurement, and layer relation management employing operation and measurement in PON, and also discusses frame-loss-free line switching for a highly reliable communication network.

articleTitle: Demonstration of GMPLS-controlled device power management for next generation green optical networks
abstract: We propose GMPLS protocol enhancements enabling dynamic power state management of optoelectronic network devices for setup-time-aware differentiated connection provisioning. Daily energy savings of 56% are demonstrated in a Pan-European-like network compared to always on scenarios.

articleTitle: Offset RZ pulse shape for 128 Gb/s PDM-QPSK subject to aggressive filtering
abstract: A filtering-tolerant, offset RZ pulse shape for 128Gb/s PDM-QPSK was proposed for the first time. On a 25GHz grid, 0.8 and 0.2dB OSNR penalties at SD pre-FEC BER limit were experimentally and numerically demonstrated, respectively.

articleTitle: Performance comparison between 980 and 1480 nm pumping for Er3+-doped bismuth fiber amplifiers
abstract: We have carried out the performance comparison between 980 and 1480-nm pumping for bismuth-based EDFAs. 980-nm pumping was observed to provide no NF benefit relative to 1480-nm due to the overall population decrease in the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13/2</sub> state caused by the combination of the pump ESA and the PIQ. 1480 nm was found to be the better considering the signal gain and NF.

articleTitle: Linewidth-tolerant low complexity pilot-aided carrier phase recovery for M-QAM using superscalar parallelization
abstract: A modified superscalar parallelization based phase-locked loop combined with the maximum-likelihood algorithm is proposed. Its high tolerance to laser linewidth is demonstrated both numerically and experimentally.

articleTitle: Low-loss mode coupler for mode-multiplexed transmission in few-mode fiber
abstract: We present a novel low-loss 3-spot mode coupler to selectively address 6 spatial and polarization modes of a few-mode fiber. The coupler is used in a 6×6 MIMO-transmission experiment over a 154-km hybrid span consisting of 129-km depressed-cladding and 25-km graded-index few-mode fiber.

articleTitle: Digital Nyquist WDM for access networks using limited bandwidth reflective semiconductor optical amplifiers
abstract: Digital Nyquist-WDM is experimentally demonstrated using RSOA-based colorless ONUs, providing a 6-fold enhancement of transmission capacity through 25km fiber, and showing digital Nyquist-WDM as promising candidate for cost-effective flexible bandwidth allocation in PONs.

articleTitle: Nodal contention in colorless, directionless ROADMs using traffic growth models
abstract: We study the impact of intra-node contention in colorless, directionless ROADMs under traffic growth conditions. Our results indicate that modular add/drop banks provide blocking performance approaching that of contentionless architectures.

articleTitle: Nonlinearity compensation using very-low complexity backward propagation in dispersion managed links
abstract: Low complexity SPM compensation is experimentally demonstrated in WDM transmission over inhomogeneous dispersion-managed links with and without Raman amplification. Significant performance increase can be achieved with the longest reported backward-propagation step-size of 530 km.

articleTitle: Outage capacity for spliced mode multiplexed multi-mode fiber links
abstract: We investigate numerically the influence of fiber splices to the multiple-input-multiple- output (MIMO) outage capacity in mode multiplexed multi-mode fiber links. The capacity of long-haul transmission systems will be significantly influenced.

articleTitle: Power-efficient transceivers for high-bandwidth, short-reach interconnects
abstract: Coming exa-scale computer systems and next-generation data centers impose extreme demands on transceiver technology to simultaneously achieve high bandwidth in a compact footprint for maximum bandwidth density while minimizing both cost and power.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of mixed formats and bit rates signal allocation for spectrum-flexible optical networking
abstract: We report on an extensive experimental study for adaptive allocation of 16-QAM and QPSK signals inside spectrum flexible heterogeneous superchannel. Physical-layer performance parameters are extracted for use in resource allocation mechanisms of future flexible networks.

articleTitle: Physical-enhanced secure strategy in an OFDM-PON
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a physical layer enhanced OFDM access network based on chaos scrambling. An 8.89-Gb/s 64QAM-OFDM data with Logistic mapped chaos scrambling is transmitted over 25km successfully.

articleTitle: Dependence of optical OFDM transceiver ASIC complexity on FFT size
abstract: We study the effects of the fast Fourier transform size on the performance and power consumption of real-time optical orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) transceivers.

articleTitle: Nonlinearity compensation via spectral inversion and digital back-propagation: A practical approach
abstract: We report performance enhancements enabled by pre-dispersed spectral inversion equivalent to that of ideal back-propagation, with further x2 increase in reach from multi-channel compensation, with spectral inversion employed upto 400km (from mid-link) with <;1dB penalties.

articleTitle: Tunable residual dispersion compensator using generalized MZIs in Silicon-on-Insulator
abstract: A filter using generalized MZIs for tunable residual dispersion compensation is presented. The design, the silicon photonic realization and its characterization are presented. The device can compensate up to ±180ps/nm of residual chromatic dispersion.

articleTitle: Error-free 10-Gb/s, 11.4-km long transmission on 1.3-μm waveband photonic transport system with wavelength tunable quantum dot laser and holey fiber transmission line
abstract: A wavelength tunable quantum dot external-cavity laser and ultra-broadband holey fiber transmission line were developed using novel nano-structured materials for successful demonstration of error-free 10-Gb/s, 11.4-km long transmission on a 1.3-μm waveband photonic transport system.

articleTitle: Chromatic dispersion compensation in regular and bend-insensitive multimode fibers
abstract: We numerically and experimentally validate a new criterion that quantifies how modal dispersion can compensate for chromatic dispersion in specifically designed regular and bend-insensitive multi-mode fibers in 10Gbps serial transmission over more than 400m.

articleTitle: Error-free 10Gb/s duobinary transmission over 215km of SSMF using a hybrid photonic integrated reflective modulator
abstract: We demonstrate a novel hybrid photonic integrated circuit, incorporating reflective electroabsorption modulators, which achieves error-free 10Gb/s duobinary transmission over 215km of standard fiber with similar performance to a commercial lithium niobate duobinary MZM.

articleTitle: 20-Gbps silicon photonic waveguide nested Mach-Zehnder QPSK modulator
abstract: Silicon photonic waveguide nested Mach-Zehnder modulators having rib-waveguide planar P-N junction phase shifters are fabricated and characterized in constellation and transmittance measurements. 20-Gbps QPSK constellation is observed with optical loss lower than 15 dB at wavelengths of 1550 and 1590 nm.

articleTitle: World-wide networking for LHC data processing
abstract: CERN's Large Hadron Collider is producing several Petabytes of physics data per year. We present the network environment used for LHC data processing, and provide outlook into evolution of computing models and networks supporting them.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a self aligned hybrid silicon-plasmonic waveguide with low loss and nanoscale confinement
abstract: We demonstrate self-aligned approach for fabricating hybrid silicon plasmonic waveguide. The demonstrated structure provides nanoscale confinement together with propagation length of 100 microns on chip. Near-field measurements of propagation and coupling loss are presented.

articleTitle: Next generation CFP modules
abstract: The details of two next generation CFP MSA modules, CFP2 and CFP4 are described. This includes size evolution, front panel port density, electrical I/O, mechanics, MIS, power, and support of SMF and MMF applications.

articleTitle: Cost efficient optical FMCW scheme for long range high resolution detection
abstract: High resolution optical network monitoring based on FMCW using a standard DFB laser is presented. By tracking the chirp rate dependent target position the spatial resolution is increased to 5m keeping 100km range.

articleTitle: Generation of spectrally efficient Nyquist-WDM QPSK signals using DSP techniques at transmitter
abstract: We investigate complexity and performance of transmitter DSP for Nyquist-WDM QPSK and show that filters with less than 20 taps can reduce the channel spacing to 1.1 times the symbol rate within a 1-dB penalty.

articleTitle: Core-pumped gain-guided index-antiguided CW fiber laser using dispersion-engineered erbium-doped fiber
abstract: We demonstrate core-pumped gain-guided index-antiguided CW fiber lasers using a 22-cm-long dispersion-engineered erbium-doped fiber with core diameter of 3.2μm. The index of core is higher (lower) than that of cladding at pump (lasing) wavelength, respectively.

articleTitle: Bio-optic gas sensor (Bio-sniffer) for residential formaldehyde (with ppb-level lower sensitivity)
abstract: A bio-optic gas sensor (bio-sniffer) with UV-LED and formaldehyde dehydrogenase (FALDH) for gaseous formaldehyde (FA) was developed and applied for on-site assessment of residential FA. The bio-sniffer measures FA as a fluorescence of reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NADH) which is the product of formaldehyde dehydrogenase reaction. The detection limit of the bio-sniffer for gaseous FA was 2.5 ppb (parts per billion), which is enough lower for the purpose of evaluating residential FA from building materials and furniture. The bio-sniffer was also applied to measure phytoremediation of FA vapor with N. E. “Bostoniensis”. The FA level in the measurement chamber decreased down to the detection limit (2.5 ppb), which is lower level than FA level of room air (12 ppb), within 95 min and the value increased to FA level when the chamber was vented.

articleTitle: Phase entropy-based Frequency Offset Estimation for coherent optical QAM systems
abstract: We investigate a novel approach to Frequency Offset Estimation for coherent optical QAM systems, based on the received symbol phase entropy. It is highly accurate, non-data-aided and oblivious to modulation format.

articleTitle: Energy efficiency in future 40-Gb/s fiber access networks
abstract: This paper compares energy efficiency of 40-Gb/s optical networks that utilize optical amplification, coarse and dense WDM, or electronic switching. We show that using an electronic switch can be over 3 times more energy efficient.

articleTitle: Distributed online RWA considering add/drop contention in the nodes for directionless and colorless ROADMs
abstract: This paper presents an online distributed RWA algorithm that considers the add/drop ports occupation in directionless-colorless ROADMs, to reduce the lightpath blocking. Results support our approach to reduce the number of ROADM transponder banks.

articleTitle: Hybrid compensation of nonlinear effects in coherent optical receivers
abstract: We present performance improvements in nonlinear regime of long-haul transmission systems. In several transmission scenarios based on offline data MLSE, simplified BP, modified NPCC, carrier recovery optimization and combinations thereof show improvement up to 1.8dB.

articleTitle: Next generation ECDM-OFDM based passive optical network with variable spreading factor
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate an ECDM-OFDM-PON with variable spreading factor (VSF), which endues the network with more flexible resource allocation. Bidirectional 9.22-Gb/s ECDM-OFDM signal with VSF are transmitted 75-km fiber successfully.

articleTitle: Si/Ge avalanche photodiode based electrical comb generator for photonic ultra-wideband (UWB) wireless communication with very-high data rate
abstract: We demonstrate novel Si/Ge avalanche photodiodes based electrical comb-line generators, which can directly generate ultra-wideband (10 GHz) comb-lines and short-pulse. By using this device, 1.5Gbps error-free ultra-wideband short-pulse photonic wireless-linking have been successfully achieved.

articleTitle: Economical solutions of the WDM-PON system
abstract: We review recent advances in WDM-PON technologies to realize economical system implementation, and also discuss cost-effective solutions and potential areas of application.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of joint-polarization phase recovery algorithms for dual-polarization 16-QAM transmission
abstract: The concept of joint-polarization phase estimation is experimentally demonstrated in a dual-polarization 7-Gbaud 16-QAM system. Performance improvement using a distributed feedback laser with 2-MHz linewidth as well as narrow linewidth lasers are presented.

articleTitle: Nonlinear compensation study for WDM Transmission using multi-level modulation over transoceanic distance
abstract: WDM Transmission using PDM-8QAM-OFDM and PDM-16QAM-OFDM modulations over 10,181km and 4,242km are successfully demonstrated. Up to 0.5dB Q-factor improvement can be achieved from nonlinearity compensation for self-phase modulation (SPM) using back-propagation method.

articleTitle: Enhanced self-coherent OFDM by the use of injection locked laser
abstract: An injection-locked laser based pilot carrier enhancement technique is proposed for self-coherent OFDM. An improvement of 2.2 dB is observed when compared to Fabry-Perot filter based self-coherent OFDM.

articleTitle: Baud-rate back-propagation for intra-channel nonlinear impairments compensation
abstract: We split each stage of back-propagation into a linear and a nonlinear part in parallel. We show by simulation and experiment that negligible performance degradation is achieved with half implementation complexity by baud-rate nonlinear compensation.

articleTitle: All-optical monolithically integrated differential XOR
abstract: A monolithically integrated InP optical device performing XOR between a bit sequence and one delayed copy (differential XOR) for encryption, scrambling, PRBS generation, and differential modulation format decoding is presented. Operation at 8/16/32Gbs is reported.

articleTitle: 100-Gbit/s amplitude and phase modulation characterization of a single-drive, low-Vπ polymer Mach-Zehnder modulator
abstract: A polymer single-drive Mach-Zehnder modulator is experimentally characterized using 100-Gbit/s serial data modulation. BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> is achieved for both 100-Gbit/s NRZ-OOK and NRZ-DPSK signals without optical or electrical equalization. The modulator shows a 7-dB bandwidth at 110-GHz and the chirp as low as -0.0219 GHz. © 2012 Optical Society of America.

articleTitle: 160 Gb/s silicon all-optical data modulator based on cross phase modulation
abstract: We have demonstrated 160 Gb/s all-optical data modulation with an extinction ratio of 18.5 dB based on XPM in a silicon nanowire. Error free performance is achieved for the optically modulated 160 Gb/s signal.

articleTitle: Energy saving strategies for VCSEL ONUs
abstract: The energy savings of 10 Gb/s VCSEL ONUs in sleep/doze mode operations is critically analyzed as function of polling cycle, network load, and upstream access. Results provide guidance on specific energy saving mode to maximize energy savings throughout the day.

articleTitle: Joint PDL and in-band OSNR monitoring supported by data-aided channel estimation
abstract: Employing a known training sequence robust and precise PDL and OSNR monitoring is demonstrated over a wide range of combined distortions. The proposed in-service monitoring technique is insensitive to CD, PMD and SOP rotation.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable optical 8-ary transmitter based on arbitrary 2-QAM for generating 8PSK and 8QAM
abstract: Arbitrary 2-QAM is proposed and experimentally demonstrated using an under-driven IQ modulator. By cascading a standard QPSK modulator and a constant-amplitude or non-constant-amplitude 2-QAM, an optical 8PSK or 8QAM could be synthesized, respectively.

articleTitle: Energy efficiency of optical IP protocol suites
abstract: An energy efficiency metric is defined for network node protocol suites. The metric is used to provide a comparison of several common suites. Certain protocol suite implementations incur a significant energy efficiency penalty.

articleTitle: Real-time services in EPON
abstract: This paper proposes an improved scheduling algorithm that optimizes the allocation of the real-time services and elastic flows in EPON by spreading the real-time service periods lowering the delay and thus fulfilling the QoS requirements.

articleTitle: Network interoperability trial with multi-vendor OTU4 interfaces carrying 100 Gigabit Ethernet signals
abstract: OTN based network interoperability field trial was demonstrated for OTU4 interface carrying 100GE with three system equipment and one test equipment vendors. This is the first report of interoperability with OTU4 data plane technology.

articleTitle: Optically cross-braced hypercube: A reconfigurable physical layer for interconnects and server-centric datacenters
abstract: Our proposal is to gradually deploy 2×2 optical switches to hypercubes planes in order to decrease about 15% of transit traffic processing for bidirectional physical connections and over 20% forwarding traffic in unidirectional links.

articleTitle: 112-Gb/s transmission over 100m of graded-index plastic optical fiber for optical data center applications
abstract: 100G transmission over GI-POF is demonstrated by using 112-Gb/s PolMux-QPSK modulation and digital coherent detection. The transmission distance over 100m and simplified coupling method is suitable for optical data-center applications.

articleTitle: Reliability and scalability of access networks with ladder structure
abstract: We analyze the failure rate and unavailability of redundant access network models, and show that hybrid WDM/TDM-PON architectures can significantly improve their unavailability in large scale regions and enable increased capacity per fiber.

articleTitle: 34 Gb/s PDM-QPSK coherent receiver using SiGe ADCs and a single FPGA for digital signal processing
abstract: A fully reprogrammable coherent receiver using an integrated coherent front end, four high speed ADCs and powerful FPGAs is reported and tested against optical noise level, chromatic dispersion and PMD for various equalizer filter length.

articleTitle: Plasmonic waveguides: Challenges and opportunities
abstract: Main configurations of plasmonic waveguides are overviewed discussing fundamental challenges in trading between the lateral mode confinement and propagation losses. Recent developments and promising opportunities for practical applications of plasmonic waveguides are also outlined.

articleTitle: Spectrum, cost and energy efficiency in fixed-grid and flex-grid networks
abstract: Single and multi-carrier networks offering channel rates up to 400Gb/s are evaluated under realistic reach parameters. It is found that efficient spectrum utilization and fine bit-rate granularity are essential to achieve cost and energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Laser generation with a microstructured Er3+-doped tellurite optical fiber
abstract: We fabricate a microstructured Erbium-doped tellurite fiber and demonstrate laser emission. A simple double-pump configuration (980 nm) is used. A 5 cm fiber generates a laser at 1553.3 nm with an OSNR of ∼21 dB.

articleTitle: Performance of decision-aided maximum-likelihood carrier phase estimation with frequency offset
abstract: Adaptive decision-aided maximum-likelihood (DA ML) carrier phase estimation (PE) is shown to be more robust to frequency offset, with better frequency-offset and laser-linewidth tolerance compared to conventional DA ML carrier PE.

articleTitle: OTDM-to-WDM conversion of complex modulation formats by time-domain optical Fourier transformation
abstract: We demonstrate the utilization of the optical Fourier transform technique for serial-to-parallel conversion of 64×10-GBd OTDM data tributaries with complex modulation formats into 50-GHz DWDM grid without loss of phase and amplitude information.

articleTitle: Wavelength self-initialization of tunable laser employing wavelength recognition using power difference in WDM-PONs
abstract: We proposed a simple method to initialize the wavelength of tunable laser in WDM-PON employing wavelength recognition using power difference method and accomplished plug & play function. We confirmed the feasibility of our proposed method.

articleTitle: 10-Gbps OFDM upstream rate by using RSOA-ONU with seeding-light for 75 km long-reach PON access
abstract: We first develop and investigate the 10 Gb/s upstream traffic using RSOA-based ONU and OFDM-QAM modulation via a larger injection power of seeding light for long-reach PON after 75 km fiber transmission.

articleTitle: Restoration design with selective optical bypass in IP-over-optical networks
abstract: We propose a multi-layer restoration scheme that strategically selects a subset of IP links to be restored at the optical layer with the rest being restored at the IP layer, resulting in significant cost savings.

articleTitle: Noise performance of an eight-sideband parametric mixer
abstract: Noise performance of an eight-sideband mixer seeded by two continuous-wave pumps was measured and compared with two- and four-sideband parametric devices. We show that the noise-figure of a free-running mixer grows with increasing sideband number.

articleTitle: Multi-hop dynamic routing in an integrated 4×4 space and wavelength select cross-connect
abstract: We demonstrate the first dynamic routing through an integrated 4×4 space and wavelength cross-connect. Multipath routing through all four wavelength selective switches is presented employing multiple hops. Switching speed of less than 2ns is measured.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 40 GHz analog-to-digital conversion using copy-and-sample-all parametric processing
abstract: We present the result of an optical analog-to-digital conversion front-end based on the copy-and sample-all principle for the first time. The new architecture uses self-seeded multicasting and polychromatic sampling. Operation at 40 GHz and 6 ENOBs is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Constrained LMS phase noise estimation algorithm for coherent optical M-QAM intradyne receivers
abstract: We analyze and optimize the performance of a single-tap constrained decision-directed least-mean square algorithm for computationally-efficient phase noise estimation in coherent optical intradyne receivers intended for the detection of arbitrary M-QAM constellations.

articleTitle: Limitation of fiber nonlinearity compensation using digital back propagation in the presence of PMD
abstract: Limitation of digital back propagation under the influence of polarization mode dispersion is investigated. For 1-THz bandwidth systems, the Q factor improvement is reduced from 10.9 to 1.5 dB by introducing PMD of 0.05 ps/√km.

articleTitle: Multiplier-free carrier phase estimation for low complexity carrier frequency and phase recovery
abstract: Carrier phase estimation for QPSK modulation is demonstrated using only real-valued additions without any multiplication or angle computation. Based on simulation and offline data, the same performance as the widely considered 4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup>-power algorithm is reached.

articleTitle: On the use of DFB lasers for coherent PON
abstract: Some of the proposed NG-PON2 architectures encompass coherent receivers. In this scenario, we investigate the use of commercial DFB lasers, rather than more expensive ECL, showing negligible penalty for 40 Gbps PM-QPSK.

articleTitle: Low-voltage, low-loss, multi-Gb/s silicon micro-ring modulator based on a MOS capacitor
abstract: Optical modulation with 8dB extinction ratio and 3dB insertion loss is achieved by applying a 1.5-V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pp</sub> drive voltage to a 10-μm ring with embedded MOS capacitor. Open-eye diagrams are obtained at 3Gbps.

articleTitle: Development of a novel all-optical fiber isolator using a CdSe quantum dots doped optical fiber
abstract: A novel all-optical fiber isolator with 14 dB isolation at 660 nm was developed by using a CdSe quantum dots doped optical fiber of 183 cm length at magnetic field of 0.1 T.

articleTitle: Liquid crystal phase shifter on the SOH platform with ultra-low power consumption
abstract: A silicon phase shifter with V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</sub> L = 0.085 Vmm and nW-power consumption is demonstrated. The device exploits slot-waveguides filled with liquid crystals. A drive voltage of 5 V leads to a 35 π phase shift.

articleTitle: Cost, power and performance analysis of WDM-PON systems based on reflective transmitters for next-generation optical access
abstract: WDM-PON systems based on reflective transmitters for next-generation optical access are compared in terms of cost, power and performance.

articleTitle: Low complexity and high capacity transmission in the 1310 nm transmission window
abstract: 8×40 Gbit/s transmission over 38 km of SSMF at 1310 nm is successfully demonstrated. The results unequivocally indicate that the 1310 nm transmission window can support the cost-effective and high capacity connections over short/medium distances.

articleTitle: Spectrally efficient WDM-PON employing multi-wavelength coherent detection with wavelength-swept local light
abstract: We propose a spectrally efficient upstream configuration for WDM-PONs where multi-wavelength channels are demodulated using a single coherent receiver by periodically shifting the local light wavelength. The feasibility is confirmed based on a 2 × 1.5-Gbit/s WDM experiment.

articleTitle: Optically interconnected data center networks
abstract: Optical switching shows great promise for the future intra data center network (DCN) interconnection applications. The network benefits of optical circuit switching for DCN applications are discussed, and recent work on optical switching-based DCN is reviewed.

articleTitle: An optical burst switching fabric of multi-granularity for Petabits/s multi-chassis switches and routers
abstract: A multi-granularity optical burst switch fabric with 80M×80M(M=2, 4, 8…) ports using Fast Tunable Lasers and ULCF-AWG is proposed. This fabric for Petabits/s multi-chassis switches and routers is also experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Quantifying the impact of DWDM nodes with flexible add/drop port utilization for dynamic connection setup
abstract: DWDM transport networks are evolving towards dynamic setup/rerouting of optical connections. This paper quantifies the impact of optical node architecture and traffic variability on the network blocking probability and transponder count requirements.

articleTitle: On the impact of backreflections in a bidirectional 10 Gbit/s coherent WDM-PON
abstract: The impact of backreflections on receiver sensitivity in a bidirectional coherent WDM-PON is investigated. Channel spacing is swept from 4 GHz to 30 GHz using 3.125 GBaud PDM-QPSK channels.

articleTitle: Traffic grooming in WDM mesh networks with loop-free paths
abstract: A solution framework for the traffic grooming problem with physical loop-free end-to-end paths is proposed and its impacts in terms of network resource efficiency and installation cost is analyzed.

articleTitle: Results from the OASE project
abstract: A collection of slides from author's conference presentation is given. Requirements ; Support of 20 to 40 km passive reach option for the working path ; Support of 60 to 90 km extended reach option for the protection path (preferably passive) ; Support of 256 up to 1024 ONUs per feeder fiber ; Support of redundancy and protection mechanism for service availability and to guarantee that a certain failure penetration range will not be exceeded ; NGOA system has to work on the existing first mile infrastructure (single fiber solution) ; NGOA system does not affect the deployed system and the existing spectrum.

articleTitle: Horizontal Cu/SiO2/Si/SiO2/Cu plasmonic waveguide components integrated in silicon photonic circuits
abstract: We report experimental realization of various Cu/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/Si/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/Cu plasmonic waveguide based building blocks, including low loss (~0.28 dB/Lim) waveguides, low loss (~0.52 dB/turn) bends, power splitters, and Mach-Zehnder interferometers with ER of ~18.7 dB. This is a significant step toward plasmonic nanocircuits on the Si platform.

articleTitle: Bandwidth for next generation IP MPLS backbones
abstract: As AT&T plans our next generation router networks, our requirements for bandwidth, in addition to scale, include information and decision integration in the L1 and L3 control plane for efficiency, flexibility, reliability and speed. AT&T has one of the world's largest and most powerful IP MPLS backbones. Our network is our brand, so as we look to leverage our network to improve our customer's experience, the integrated role of bandwidth and optical technology in building that network is critical to our success. AT&T is focused on the next generation of capabilities, including even higher capacity and scale (of course!), but also more intelligent capabilities through dynamic real-time sharing of knowledge between the optical and IP MPLS networks that improve service connectivity and restoration, while continuously lowering costs by improving fill. The most efficient and capable IP MPLS network is one in which the optical and IP MPLS layers are working together in unison as the “database of record” to make intelligent decisions regarding path selection, reliability, latency, and on demand scale.

articleTitle: Ultimate reach 10Gbps dispersion-compensation-free WDM-TDM-OCDMA-PON: Experimental demonstration and theoretical validation
abstract: 100km long-reach 10Gps dispersion-compensation-free 2-wavelength × 2-time-slot × 4-code WDM-TDM-OCDMA-PON using only a pair of multiport en/decoder is experimentally demonstrated. The simulation results of the OCDMA transmission system validates the feasibility of the extended reach.

articleTitle: Metal-cavity nanolasers
abstract: We demonstrated the operation of metal-cavity microlasers and nanoLEDs flip-chip bonded to silicon under electrical injection at room temperature. The work represents significant progress bridging the gap between nanophotonics and silicon electronics.

articleTitle: Fourier domain mode locking laser for enhanced sweeping range based on dispersion-shifted fiber
abstract: A Fourier domain mode locking laser with dispersion management at long-wavelength band is investigated. Sweeping bandwidth and obtained OCT axial resolution compared with the case without dispersion control is enhanced by 33% and 30%, respectively.

articleTitle: 40 km fiber transmission of time domain multiplexed MIMO RF signals for RoF-DAS over WDM-PON
abstract: We report the 40 km fiber transmission of MIMO RF signals with time domain multiplexing for RoF-DAS over WDM-PON architecture. No transmission degradation is observed over 12-dB optical received power range.

articleTitle: Protection scheme for passive optical networks shared between a fixed and a mobile operator
abstract: A protection scheme for passive optical networks (PONs) is proposed. It supports partial protection, relevant when reusing existing PON infrastructure for LTE-Advanced mobile network backhaul. We provide a protection level and cost analysis.

articleTitle: LCOS-based gridless wavelength blocker array for broadband signals at 100Gbps and beyond
abstract: We demonstrate a gridless wavelength blocker array for advanced broadband signals, which is characterized by ultra-wide passband and sub-GHz frequency control. The 0.5dB-passband and frequency setting resolution for 50-GHz systems are 40 GHz and 0.2 GHz, respectively.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of symmetrical 10 Gb/s WDM/TDM-PON with respect to different downstream signal extinction ratios
abstract: The performance characteristics of symmetrical 10 Gb/s WDM/TDM PON system based on an RSOA-EAM colourless ONU are extracted under different downstream signal ER operating conditions and for various transmission distances.

articleTitle: Compact PM-HNLF module with increased SBS threshold having −29 dB polarization crosstalk
abstract: SBS threshold of PM-HNLF is increased by 4.5 dB due to longitudinal distribution of GeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> concentration. The 200 m long PM-HNLF is packaged into a credit card sized module with polarization crosstalk of -29 dB.

articleTitle: Optical injection-locking-based pump recovery for phase-sensitively amplified links
abstract: An injection-locking-based pump recovery system for phase-sensitively amplified links is proposed and studied experimentally. Measurements with 10 Gbaud DQPSK signals show penalty-free recovery of 0.8 GHz FWHM bandwidth pump with 63 dB overall amplification.

articleTitle: Investigation on the ENOB and clipping effect of real ADC and AGC in coherent QAM transmission system
abstract: The roles of ADC ENOB and AGC clipping effect are investigated in coherent QAM optical transmission system by experiments and simulations, under different transmission effects. Potential implementation risks and optimization for AGC and ADC are presented.

articleTitle: Simultaneous demultiplexing of OTDM channels based on swept-pump fiber-optical parametric amplifier
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate simultaneous demultiplexing of 80-Gb/s OTDM signal by transforming it into WDM idlers (spaced by 1.15 nm), based on a swept-pump fiber-optical parametric amplifier (FOPA), and ~10-dB parametric gain is achieved.

articleTitle: Technology progress of high-speed burst-mode 3R receiver for PON applications
abstract: We review the recent technology progress of high-speed burst-mode 3R receiver suitable for next-generation TDM-PON systems. The essence of dual-rate optical receiver with fast settling function and over-sampling based CDR for 10G-EPON are also presented.

articleTitle: Planar fiber packaging method for silicon photonic integrated circuits
abstract: A novel method for fiber packaging silicon waveguides is presented. The process uses angled fibers and capillary action of UV-cure epoxy. The technique is suited to passive alignment and can be scaled for fiber arrays.

articleTitle: Performance monitoring and measurement techniques for coherent systems
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: Stokes space works; polarization state tracking; CD/PMD; Kalman filtering; carrier phase tracking; polarization state tracking; PMD estimation; EVM; and signal quality.

articleTitle: Single-shot photonic time-intensity integration with high processing speed over nanosecond time windows
abstract: We demonstrate photonic temporal intensity integration based on incoherent optical signal processing, with 36.8GHz processing bandwidth and 1.24ns integration time window. Single-shot operation is achieved using a frequency comb incoherent laser source.

articleTitle: A centralized optical monitoring for high capacity TDM-PON based on optical frequency-hopping/periodic code
abstract: A coding scheme of two-dimensional frequency-hopping/periodic code for optical centralized monitoring in high capacity TDM-PON is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. The results show it achieves large code cardinality and small correlation distance.

articleTitle: Generalized weighted crosstalk for DWDM systems with cascaded wavelength-selective switches
abstract: A generalized method for estimating penalties from spectrally-shaped crosstalk in cascaded multi-port WSS networks is derived, incorporating effects of ASE, signal filtering, and crosstalk filtering. Experiments in a 4-WSS cascade validate the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: 10-Gbps single-feeder, full-duplex WDM-PON using directly modulated laser and RSOA
abstract: We demonstrate a cost-effective 10-Gbps symmetric WDM-PON using a single light source over a 20-km single-feeder network. We utilize an RSOA for uplink and a directly modulated laser for both downlink and seed light.

articleTitle: Free-running L-band VCSEL for 1.25 Gbps hybrid radio-fiber cloud optical interconnects
abstract: We demonstrate a free-running directly-modulated 1580 nm VCSEL suitable for hybrid wireless/optical interconnects supporting cloud data centers. Error-free transmission at 1.25 Gbps was achieved after 6.5 GHz wireless link and 1 km bend-insensitive fiber.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of cascaded transmission and all-optical label swapping for a 1.2Tbit/s O-OFDM 16QAM payload and a 12.5Gb/s OOK label
abstract: We demonstrate a network node with two-hop transmission and all-optical label swapping for an O-OFDM 16QAM payload at 1.2Tb/s and an OOK label at 12.5Gb/s. The overall OSNR penalty after label swapping and cascaded transmission is less than 2dB.

articleTitle: Regenerator placement and link capacity optimization in translucent optical networks using a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm
abstract: We present an algorithm to tackle simultaneously the regenerator placement and link capacity optimization problems in translucent optical networks. It can assist a network designer to find a solution that balances cost and performance.

articleTitle: R-SOA based extender for XG-PON/G-PON applications
abstract: Reflective semiconductor optical amplifiers were used in a downstream extender for G-PON and XG-PON applications. The performance of the R-SOA extender was demonstrated in a PON test bed using 1:64 splitter and 64.5 km reach.

articleTitle: A high throughput plasmonic bull's eye aperture and its application to photon sorters
abstract: This study presents a micron-sized bull's eye aperture which plasmonically enhances optical transmission. A nanoantennaring in the device enhances the throughput power as well as damping spectral noise. The proposed aperture has promising applications in photon sorters.

articleTitle: Performance of colorless, non-directional roadms with modular client-side fiber cross-connects
abstract: We study the impact of partitioning client-side fiber cross-connects on the blocking performance of colorless, non-directional ROADM based dynamic optical networks. Simulations show that smaller fiber cross-connects (16×16, 48×48) can achieve low blocking.

articleTitle: Efficient compact tunable laser for access networks using silicon ring resonators
abstract: A compact external-cavity tunable laser using an InP gain chip and a reflector chip containing silicon ring resonators is demonstrated. We obtain more than 5mW output power with tuning across the C-band.

articleTitle: Low resolution distributed measurement of fiber optical parametric amplifiers gain
abstract: Using high power pulsed pump, a simple scheme based on BOTDA is proposed to measure the FOPA gain along the fiber. Employing this technique, gain mapping with 2 meters resolution is reported.

articleTitle: Asynchronous spiking neuron based on four-wave mixing and cross absorption modulation
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an asynchronous photonic neuron using four-wave-mixing in photonic-crystal fiber and cross-absorption-modulation in an electro-absorption-modulator. Our approach enables completely asynchronous-spiking in response to input signals, while maximizing the throughput relative to synchronous approaches.

articleTitle: Longitudinal distribution of generated power in random distributed feedback fiber lasers
abstract: We have measured the longitudinal distribution of the generated power in random distributed feedback Raman fiber laser. Analytic solution as well as numerical simulation provides an excellent agreement with experimental data.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient capacity upgrade in optical networks with mixed line rates
abstract: We investigate the energy-efficient network upgrade problem. The traffic growth in a mixed-line-rate (10/40/100 Gbps) optical network is supported through both non-disruptive and disruptive upgrades, and their cost and energy efficiency are compared.

articleTitle: Ultrafast nonlinear signal processing in silicon waveguides
abstract: We describe recent demonstrations of exploiting highly nonlinear silicon waveguides for ultrafast optical signal processing. We describe wavelength conversion and serial-to-parallel conversion of 640 Gbit/s data signals and 1.28 Tbit/s demultiplexing and all-optical sampling.

articleTitle: Digitized RF-over-fiber technique as an efficient solution for wideband wireless OFDM delivery
abstract: 1-GHz bandwidth OFDM signal at 10-GHz is transmitted error-free using digitized RF-over-fiber with 4-bit ADC resolution and 4-Gbps optical data rate. Better-linearity, longer-distance, lower-received power, and simpler BS are achieved in comparison with analog RoF.

articleTitle: High extinction ratio optical switching independently of temperature with silicon photonic 1 × 8 switch
abstract: We demonstrate high extinction ratio optical switching over 40 dB independently of the temperature in the range from 0°C to 75°C with the 1 × 8 selector switch composed of silicon thermo-optical switch elements.

articleTitle: Programmable filtering devices in next generation ROADM networks
abstract: Programmable filtering devices are being integrated in ROADM systems worldwide. These “Gridless” devices can be reconfigured to support the optimal channel allocation for any network application. The benefits, device requirements, and architectures are detailed.

articleTitle: Employing M-QAM OFDM downlink and remodulated OOK uplink for colorless WDM-PON system with mitigation Rayleigh backscattering effect
abstract: We investigate a new and simple colorless WDM-PON system with mitigation Rayleigh backscattering noise and twice capacity simultaneously, using M-QAM (M = 16, 32 and 64) OFDM downstream and remodulated OOK upstream signals, respectively.
