articleTitle: A novel multi-fault localization mechanism in PCE-based multi-domain large capacity optical transport networks
abstract: A stateful PCE-based multi-link failure localization mechanism using fuzzy fault set is implemented in multi-domain large capacity optical networks. The novel localization mechanism has high scalability, speed and success rate compared with extended LVM protocol.

articleTitle: Scaling of nonlinear impairments in dispersion-uncompensated long-haul transmission
abstract: We experimentally investigate the scaling of nonlinear impairments with distance and spectral efficiency in 40G and 100G dispersion-uncompensated long-haul transmission.

articleTitle: A 40-Gbit/s MMF transmission with 1.3-μm lens-integrated EA/DFB lasers for optical interconnect
abstract: A lens-integrated EA/DFB laser was developed. Stable lasing operation and narrowly focused surface emission were achieved. In addition, 40-Gbit/s, 30-m error-free multimode fiber transmission was successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Sideband-assisted phase sensitive amplifiers with high phase sensitivity for efficient phase regeneration
abstract: We show that sidebands entailed by phase sensitive amplification significantly increase the parametric de-amplification. The resultant gain extinction ratio was 30 dB with less than 22-dBm pump power, which enables an efficient phase regenerator.

articleTitle: Mode coupling effects in multi-mode fibers
abstract: In mode-division-multiplexed systems using coherent detection, strong mode coupling is beneficial. Mode coupling reduces modal dispersion, minimizing signal processing complexity. In combination with modal dispersion, mode coupling creates frequency diversity, mitigating the mode-dependent gain of optical amplifiers.

articleTitle: Mitigation of fiber Bragg grating-induced group-delay ripple in 112 Gbit/s DP-QPSK coherent systems
abstract: We experimentally investigate the fiber-Bragg grating (FBG)-induced group-delay ripple (GDR) mitigation capability of coherent receivers. We also show that 112-Gbit/s DP-QPSK systems with electronic-dispersion compensation (EDC) and FBG-based devices provide similar performances over 840-km transmission.

articleTitle: Black-box phase-sensitive fiber-optic parametric amplifier assisted by a semiconductor optical amplifier
abstract: We realize phase-sensitive regeneration in a highly non-linear fiber for BPSK signals by employing phase-locking which facilitates a semiconductor optical amplifier. The regeneration capability is validated in system experiments with 43-Gb/s NRZ-differential BPSK.

articleTitle: Development of OLT using semiconductor optical amplifiers as booster and preamplifier for loss-budget extension in 10.3-Gb/s PON system
abstract: We developed an OLT, using SOAs as booster and preamplifier for loss-budget extension, with our proposed burst-mode SOA controller for satisfying high sensitivity and wide dynamic range. 10.3-Gb/s transmission with 37.9-dB loss budget was obtained.

articleTitle: Optical RAM cell with dual-wavelength bit input and three SOA XGM switches
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a novel optical static RAM cell that exploits wavelength diversity in the incoming optical streams towards reducing the number of active elements, requiring only three SOA XGM gates for successful Read/Write operation.

articleTitle: Chirp removal from directly modulated laser signals by two-stage fiber cross-phase modulation
abstract: A novel chirp removal method by two-stage fiber cross-phase modulation is proposed and successfully demonstrated for 10/40-Gb/s signals generated by directly modulated laser diodes with over four times extension of transmission distance.

articleTitle: Simultaneous multiple pattern correlation with <1 ns reconfiguration time
abstract: We demonstrate a data pattern correlator for OOK and BPSK signals that can simultaneously search for multiple patterns using optical sampling via wavelength conversion. We show reconfiguration times as low as 100 ps for the search pattern update in the correlator.

articleTitle: 8 × 320-Gb/s transmission over 5600 km using all-ETDM 80-Gbaud polarization multiplexed QPSK transmitter and coherent receiver
abstract: WDM transmission over 5600 km of ultra-large-area fiber is achieved using an 80-Gbaud all-electronically multiplexed polarization-division multiplexed quadrature phase-shift-keyed (PDM-QPSK) transmitter and off-line intradyne detection with four synchronized 120-GSamples/s, 45-GHz inputs of an oscilloscope prototype.

articleTitle: Photonics generation of phase-modulated RF pulses with carrier frequency agility for software-defined coherent radars
abstract: An innovative optical scheme generates software-defined phase-modulated RF pulses with carrier frequency agility from a mode-locked laser. Results show chirped pulses at 10 or 40GHz in a single setup, with phase-stability suitable for coherent radars.

articleTitle: 20-Gb/s adaptively modulated optical OFDM transmission over 20-km single fiber loopback WDM PON based on separated I/Q baseband delivery using 1 GHz RSOAs
abstract: 20-Gb/s optical OFDM transmission with separated I/Q baseband delivery over 20-km single fiber loopback link was demonstrated using remotely-fed 1-GHz RSOAs in WDM-PON. Adaptive loading algorithm without Hermitian Symmetry was applied to optimize the performance.

articleTitle: Dual Reach Extender based on optical amplification for G-PON and symmetrical 10G-PON systems
abstract: Performances of a symmetrical 10G-PON prototype are explained and a Reach Extender for both G-PON and 10G-PON systems based on only two SOA is proposed.

articleTitle: PICs for next-generation optical access systems
abstract: Photonic integrated circuits (PICs) provide an attractive solution to the challenges of complexity, size and power dissipation in next-generation access systems. This paper reviews the requirements for next-generation systems based on wavelength division multiplexing in passive optical networks (WDM-PON) and assesses steps towards PIC implementation.

articleTitle: PICs in PONs
abstract: The use of photonic integrated circuits (PICs) expands the universe of possibilities for both present and future passive optical networks (PONs). This paper reviews present technologies and predicts future impacts.

articleTitle: A cost-effective scheme of high-radix optical burst switch based on fast tunable lasers and cyclic AWG
abstract: This paper proposes a new scheme using single N×N cyclic AWG and fast tunable lasers to realize a high-radix kN×kN optical burst switch, which is cost-effective compared with kN×kN AWG and cascaded N×N AWGs schemes.

articleTitle: First experimental demonstration of real-time optical OFDMA PONs with colorless ONUs and adaptive DBA
abstract: End-to-end real-time 10.375 Gb/s optical OFDMA PONs with adaptive DBA and colorless ONUs utilizing RSOA intensity modulators are experimentally demonstrated, for the first time, in 26.4 km IMDD architectures. The identified minimum ONU wavelength spacing is 0.15 nm.

articleTitle: Development of multi-fiber low friction optical indoor cable for mid-span branching
abstract: Multi-fiber low friction optical indoor cable which is the most suitable for a vertical trunk line cable in MDUs or subscriber's premises, has been newly developed. Its unique cable structure enables easy mid-span branching.

articleTitle: Impact of intra-domain information in GMPLS-based WSONs with hierarchical PCE
abstract: This paper first shows that Hierarchical PCE is a scalable and effective solution applicable in large multi-domain WSONs. Then, three schemes are proposed for understanding the impact of intra-domain information provided to the Parent PCE.

articleTitle: Thermodynamic aspects of erbium doped fiber amplifiers
abstract: This paper shows analogies between rare-earth doped fiber amplifiers and some thermodynamic systems and presents thermodynamic macroscopic and microscopic models for evaluating energy conversion efficiency and flow of energy and entropy in erbium doped fibers.

articleTitle: Survivable green optical backbone networks with shared path protection
abstract: We propose a novel energy-efficient and survivable routing algorithm addressing the trade-off caused by conflicting objectives of energy saving and survivability, i.e. energy-efficient routing tends to pack while survivable strategies try to spread the traffic.

articleTitle: Widely tunable SOA-based OTDR employing a cost-effective source configuration
abstract: We describe an SOA-based tunable pulsed optical source employing a novel topology, which provides pulses of variable duration and rapid rise time for OTDR measurements. Applications to spectral attenuation and CD characterization are illustrated.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient demand provisioning in the cloud
abstract: In this paper, we propose optimized provisioning models to guarantee minimum energy consumption of Internet and cloud services where high performance data centers are located at the core nodes of an IP-over-WDM network.

articleTitle: Investigation of bandwidth dependence on chromatic and model dispersion in MMF links using VCSELs
abstract: The interaction between modal and chromatic dispersion is modeled and experiments predict that significant improvements in the channel performance can be achieved by matching the mode dispersion to the spectral characteristic of the VCSELs.

articleTitle: CMOS photonics for optical engines and interconnects
abstract: In this contribution the CMOS photonics technology (LuxG) developed and commercialized by Luxtera is reviewed. The advantages of integration and usage of a standard CMOS foundry toolset/process/practice are discussed with mention to a newly developed 14Gbps transceiver chip.

articleTitle: Distributed coherent optical OFDM multiplexing using fiber frequency conversion and free-running lasers
abstract: We propose a concept for distributed coherent optical orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing by fiber-frequency conversion for locally-defined exact channel mapping based on free-running lasers. Experiments with quadrature phase-shift keying and 16-quadrature-amplitude modulation subchannels show error-free performance.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated VOA-MUX with power monitors based on submicron silicon photonics platform
abstract: We present a monolithically integrated silicon-photonics VOA-MUX (variable optical attenuators with multiplexing filters) with power monitors. Submicron waveguides results in a compact chip size of 5mm × 4mm with a fast 3dB response of 23MHz.

articleTitle: Polarization-multiplexed 32QAM and 16PSK signaling with coherent receiver using digital-delay detection
abstract: Application of digital-delay detection to considerably higher-order coherent multilevel signaling is verified by 100-Gbit/s PM-32QAM and 80-Gbit/s PM-16PSK transmission experiments with low implementation penalty, and their laser linewidth and IF-frequency offset tolerance is also shown.

articleTitle: Polarization effects in coherent systems
abstract: Relevant polarization effects in coherent systems include polarization mode dispersion, polarization dependent loss, and polarization transients. This paper reviews coherent receivers' tolerances to these impairments and discusses recent field measurements of PDL and polarization transients.

articleTitle: Hybrid 40-Gb/s and 100-Gb/s PDM-QPSK DWDM transmission using real-time DSP in field testbed
abstract: We demonstrate hybrid 40-Gb/s and 100-Gb/s PDM-QPSK DWDM transmission using real-time DSP in 580-km DSF-installed field testbed. The nonlinear crosstalk penalty due to the hybrid transmission of less than 0.5 dB is confirmed.

articleTitle: Nonlinear tolerant long-haul WDM transmission over 1200km using 538Gb/s/ch PDM-64QAM SC-FDM signals with pilot tone
abstract: We investigate long-haul WDM transmission using 538Gb/s PDM-64QAM single-carrier frequency-division-multiplexing (SC-FDM) signal with pilot tone. Assuming 20% FEC overhead, the longest transmission distance of 1200km at the spectral efficiency of 8.96b/s/Hz is achieved.

articleTitle: Performance of AWGR-based optical interconnects with contention resolution based on all-optical NACKs
abstract: This paper analyzes a 10Gb/s 64×64 optical interconnect switch exploiting an all-optical NACK technique. Simulations show that this switch architecture supports high throughput and low-latency even at 0.85 load in contrast to the flattened-butterfly architecture.

articleTitle: Polarization demultiplexing using linearly-estimated channel matrix in PDM systems with MIMO processing
abstract: We propose a polarization demultiplexing using linearly-estimated channel matrix for faster polarization tracking. Through experiments, we confirm that the proposed method can enhance tolerance of SOP change compared with demultiplexing using an identical channel matrix.

articleTitle: Applications of phase-sensitive parametric amplification
abstract: A review of recent progress in nonlinear fiber-based phase-sensitive parametric amplifiers is provided. In addition, their potential use as in-line amplifiers, resulting in significant link performance improvement potential, is discussed.

articleTitle: The incorporation of photonic transmitter-mixer with Si/Ge based electrical comb line generator for W-band ultra-wideband (UWB) wireless data transmission
abstract: By combing Si/Ge avalanche photodiodes based electrical comb-line generators with photonic-transmitter-mixers, millimeter-wave short-pulse generations for photonic ultra-wideband linking at W-band with wireless transmission distance up to 12 meter and error-free 1.5Gbps data rate are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Detailed study of modal gain in a multimode EDFA supporting LP01 and LP11 mode group amplification
abstract: We demonstrate simultaneous modal gains of ~20dB for different pair-wise combinations of spatial and polarization modes in a MM-EDFA. The differential modal gains are reduced by fiber design and control of the pump field distribution.

articleTitle: 42.7 Gbit/s RZ-33% wavelength conversion in a chalcogenide microstructured fiber
abstract: We demonstrated error-free four-wave-mixing-based wavelength conversion of a 42.7-Gbit/s RZ-33% signal in a 1-m long GeAsSe chalcogenide microstructured fiber with a total average power of 56 mW.

articleTitle: Comparison of PS-QPSK and PM-QPSK at different data rates in a 25 GHz-spaced WDM system
abstract: We compare polarization-switched QPSK and polarization-multiplexed QPSK in a WDM system with 25 GHz channel spacing. We investigate experimentally the transmission distance as a function of the data rate for both modulation formats.

articleTitle: A polymeric regenerative optical bus for board-level optical interconnections
abstract: A scalable polymer waveguide-based regenerative optical bus architecture for use in board-level communications is presented. As a proof-of-principle demonstration, a 4-channel polymer bus formed on a FR4 substrate providing 10 Gb/s/channel data transmission is reported.

articleTitle: Experiments on 10Gb/s fast settling high sensitivity burst-mode receiver with on-chip auto-reset for 10G-GPONs
abstract: This paper reports performance tests on a DC-coupled 10Gb/s burst-mode receiver with on-chip reset, designed for 10G-GPONs. Record short 2R settling time, high sensitivity and large loud/soft ratio is demonstrated in burst-mode operations at 2.5G/5G/10Gb/s.

articleTitle: A regenerative variable optical buffer for NRZ and RZ packets
abstract: A re-circulating-loop optical memory exploiting regenerative amplification by cross-gain-compression in a SOA is reported. Hundred circulations with maximum delay of 130μs with 0.5dB power penalty every 10 rounds are obtained with 10Gbps NRZ and RZ-packets.

articleTitle: Optimized design of shared restoration in flexible-grid transparent optical networks
abstract: We propose a novel mathematical model and an efficient heuristic for planning WDM networks with flexible channel-grid and shared restoration. The spectral benefits of this approach versus dedicated protection and fixed channel-grid are highlighted.

articleTitle: Low latency optical services
abstract: Applications are driving optical services to provide higher bandwidth, higher availability, and increasingly lower latency. These requirements conflict with current optical network design. New methods are needed for lower latency for these higher bandwidth services.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable all-optical Discrete Fourier Transform in a wavelength selective switch for optical OFDM demultiplexing
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that a multi-output optical DFT can be implemented using a LCOS-based wavelength-selective switch. This enables high-spectral efficiency OFDM systems to be implemented optically, potentially overcoming limitations in electronic processing.

articleTitle: OFDM remodulation for 10-Gb/s/channel WDM-PON with simple carrier extraction and enhanced tolerance to Rayleigh noise
abstract: A novel OFDM-remodulation scheme for 10-Gb/s/channel WDM-PON is proposed and numerically investigated. Negative remodulation penalty is achieved without using any ultra-narrow filter or coherent detection. 40-km single-fiber bidirectional transmission is confirmed with 7-dB power margin.

articleTitle: In-home networking using optical fiber
abstract: Increased bandwidth requirements for in-home networks create opportunities for optical fiber interconnects. We outline the requirements for in-home networking and discuss the suitability of various optical fiber types to meet them.

articleTitle: Integrated-optic OFDM demultiplexer using multi-mode interference coupler-based optical DFT circuit
abstract: We report a silica-PLC OFDM demultiplexer comprising an N × N multi-mode interference coupler-based DFT circuit. The demultiplexer, which can demultiplex four OFDM sub-carriers simultaneously, is realized and applied to 4 × 10-Gbit/s signal demultiplexing.

articleTitle: Efficient traffic grooming through node clustering
abstract: The effect of traffic grooming, when employing the CANON architecture and its impact on performance and cost are evaluated using a national backbone network as a case study.

articleTitle: Optically demultiplexed orthogonal wavelength division multiplexing for terabit networking systems
abstract: We investigated the fundamental limits of an optical processing technique that enables instantaneous demultiplexing of orthogonal-wavelength-division-multiplexing in terabit optical networking systems without requiring conventional guard-band.

articleTitle: Multi-excitation of spatial modes using single spatial light modulator for mode division multiplexing
abstract: With the goal of establishing mode division multiplexing techniques, we performed experiments on the multi-excitation of spatial modes by combining first-order diffracted beams generated from hologram patterns indicated in different regions using a single SLM.

articleTitle: Rearrangeable hybrid optical and packet system for adaptive power consumption control
abstract: This paper proposes a rearrangeable hybrid optical and packet system that changes its internal configuration to optimize packet forwarding capacities and to reduce the entire system power consumption in response to network traffic patterns.

articleTitle: Optimized provisioning of 100-GbE services over OTN based on shared protection with collocated signal regeneration and differential delay compensation
abstract: The combined use of shared protection with distributed differential delay compensation is proposed to cost-efficiently deploy virtually-concatenated services over optical transport networks. The results highlight the significant link capacity and regenerator count savings attained.

articleTitle: Dynamic optical path switching of 172-Gbit/s OTDM ultra-high definition video signals using fast channel-identifiable clock recovery and integratable devices
abstract: Dynamic optical switching was first demonstrated in 172-Gbit/s OTDM transmissions of real ultra-high definition video signals, using truly in-band clock distribution with channel identification and newly developed CMOS-based transceivers, quantum-dot SOAs, monolithic ISBT all-optical gate.

articleTitle: Network virtualization: A tutorial
abstract: This paper is a tutorial, which discusses reference model; architectural principles and objectives of network virtualization. Network virtualization projects, challenges and future directions are also discussed.

articleTitle: A novel optical networking scheme utilizing coarse granular optical routing and fine granular add/drop
abstract: We propose a novel network architecture that exploits coarse granular routing while add/drop operations are done at wavelength granularity. Node architecture and the network design algorithm are introduced. Numerical results verify its cost efficacy.

articleTitle: High-order QAM transmission for spectrally-efficient and high-capacity transport
abstract: High-order QAM offers the high spectral efficiency and high capacity. PDM-64QAM with single-carrier frequency-division-multiplexing (SC-FDM) enhanced by pilot-tone-based phase noise compensation is proposed and shown to achieve high-capacity transport with 400Gb/s-class high speed channels.

articleTitle: First demonstration of cooler-less, bi-directional, format-agnostic, wireless and gigabit ethernet network provision using off-the-shelf VCSELs
abstract: We used cooler-less, directly-modulated, commercially-available, 1345.6 nm and 1541.9 nm VCSELs to deliver bi-directional, co-existing UWB, WiMAX, LTE and GbE capacity over 20.6 km of SSMF. Error-free GbE supported 65 nm SiCMOS 60 GHz pico-cell connectivity.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of a hybrid operated MPLS-TP transport network for dynamic Ethernet service provisioning and restoration
abstract: We present a lab Trial to provide Ethernet services over a packet transport network using coordinately operated GMPLS control and management planes to support dynamic provisioning and restoration of MPLS-TP tunnels and pseudowires.

articleTitle: 400 Gbit/s frequency-division-multiplexed and polarization-multiplexed 256 QAM-OFDM transmission over 400 km with a spectral efficiency of 14 bit/s/Hz
abstract: We demonstrate a 400-Gbit/s frequency-division-multiplexed and polarization-multiplexed OFDM transmission over 400 km (5×80 km SSMF) with 256 QAM subcarrier modulation using an optical PLL. A record spectral efficiency of 14 bit/s/Hz was successfully achieved.

articleTitle: Full MAC system demonstration of extended 10G-EPON uplink with 512 ONU splits access span via burst-mode SOA and enhanced-FEC combined with burst-mode 3R
abstract: This first Extended 10G-EPON uplink system test achieved the largest access span loss of 37 dB supporting 512 ONU splits over 25 km with an enlarged loss budget of 51.2 dB via wide linear gain region burst-mode SOA, RS(255, 223) E-FEC and burst-mode 3R.

articleTitle: Integrated wire grid polarizer and plasmonic polarization beam splitter
abstract: An ultra-compact, low loss, high extinction ratio polarization beam splitter is proposed for the SOI platform The device is 3.5 um in length and provides more than 11 dB extinction ratio with less than 1 dB plasmonic losses.

articleTitle: Automatic discovery of fiber optic structured cabling component locations and connectivity
abstract: The use of RFID tags integrated into fiber optic structured cabling components enables network operators to automatically discover and track the location and connectivity of their cabling infrastructure in real time. A laboratory feasibility demonstration focused on data center applications illustrates the potential capabilities.

articleTitle: Small form factor thin film polymer modulators for telecom applications
abstract: 40Gbps Small form factor thin film polymer on silicon (TFPS) EO modulators have been presented. The TFPS modulators have a small size, low Vπ, broad bandwidth and zero chirp, which are desirable for telecom applications.

articleTitle: High power single mode output low threshold current photonic crystal vertical cavity surface emitting lasers
abstract: A scheme of reducing oxide aperture diameter to match the central defect region of the photonic crystal in PhC-VCSEL was investigated in both theory and experiment in order to get low threshold current and high single-fundamental-mode output devices.

articleTitle: Contact force sensor based on microfiber Bragg grating
abstract: We demonstrate a miniature contact force sensor based on a 30-μm diameter microfiber Bragg grating packaged with a conforming elastomer material features extremely high sensitivity up to 0.8-mN to contract force.

articleTitle: Parametric Asynchronous Eye Diagram for Optical Performance Monitoring
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the novel Parametric Asynchronous Eye Diagram (PAED) applicable to Optical Performance Monitoring. Parametric Asynchronous Eye Diagram uses samples of the signal and samples of the derivative of the signal to construct a diagram similar in shape and behavior to the Synchronous Eye Diagram. This diagram allows to identify separately the impact of Chromatic Dispersion (CD), Differential Group Delay (DGD) and Optical Signal to Noise Ratio (OSNR). The technique is completely independent of the modulation format, and bit rate.

articleTitle: 320-to-40-Gb/s optical demultiplexing by means of optical filtering of chirped signal using a quantum-dot SOA
abstract: We demonstrated ultrahigh-speed optical demultiplexing using optical filtering of chirped signal induced by a quantum-dot semiconductor optical amplifier. Using a simple scheme, we successfully achieved error-free operations of 320-to-40-Gb/s demultiplexing.

articleTitle: Developments on a submarine neutrino sensor-based network
abstract: We present the deep sea permanent infrastructures of neutrino telescopes in operation (ANTARES offshore of Toulon, France) and under design (KM3NeT in the Mediterranean Sea), with focus on the submarine optical network used for real time data transfers and detector control.

articleTitle: Add-drop filters in silicon grating-assisted asymmetrie couplers
abstract: We demonstrate narrow-bandwidth (<; 1 nm) contradirectional couplers in silicon sidewall-modulated strip waveguides and slab-modulated rib waveguides, using a CMOS-compatible technology. They have box-like responses, low insertion losses, and no need of a circulator or isolator.

articleTitle: Auto discovery for optimizing the connection set up time in network restoration for OFDMA-PONs
abstract: Three ONU auto-discovery schemes are proposed to reestablish connections between ONUs and OLT in network failure restoration for OFDMA-PONs. Simulation is conducted to compare the performances of these schemes.

articleTitle: Survivability self-management in GMPLS controlled packet optical networks
abstract: In a multi-technology network, we propose a method to leave the recovery scheme selection to the path computation stage. Operators can specify resiliency in terms of needs rather than in terms of the involved technologies.

articleTitle: Equalization performance in the presence of linear polarization impairments
abstract: We show that in the presence of PDL, the performance of single carrier polarization multiplexed systems using standard equalization methods with reasonable complexity, improves significantly when large values of PMD are introduced intentionally into the link.

articleTitle: First demonstration of dispersion limit improvement at 20 Gb/s with a Dual Electro-absorption Modulated Laser
abstract: The Dual Electro-absorption Modulated Laser (D-EML) is a transmitter technology based on integrated Electro-absorption Modulated Laser (EML) with dual independent-access modulation. The D-EML allows the adjustment of the laser and modulator chirp by controlling the amplitude modulation in order to enhance the transmission distance without increasing consumption, cost and complexity. We successfully demonstrate experimentally and by simulation an error-free 39.7-km transmission at 20 Gb/s in standard dispersion fiber without any compensation fiber using D-EML.

articleTitle: Capacity and outage of multimode fiber with statistical bends
abstract: Information capacity of a group delay spread minimized MMF carrying 15 spatial modes is calculated taking into account limited inter mode group coupling of statistical fiber bends and their attenuation of higher order modes.

articleTitle: A simple alignment technique for consolidated tri-state multi-rate burst-mode DPSK transmitters
abstract: We demonstrate an average-power-based technique for aligning data and clock signals in consolidated tri-state multi-rate burst-mode DPSK transmitters with a simple and low-SWaP implementation.

articleTitle: Quantum information processing in the telecom waveband
abstract: We present recent progress in all-optical routing of entangled single photons at high speeds, with minimal loss and added in-band noise, and-most importantly-without disturbing the photons' quantum state.

articleTitle: Tunable all-optical pre-compensation of fiber Kerr effect on multi-format DPSK signals using a nonlinearity module
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical pre-compensation of the fiber Kerr-effect on 40 Gb/s signals using a negative nonlinearity module. Tunable compensation for different DPSK formats, fiber spans and WDM channels achieves up to ≈4 dB lower BER power penalty.

articleTitle: A silicon platform for high-speed photonics systems
abstract: We present a silicon photonic platform that offers monolithically integrated silicon modulators and germanium photodetectors with sufficient device bandwidth (>19 GHz) to support 25 Gb/s data channels. Cross-wafer uniformity and yield data are included.

articleTitle: A comparison of approaches for ultra-low-loss waveguides
abstract: We compare ultra-low-loss silica waveguides with PECVD SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, borophosphosilicate glass (BPSG), and wafer-bonded thermal oxide upper claddings. We demonstrate fiber-like (0.045 dB/m) total propagation loss in planar waveguides with bonded thermal oxide upper claddings.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable optical fiber-based microwave dispersive line for single-shot chirped microwave pulse compression
abstract: A fiber-based approach for reconfigurable and single-shot chirped microwave pulse compression is proposed and demonstrated based on a time-spectrum convolution system. Different nanosecond-long, GHz-bandwidth linearly chirped microwave pulses are successfully compressed using the same platform.

articleTitle: Graphene-based optical modulators
abstract: The optical loss of graphene can be tuned by shifting its Fermi level. We demonstrated that this tuning can be used for in a high-speed optical modulator at telecommunication wavelength.

articleTitle: An ultra-flat frequency comb generated using nonlinear broadening and adaptive pulse shaping
abstract: We present the nonlinear generation of ultra-flat broadband spectra suited to high capacity communication signals. A spectrum covering the full C-band (3-dB bandwidth of 35nm) is generated in an adaptable and power-efficient fashion.

articleTitle: Fiber optical CATV transport systems based on PM and light injection-locked DFB LD as a duplex transceiver
abstract: A bidirectional optical CATV transport system is proposed with an assistant of frequency-upconversion technique and a phase-modulation scheme to optimize transmission performance as well as an injection-locked DFB LD to work as a duplex transceiver.

articleTitle: Extended-reach 10G/1G-EPON over 80 km and 1024 Split with optical amplifier-based hybrid repeater
abstract: We propose a hybrid all-optical repeater for 10G/1G-EPON mixed bit-rate upstream link. Through a bidirectional transmission experiments, we successfully achieved a total loss budget of 62.1 dB which corresponds to 80km reach and 1024 split.

articleTitle: Full-duplex 20/10 Gb/s WDM-PON with remodulation of chirped ASK and multi-level quaternary PAM and OFDM
abstract: A full-duplex 20/10Gb/s WDM-PON is demonstrated by all-optical carrier recovery technique, showing that it is efficient and flexible for being applied to different downstream signals as non-/chirped ASK or multilevel signals as 4-PAM or OFDM.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient bandwidth allocation in optical OFDM-based data center networks
abstract: This paper presents two bandwidth assignments algorithms for an optical OFDM-based data center network. The proposed scheme can provide up to 95% bandwidth utilization and 14% lower power consumption compared to a WDM-based network.

articleTitle: Tunable laser for 40GPON ONU transmitter
abstract: Three-section tunable laser operating at 2.5Gb/s is shown to be a good candidate for the ONU transmitter in a hybrid 40G G-PON system. Successful transmission over 40kM links is experimentally confirmed, with tunability over four channels.

articleTitle: Lambda switched future photonic network development
abstract: High spectral efficiency DWDM transmission and flexgrid technologies are evaluated as upgrades of future lambda switched networks. A capacity limit of the order of 320 Tbit/s is calculated together with parameters for flexgrid optimization.

articleTitle: Improving network scalability using OCDMA over OTDM
abstract: We analyze and present a field demonstration of an incoherent OCDMA over OTDMA system. The performance analysis shows significant scalability improvement without any significant system performance degradation.

articleTitle: Nanolasers directly grown on Si
abstract: We report a completely new growth mode with which single crystalline InGaAs/GaAs nanopillars can be grown directly on silicon substrates at CMOS compatible temperature. Light emitting diodes, photovoltaic device and optically pumped lasers are achieved.

articleTitle: A perspective from Europe on in-home networking
abstract: Delivery of wirebound and wireless services can be integrated in a single cost-efficient in-home POF network, when using advanced signal modulation techniques. In larger buildings, dynamic capacity allocation by wavelength routing improves the network performance.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact Si-photonic DQPSK demodulator
abstract: We propose an ultra-compact DQPSK demodulator based on silicon nano-photonics using a polarization diversity approach. Using interleaved delay-line interferometers, a low polarization dependent frequency shift of 0.5 GHz has been obtained.

articleTitle: Femtosecond pulse shaping based on a wavelength-selective directional coupler
abstract: Femtosecond pulse shaping capabilities of wavelength-selective directional couplers are evaluated for the first time. Different practically relevant optical pulses, e.g., femtosecond Hermite-Gaussian, parabolic and flat-top pulses, can be generated from feasible, simple integrated/fiber devices.

articleTitle: Survivable green optical backbone networks with shared path protection
abstract: We propose a novel energy-efficient and survivable routing algorithm addressing the trade-off caused by conflicting objectives of energy saving and survivability, i.e. energy-efficient routing tends to pack while survivable strategies try to spread the traffic.

articleTitle: Cost-effective and scalable architecture for moving cell application employing integrable tunable laser assembly
abstract: We propose a cost-effective, scalable architecture to provide high-speed connection to trains by moving-cells employing tunable lasers in the CO and passive add/drop multiplexers in the field. The architecture is demonstrated with bidirectional OFDM signals.

articleTitle: 640 Gbaud NRZ-OOK data signal generation and 1.19 Tbit/s PDM-NRZ-OOK field trial transmission
abstract: We demonstrate a field trial of a 640-Gbaud NRZ signal generated by RZ-to-NRZ conversion of a phase-coherent RZ-OTDM signal. This is employed in a 1.19-Tbit/s PDM-NRZ-OOK field transmission with BER<; 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> for all 128 tributaries.

articleTitle: Latest developments of 40G silicon photonics active devices
abstract: High performance generic building blocks will be reviewed such as 1OdBm sources by III-V/Si heterogeneous integration, 40G Si modulators, and 100GHz Ge detectors. Different scenari for integrating photonic with an electronic chip will be addressed.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of adaptive combinational QoT failure restoration in flexible bandwidth networks
abstract: We propose and demonstrate an adaptive quality of transmission restoration scheme combining methods of lightpath rerouting and modulation format switching to combat real-time impairments in flexible bandwidth networks. Testbed demonstration achieved error-free performance.

articleTitle: Compact and large capacity identification device for uniquely addressing optical components
abstract: We describe a new optical identification device consisting of a superimposed FBG with sixteen different Bragg wavelengths. We demonstrate the remote reading of optical identification devices installed at different positions on the same optical path.

articleTitle: Finding partially disjoint routes for dual fiber-cut protection on bi-connected networks
abstract: A diverse routing algorithm is introduced to maximize dual fiber-cut protection on bi-connected networks, where each flow have to use two or more partially disjoint backup paths to protect all restorable dual failures.

articleTitle: A simple estimation of XPM and XPolM induced penalties in hybrid OOK-PSK systems
abstract: XPM phase error variance and the related DOP reduction induced by neighbouring OOK channels is analytically estimated. The results may be applied for hybrid PolMux-QPSK -10 GBit/s OOK DWDM-transmission.

articleTitle: Dual-carrier DQPSK based 112 Gb/s signal transmission over 480 km of SMF link carrying 10 Gb/s NRZ channels
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a cost-effective 112 Gb/s optical transceiver based on dual carrier-DQPSK with direct detection. The performances of DC-DQPSK are evaluated by transmitting 112 Gb/s signal over 480 km of SMF link carrying 10 Gb/s NRZ neighboring channels.

articleTitle: Multi-channel phase squeezing in a PPLN-PPLN PSA
abstract: We investigate phase squeezing of up to four signal channels in a non-degenerate phase-sensitive amplifier constructed from periodically-poled-lithium-niobate waveguides and observe that additional channels have little impact the phase squeezing performance.

articleTitle: Equalizer complexity of mode division multiplexed coherent receivers
abstract: We show that OFDM requires the lowest equalizer complexity for crosstalk compensation in a mode-division-multiplexing receiver. For a 2000-km transmission distance and less than 10% OFDM-specific overhead, the modal dispersion must be below 12 ps/km.

articleTitle: 112Gbit/s RF assisted dual-carrier DP-16-QAM in installed and new build WDM applications
abstract: The performance of a 112Gbit/s dual-carrier DP-16-QAM channel in various WDM configurations is characterized. Variations of the dispersion map, ROADM count and system length are experimentally evaluated and compared with numerical simulation.

articleTitle: RF photonic link employing optical phase sensitive amplification
abstract: We present operation of an optical phase-sensitive amplifier (OPSA) in a RF-photonic link for improved link performance. Enhancement of 3.5dB in OIP3 and 2.5dB.Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2/3</sup> in SFDR at net OPSA gain of 5dB is observed.

articleTitle: Wireless BPSK communication Using electrooptic modulation for coherent microwave detection
abstract: We demonstrate a technique for electrooptically phase modulating digital data onto a microwave signal and performing coherent microwave detection and downconversion. The modulated microwave signal is wirelessly transmitted to show its potential in wireless applications.

articleTitle: Amplification characteristics of a multi-core erbium-doped fiber amplifier
abstract: A multi-core erbium-doped fiber amplifier with three cores was demonstrated. By utilizing MC-EDF with low cross-talk of -30dB, two 10-Gbit/s signals were simultaneously amplified with gain of 15dB and power penalty of less than 1dB.

articleTitle: All-optical OOK to 16QAM modulation conversion based on nonlinear optical loop mirror with 1:2 coupler
abstract: All-optical on-off-keying to 16 quadrature amplitude modulation conversion based on cross-phase modulation of nonlinear optical loop mirror with 1:2 coupler configuration is proposed and demonstrated at 10Gs/s both theoretically and experimentally.

articleTitle: Broadband optical processing techniques for ultrabroadband RF
abstract: We discuss research at Purdue University in which ultrafast optical signal processing approaches are adapted for generation, processing, and compression of ultrabroadband RF electrical signals.

articleTitle: High-stability phase-coded RF pulses for coherent radars from a mode-locking laser
abstract: A novel scheme for photonic generation of phase-coded RF signals in coherent radars allows pulse-compression techniques exploiting an optical I/Q modulator, reducing system complexity. Results show superior phase-stability and quadrupled resolution.

articleTitle: Existing PON infrastructure supported hybrid fiber-wireless sensor networks
abstract: We propose a hybrid fiber wireless sensor network based on the existing PON infrastructure. The feasibility of remote sensing and PON convergence is experimentally proven by transmitting direct-sequence spread-spectrum wireless sensing and 2.5Gbps GPON signals.

articleTitle: Raman amplifier module for GPON reach extension
abstract: We describe the design and characterization of the first reported GPON reach extender module based on a commercial Raman platform with automatic laser shutdown for safe operation in fiber access networks.

articleTitle: Variable all-optical buffering for DQPSK packets
abstract: All-optical buffering of 56Gbps DQPSK packets based on a SOA-boosted recirculating fiber loop is demonstrated. The scheme effectiveness is proven by BER measurements for a maximum delay of 25μs. Crosstalk impairment is also investigated.

articleTitle: Routing, wavelength assignment, and spectrum allocation in wavelength-convertible flexible optical WDM (WC-FWDM) networks
abstract: We investigate the routing, wavelength assignment, and spectrum allocation problem in WC-FWDM networks for the first time. The benefits of full, limited, sparse, and limited range wavelength conversion capabilities are evaluated in WC-FWDM networks.

articleTitle: Comparison of DSB and SSB transmission for OFDM-PON
abstract: We demonstrate that the power penalty induced by fiber dispersion can be negligible for DSB OFDM-PON by employing higher order modulation, lower RF carrier and allocating subcarriers dynamically according to the power penalty.

articleTitle: All-optical selective wavelength shifter for phase signals up to 40 Gb/s in a single SOA-MZI
abstract: Simultaneous wavelength conversion and data erasing of a burst of DPSK data under an optical gate is demonstrated in a single SOA-MZI. Error-free operation with low power penalty is reported at 10 and 40 Gb/s.

articleTitle: A 40-Gbps OFDM LR-PON system over 100-km fiber employing an economical 10-GHz-based transceiver
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a superior performance of at least 40-Gbps OFDM-signal transmission over 20~100-km long-reach PONs, which is achieved by using a 10-GHz EAM and direct detection, and adopting the bit-loading algorithm.

articleTitle: Cord identification technique using higher order guiding modes of visible light for ultra-low bending loss fibers
abstract: A cord identification technique is proposed using visible light for ultra-low bending loss fiber. We employed an offset launch technique to excite higher order modes, and achieved a sensitivity improvement of more than 10 dB.

articleTitle: Design and evaluation of highly reliable silica-LiNbO3 hybrid modulators for advanced formats
abstract: Silica/LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> hybrid integration enables us to realize compact and low-loss optical modulators for advanced formats. We propose a hybrid modulator design to mitigate the difference between the thermal expansion of a silicon substrate and LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, and report the evaluation results.

articleTitle: Experimental evaluation of coded modulation for a coherent PDM system with high spectral efficiency
abstract: We experimentally evaluate the performance of optimized constellation labelings together with soft-FEC decoding using low-density parity-check codes in a coherent burst-mode PDM system with spectral efficiency of 12 bit/channel use.

articleTitle: Crosstalk optimization of phase masks for mode multiplexing in few mode fibers
abstract: We show the design optimization of phase masks for mode conversion and subsequent mode division multiplexing/de-multiplexing. We focus on optimization of mask resolution and offset tolerance to minimize mode power crosstalk.

articleTitle: Impact of energy consumption on the OpEx of WDM networks
abstract: The contribution of the energy consumption on the operational costs of the WDM layer of two network architectures is evaluated. Results show that energy consumption does not determine the operational expenditures of the optical layer.

articleTitle: Individual loss distribution measurement in 4-branched PON using pulsed pump-probe Brillouin gain analysis
abstract: We present a novel fault location technique for PONs that employs Brillouin gain analysis. We describe the measurement of 4-branched optical fibers in a PON with a spatial resolution of 10 m.

articleTitle: Electro-optically tunable switches with 100GHz flat-top passband and 45dB extinction ratio using silicon high-order coupled-microring resonators for optical interconnects
abstract: We demonstrate electro-optically tunable switches using coupled-microrings on silicon-on-insulator, which show flat-top passbands with ~100GHz bandwidth and ~45dB extinction ratio. We show simultaneous switching of 20Gbit/s signal transmissions in 10 channels with 1.9/1.4ns switching times.

articleTitle: Limitless range quantum communications: Steps towards a solid state quantum repeater
abstract: We present a quantum repeater scheme based on a single quantum-dot spin in an optical microcavity. The spin-cavity unit performs deterministic Bell-state analysis with heralded memory allowing loss free repeater operation.

articleTitle: Overcoming electronic limits to optical phase measurements with an optical phase-only amplifier
abstract: We utilize four wave mixing to precisely multiply the modulation depth of a phase encoded signal, demonstrating 3-extra effective bits of resolution at 32GHz. The technique enables a new class of optical signal processing functions.

articleTitle: Short efficient non-adiabatic spot-size converters by mode interference in silicon-on-insulator waveguides
abstract: 4 μm long spot-size converters for coupling to single-mode silicon-on-insulator wire waveguides with losses of ~0.8 dB are demonstrated. The efficiency is maximized by mode interference and exceeds that of linear tapers with equivalent lengths.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of subband switching functionality on optical OFDM superchannel
abstract: Optical OFDM superchannel has been proposed for high-speed optical transmission system, which consists of multiple individual-modulated OFDM subbands. We experimentally demonstrate OFDM subband switching functionality with a frequency spacing of 10-GHz.

articleTitle: 1200km Transmission of 50GHz spaced, 5×504-Gb/s PDM-32-64 hybrid QAM using electrical and optical spectral shaping
abstract: Employing time-domain hybrid QAM and electrical and optical shaping, we successfully transmitted five 504Gbits/s PDM-32/64QAM DWDM signals at 8.4b/s/Hz net spectral efficiency (SE) over a record 12×100km reach (for WDM SE>4b/s/Hz) and one 50GHz-grid ROADM.

articleTitle: Parametric preprocessing in high-capacity transmission links
abstract: The role of low complexity, high-rate photonics preprocessors in high-capacity coherent optical links is discussed. Combined digitization and demultiplexing function is identified as the core application of the new technology.

articleTitle: High-speed directly modulated lasers
abstract: A collection of slides from the author's conference presentation is given. The topics discussed are: direct modulation of semiconductor lasers; frequency response of semiconductor lasers; and high-speed direct modulation.

articleTitle: Evolutions of a Pan-European network over TrueWave-RS fiber enabled by flexible grid and coherent detection
abstract: We investigate possible evolutions of an optical backbone over TrueWave-RS. Maximum inter-capital capacity is obtained with fixed-grid 50-GHz spaced DP-QPSK 100G wavelengths when the interplay between spectral efficiency and XPM is considered.

articleTitle: 150 Gbit/s real-time Nyquist pulse transmission Over 150 km SSMF enhanced by DSP with dynamic precision
abstract: A real-time optical Nyquist pulse transmitter generates 150 Gbit/s PDM-64QAM data with 12 bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency. A 64-tap FIR pulse shaper improves the BER by adjusting the DSP accuracy dynamically from 6 to 11 bit.

articleTitle: Design principles in the Open Compute Project
abstract: The Open Compute Project aims to capture the best principles in datacenter design and open them for third-party implementation and discussion. This paper summarizes them in the areas of electrical, thermal, building, and server design.

articleTitle: Routing of 2Gb/s wireless IR-UWB and 1.25Gb/s wired services for in-building networks
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, simultaneous routing of wireless 2 Gb/s IR-UWB and 1.25 Gb/s wired services using XGM-SOA. This technique has potential applications for integration of wireless and wired services for in-building networks.

articleTitle: Tunable group delay staircases for generation of WDM pulse bursts from short optical pulses
abstract: We demonstrate tunable GD staircases by cascading a narrowband TODC and continuous CD systems. The TODC compresses a significant fraction of the narrowband TODC FSR, resulting in transform limited pulse bursts distinguished by wavelength.

articleTitle: Active plasmonics for optical interconnects
abstract: An overview of plasmonic approaches for achieving ultrasubwavelength guiding and manipulation of optical signals will be presented. Generation, detection, amplification and modulation of plasmonic signals in the integrated circuitry will be discussed.

articleTitle: Photonic generation, wireless transmission, and detection of continuously tunable chirped millimeter-wave waveforms with ultra-high compression ratio at W-band
abstract: By using fast-sweeping fiber distributed Bragg reflector lasers and wideband/high-power photonic transmitter-mixers at W-band, continuously tunable chirped millimeter-wave waveforms generation, wireless transmission, and detection with record-high compression ratio (89-103 GHz/50μs/7×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>) can be achieved.

articleTitle: Wide-band error-free wavelength conversion based on continuous-wave-triggered supercontinuum
abstract: We demonstrate a wavelength converter based on CW-triggered picosecond supercontinuum (SC), with significantly enhanced spectrum over 300-nm. While error-free operations are obtained for wavelength converted signals from 1510 to 1615 nm.

articleTitle: Mitigation of dispersion-induced power fading in long-haul analog optical link based on 2-Ch phase modulator
abstract: A dispersion compensation approach based on a 2-Ch PM is proposed. The experiment results show that, owing to the compensation scheme, the dispersion-induced power fading is greatly mitigated and the system SFDR is also improved.

articleTitle: Higher-order-mode erbium-doped fiber amplifiers
abstract: Higher order modes for large-mode-area, high power fiber amplifiers are reviewed. Results from amplification of both CW and nanosecond pulsed signals in Er-doped HOM fibers with effective areas as large as 4000 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> are presented.

articleTitle: 100G upgrade over legacy submarine dispersion-managed fiber link using fiber nonlinearity compensation and maximum likelihood sequence estimation
abstract: The maximum transmission reach of 127 Gb/s DP-QPSK over legacy DMF link is extended to 4,800 km with 7.4 dB Q-factor using hybrid nonlinearity compensation and maximum likelihood sequence estimation, amounting to ~37% distance increase.

articleTitle: Cost-effective transceiver technologies for high-bandwidth optical interconnection in high-end server systems
abstract: We have developed cost-effective technologies for optical transceivers with over 10-Gb/s operations in high bandwidth interconnection. These include optical engines on flexible printed circuit and 25Gb/s operation with pre-emphasis overdrive of conventional VCSEL for 10Gb/s.

articleTitle: Optically synchronized MIMO interconnects for 3D HPC memory access systems using radio-over-fiber technology
abstract: A novel analog MIMO multiplexing scheme is proposed to realize a low-latency MIMO subsystem for a paradigm-shift 3D large-memory interconnect architecture. System complexity, latency, and throughput are greatly improved by radio-over-fiber synchronization.

articleTitle: Low-latency photonic packet switches with a large number of ports
abstract: Optical packet switches that introduce little latency, scale to large port-count and handles high-bit rate data might find their use in future computing systems. We discus technology that lead to such optical switching systems.

articleTitle: First field demonstration of fault resilience in a regional undersea OADM network
abstract: For the first time an actual deployed regional OADM network is used to study the impact of cable cuts. It is shown that OADM networks can be designed to provide resilience to cable cuts.

articleTitle: Advances in solid core photonic bandgap fiber amplifiers
abstract: We present recent development of photonic crystal fiber amplifiers containing photonic bandgap structures for enhanced spectral and modal filtering functionality.

articleTitle: Self-coherent single wavelength SC-FDMA PON uplink for NG-PON2
abstract: A realistic uplink FDMA scenario for NG-PON2 is demonstrated with low speed electronics in the ONU (500 MHz) and high per wavelength aggregate capacity (12 to 15 Gbps). Stability over field deployed fiber is proven.

articleTitle: Coherent 40Gb/s OFDMA-PON for long-reach (100+ km) high-split ratio (>1:64) optical access/metro networks
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the first coherent 40Gb/s OFDMA-PON over 100km and 130km straight SSMF with 1:128 and 1:64 passive splits, respectively. By satisfying heterogeneous reach/split requirements, the approach addresses key aspects of optical access/metro convergence.

articleTitle: Evolutions of a pan-european network over truewave-RS fiber enabled by flexible grid and coherent detection
abstract: We investigate possible evolutions of an optical backbone over TrueWave-RS. Maximum inter-capital capacity is obtained with fixed-grid 50-GHz spaced DP-QPSK 100G wavelengths when the interplay between spectral efficiency and XPM is considered.

articleTitle: LC connector with enhanced mechanical durability evaluated by nutation test method
abstract: We propose a new LC connector configuration to enhance mechanical durability, and uses a nutation test method to estimate the mechanical endurance of a fiber cable when an optical fiber is pulled obliquely.

articleTitle: Optical grooming in OFDM-based elastic optical networks
abstract: We propose a novel optical grooming approach to aggregate and distribute traffic directly at the optical level in OFDM-based elastic optical networks. Significant transmitter and spectrum saving is achieved compared to non-grooming scenario.

articleTitle: Evaluations of different optical path add/drop ratio restriction schemes on OXC hardware scale and network resource requirement
abstract: We analyzed three different kinds of add/drop ratio restriction schemes for reducing OXC hardware scale and network resource requirements. Numerical experiments clarify the degree of effectiveness of each restriction.

articleTitle: 160Gbaud/s to 40Gbaud/s OTDM-DQPSK de-multiplex based on a dual parallel Mach-Zehnder modulator
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time 160Gbaud to 40Gbaud phase-preserving demultiplex of OTDM-DQPSK signals using a dual parallel Mach-Zehnder modulator(DPMZM) driven by only one electrical clock. Error-free operation is achieved with ~0.6 dB power penalty.

articleTitle: Outage capacity for spliced mode multiplexed multi-mode fiber links
abstract: We investigate numerically the influence of fiber splices to the multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) outage capacity in mode multiplexed multi-mode fiber links. The capacity of long-haul transmission systems will be significantly influenced.

articleTitle: On the energy-efficiency of a packet-level FEC based bufferless core optical network
abstract: We proposed packet-level forward error correction (FEC) as a promising technique for enabling bufferless core optical networks. In this paper, we systematically analyse its energy-efficiency and show that it can produce substantial power savings.

articleTitle: Comparison of various bandwidth-efficient LDPC coding schemes for Tb/s superchannel long-haul transmission
abstract: We compare the transmission performance of various bandwidth-efficient LDPC coding schemes. Equipped with 4 dB improvement in OSNR sensitivity, we demonstrate 1 Tb/s CO-OFDM over 1600 km SSMF transmission at spectral efficiency of 3.2 bit/s/Hz.

articleTitle: Virtual optical network composition over single-line-rate and mixed-line-rate WDM optical networks
abstract: Novel impairment and cost aware optical network virtualization mechanisms are investigated over single-line-rate and mixed-line-rate optical networks. Fundamental challenges are addressed by the proposed virtual optical network composition mechanisms utilizing optimization algorithms.

articleTitle: A sideband interrogation method for precise measurement of resonance frequency difference between interferometers
abstract: A novel sideband interrogation method was developed for precise measurement of resonance frequency difference between interferometers. Frequency resolution better than 29 kHz was experimentally demonstrated with a pair of fiber Fabry-Perot interferometers.

articleTitle: Effective single reflection peak from large diameter microfiber Bragg gratings
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated that the taper length of larger diameter microfibers can be controlled to filter out the higher order modes of LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0N</sub> to cladding mode to obtain a single reflection peak.

articleTitle: 480 Gb/s WDM (12×40 Gb/s) data transmission over a dielectric-loaded plasmonic waveguide
abstract: We demonstrate 480 Gb/s (12 × 40 Gb/s) WDM enabled data transmission through a dielectric loaded plasmonic waveguide. Error-free performance with power penalties ranging between 0.2-1 dB has been obtained for six out of the twelve channels.

articleTitle: 10Gbit/s bias-free and error-free all-optical NRZ-OOK to RZ-OOK format conversion using a III-V-on-silicon microdisk resonator
abstract: We report the experimental demonstration of an all-optical, bias free and error-free (biterror-rate ~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup>), 10Gbit/s non-return-to-zero (NRZ) to return-to-zero (RZ) data format conversion in a 7.5μm diameter III-V microdisk integrated on top of a silicon-on-insulator (SOI) waveguide circuit.

articleTitle: 64 × 43 Gb/s unrepeatered transmission over 468 km using PDM-RZ BPSK with 33 GHz spacing
abstract: Unrepeatered transmission of 64 × 43 Gb/s PDM-RZ-BPSK channels, spaced by 33 GHz is realized over a record distance of 468 km of low loss and large effective area fiber using a high power booster and a remote amplifier.

articleTitle: Ultra low power 10- to 25-Gb/s CMOS-driven VCSEL links
abstract: Two optical links sharing a TX but using different RXs explore the speed/power/area tradeoff. Circuits are 90nm CMOS. Record full-link power efficiencies of 1.37pJ/bit at 15Gb/s and 3.6pJ/bit at 25Gb/s are achieved.

articleTitle: Future computing architectures enabled by optical and nanophotonic interconnects
abstract: Integrated CMOS nanophotonics will significantly impact the design of large scale computer systems. By enabling high bandwidth, high radix router components, more flexible, programmable and power efficient computer systems can be developed.

articleTitle: Energy efficient all-optical arbitration in optical Network-on-Chip
abstract: We propose an all-optical arbitration architecture to resolve end-point contention in the optical networks-on-chip. The proposed architecture reduces on-chip optical power and energy losses by 37% and 21%, respectively, compared to Corona's token-based control plane.

articleTitle: Elastic spectrum allocation for variable traffic in flexible-grid optical networks
abstract: We focus on lightpath adaptation under variable traffic demands in flexible-grid optical networks. Specifically, we study three different adaptation schemes for the variable spectrum allocation. Illustrative numerical results show the benefits of the schemes.

articleTitle: Highly bendable and effectively single-mode all-solid photonic bandgap fiber with large effective area
abstract: Highly bendable large-mode-area all-solid photonic bandgap fibers for high-power fiber lasers are reported. A 712-μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> effective area, effectively single-mode operation, and bending loss of less than 0.1 dB/m at a 10-cm bending radius are achieved.

articleTitle: A novel virtual node migration approach to survive a substrate link failure
abstract: A virtual network mapping approach to protect against a link failure by allowing virtual nodes to migrate among their primary locations only is proposed and shown to be superior to previous approaches.

articleTitle: Transmission of 1.63-Tb/s PDM-16QAM unique-word DFT-spread OFDM signal over 1,010-km SSMF
abstract: We demonstrate transmission of 1.63-Tb/s PDM-16QAM unique-word DFT-spread OFDM signal over 1,010-km SSMF with 80-km span length and EDFA-only amplification. We find a 20 % reach improvement of DFT-spread OFDM over conventional OFDM.

articleTitle: Physical contact connection of single-mode fiber with cleaved and unpolished endface
abstract: The physical contact connection of an SMF with a return loss of more than 50 dB is achieved by using the cleaved fiber endface. The fiber endface requirements and appropriate cleaving conditions are clarified.

articleTitle: Utilization entropy for assessing resource fragmentation in optical networks
abstract: We present a new concept “utilization entropy” which represents the level of resource fragmentation in optical networks. The utilization entropies of a link, a path and a network serve as useful indicators for network optimization.

articleTitle: Knapsack-based drop-and-continue traffic grooming for power and resource efficiency
abstract: We propose a “knapsack grooming” algorithm for drop-and-continue lightpath routing, which not only saves energy, but also optimizes network performance in terms of blocking probability, wavelength-link usage, and bandwidth utilization.

articleTitle: All-optical processing of multi-level phase shift keyed signals
abstract: A technique that allows the all-optical quantization of M-PSK signals using a parametric mixing process is discussed, including recent experimental demonstrations of high baud rate QPSK regeneration, and issues regarding future scalability of the scheme.

articleTitle: Study of fiber nonlinearity impact on the system capacity of two-mode fibers
abstract: We present analysis of the system capacity for two-mode fiber and measurement of its fiber nonlinear coefficients. Despite strong spatial overlapping of three modes, the overall capacity approaches 3 times of that of single-mode fiber.

articleTitle: A 400G/1T high spectral efficiency technology and some enabling subsystems
abstract: We present prospective functions and technologies for the commercialization of optical networks supporting nascent Ethernet rates.

articleTitle: Characterization techniques for installed fibers
abstract: █ Fiber Characterization requirements over the last two decades resulted in a broad range of tools and techniques █ One key driver today for these mature techniques is that a single instrument must provide all essential parameters of a link █ Advanced networks and high-bandwidth signals bring new test requirements… and often the new technologies required for developing the test tools.

articleTitle: Bandwidth and distance dependences of depolarization-induced crosstalk in polarization-multiplexed transmission
abstract: We present an analytical expression of depolarization-induced crosstalk in polarization-multiplexed transmission caused by second-order PMD. The crosstalk depends on the fourth power of the bandwidth and the square of distance. These scalings are confirmed experimentally.

articleTitle: Decision directed least radius distance algorithm for blind equalization in a dual-polarization 16-QAM system
abstract: Robust PMD tolerance and fast pre-convergence speed of decision directed least radius distance algorithm is demonstrated via a 224Gb/s dual-polarization 16-QAM system simulation.

articleTitle: Stochastic virtual infrastructure planning in elastic cloud deploying optical networking
abstract: This paper proposes stochastic planning suitable for elastic clouds deploying optical networking. A novel model employing stochastic traffic considerations for virtualization of the underlying physical resources is proposed and validated achieving significant cost savings.

articleTitle: 21.7 Tb/s field trial with 22 DP-8QAM/QPSK optical superchannels over 1,503-km of installed SSMF
abstract: To the best of our knowledge, this is the highest capacity field trial completed to date at 21.7-Tb/s. 22 optical superchannels with flexible modulation formats were transmitted over 1,503-km installed SSMF using digital coherent detection.

articleTitle: Tuning of an SG-Y branch laser for WDM-PON
abstract: We report wideband tuning and wavelength stabilization of a low-cost SG-Y branch laser without cooler over >;10°C temperature drift by means of a wavelength locker which is shared between all channels in a WDM-PON system.

articleTitle: OTN technology for multi-flow optical transponder in elastic 400G/1T transmission era
abstract: We study the multi-flow optical transponder from the viewpoint of OTN. Rate flexible OTU and multiplexing hierarchy for the elastic network are studied in detail and the required OTN standard extension is elucidated.

articleTitle: 38.2-Gb/s optical-wireless transmission in 75–110 GHz based on electrical OFDM with optical comb expansion
abstract: We demonstrate scalable optical comb- and heterodyning-based generation, optical and 1.3-m wireless transmission, and electrical heterodyne detection of multiband OFDM up to 38.2 Gb/s occupying 14.4-GHz RF bandwidth, for high-capacity optical-wireless links in 75–110 GHz.

articleTitle: All-optical passive periodic sawtooth filter and its application to fast interrogation of fiber Bragg grating sensor array
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a low-cost all-optical passive spectral filter that exhibits a high-resolution periodic sawtooth spectral pattern and its application to fast sensitive interrogation of a fiber Bragg grating sensor array.

articleTitle: Acousto-optic tunable mode coupler
abstract: We designed and implemented a tunable mode coupler based on the acousto-optic effect applied to a multimode tapered optical fiber. Experimental measurements corroborated the theoretical model.

articleTitle: High-speed opto-electronic VOA with an integrated quasi-loss-less photo-diode and a temperature control module
abstract: A unique PMN-PT electro-optic type VOA configuration is proposed. The VOA includes a Peltier element that enables a 100-ns range operation speed and an integrated PD that acts as a quasi-loss-less input tap-monitor.

articleTitle: DWDM transmission of 70 100Gb/s CP-DQPSK channels over 2000km of uncompensated SMF with real-time DSP and coherent channel selection
abstract: We have demonstrated the DWDM transmission of 70 100Gb/s channels using CP-DQPSK and coherent detection with real-time DSP and FEC. The channel selection was performed with the coherent receiver only, without using any optical demultiplexing.

articleTitle: Routing and detection of light on deeply subwavelength scale in two-conductor metallic slot waveguides
abstract: We demonstrate propagation, routing round bends and integrated detection of light on a deeply sub-wavelength scale in two-conductor metallic slot waveguides. Light with cross-section ~ λ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/100 propagates ~10λ at 850nm in good agreement with simulations.

articleTitle: Amplitude noise reduction, pulse format conversion, and wavelength multicast of PSK signal in a fiber optical parametric amplifier
abstract: Using time- and wavelength-interleaved pump pulses in a gain-saturated fiber optical parametric amplifier, we demonstrate amplitude-noise suppressed PSK wavelength multicast with simultaneous NRZ-to-RZ format conversion. The receiver sensitivity is improved by 1.8 and 2.4 dB.

articleTitle: Fiber luminescent solar concentrator fabrics
abstract: We present the design, fabrication, and characterization of all-polymer optical fiber luminescent solar concentrators. Large-area, lightweight, and flexible fabrics constructed of such fibers are a low-cost solar-energy harvesting alternative useful for mobile applications.

articleTitle: Aeff-enlarged pure-silica-core fiber having ring-core profile
abstract: Pure-silica-core fiber with ring-core profile is designed to have the larger ratio of Aeff to MFD than with step-core, and realized Aeff of 135μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and transmission loss of 0.160dB/km with improved splicing loss onto SSMF.

articleTitle: A novel digital coherent receiver for wireless signal
abstract: We propose and characterize a promising digital coherent receiver for analog photonic link architecture based on a novel I/Q-demodulation module. Using the proposed scheme, signal demodulation of QPSK modulated RF carrier is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optically-connected memory with error correction for increased reliability in large-scale computing systems
abstract: We demonstrate an optically-connected memory system with a novel advanced error-correction protocol for improved communication reliability in large-scale computing systems. An emulated microprocessor operates uninterrupted with several optically-connected memory nodes despite multiple memory data errors.

articleTitle: Integrated CMOS compatible low power 10Gbps silicon photonic heater-modulator
abstract: We quantify bit-error performance of a heater-modulator that uses CMOS compatible heater and modulator voltages, occupies 50μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, is compatible with differential signaling and shows consistent extinction ratio under tuning while consuming only 7μW /GHz.

articleTitle: Field trial of a novel non-intrusive method for in-service PMD measurements in fiber-optic networks
abstract: We have tested a non-intrusive PMD measurement method which monitors and analyzes the in-band high-resolution frequency-dependence in the polarization states of traffic signals. The method is applicable to single-polarization optical signals with arbitrary modulation format.

articleTitle: Benefits of router offload utilizing superchannel technology for beyond-100-Gb/s networks
abstract: This paper shows the architecture of a router offloading method utilizing a superchannel signal technology that shows significant savings in energy consumption, compared to a router offloading method utilizing a sub-wavelength switching technology.

articleTitle: Category 3 — FTTx technologies, deployment and applications: NGPON2 — Where are the standards going?
abstract: After pushing standards defining systems offering ~100Mbit/s per user, Operators now aim at offering a sustainable 1Gbit/s capacity. Trends also focus on securing existing plant investments and on improving the global power efficiency as well.

articleTitle: Ultra-long-haul transmission of 16×112 Gb/s spectrally-engineered DAC-generated Nyquist-WDM PM-16QAM channels with 1.05x(symbol-rate) frequency spacing
abstract: Using serial-transmission 112Gb/s PM-16QAM we achieved net SE 7.12 and 6.32 b/s/Hz, and SE(x)distance 13,949 and 23,396 b/s/Hz·km, for 7% and 20.5% FEC overhead, respectively, by means of DAC-enabled spectral engineering, over high-performance PSCF.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of 100-Gbit/s DQPSK data exchange between orbital-angular-momentum modes
abstract: We propose and demonstrate data exchange between two spatial modes carrying orbital-angular-momentum (OAM). Reconfigurable OAM exchange accompanied by 100-Gbit/s DQPSK data exchange is implemented. A total power penalty of less than 2.4 dB is observed at a BER of 1e-9.

articleTitle: Holographic mode generation for mode division multiplexing
abstract: This paper demonstrates how techniques from computational holography can be employed to significantly improve the modal selectivity of phase masks used in mode division multiplexing.

articleTitle: Oversampled digital filter banks simplify and improve signal processing in RGI OFDM receivers
abstract: The recent filter bank based digital sub-banding improves performance and reduces complexity of every aspect of coherent RGI OFDM reception: CD/PMD Equalization, Timing and Carrier recovery, Channel Estimation, Adaptive Tracking, Nonlinear Compensation.

articleTitle: Rate-adaptive four-dimensional nonbinary LDPC-coded modulation for long-haul optical transport networks
abstract: A rate-adaptive four-dimensional nonbinary-LDPC-coded modulation scheme is proposed for high-speed long-haul optical transport networks. Transmission distances range from 5,800 km to 8,900 km at flexible information bit rates beyond 100 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Hardware-efficient polarization demultiplexing for QAM signals based on dual stage decision-directed algorithm
abstract: We propose a hardware-efficient polarization demultiplexing algorithm suitable for QAM signals, which is based on dual decision-directed algorithm. Our algorithm requires only half size hardware of a conventional double stage algorithm based on CMA.

articleTitle: Diverse lightpath protection against correlated and probabilistic failures in multi-domain optical networks
abstract: This paper proposes a distributed lightpath protection scheme for diverse routing in multi-domain optical networks with correlated and probabilistic failures. This novel solution jointly considers traffic engineering and failure risk reduction objectives.

articleTitle: Dense WDM-PON with 23(46) Gb/s/λ D(Q)PSK aggregation in the feeder and micro-ring resonator assisted ONUs
abstract: An aggregation scheme based on a D(Q)PSK/ASK comb transmission in the feeder is presented. A shared delay interferometer allows simple ONUs that are assisted by a ring resonator.

articleTitle: Resonant nonlinear refractive index measurement of optical fiber based on mode coupling using cascaded fiber tapers
abstract: Measurement of resonant nonlinear refractive index (n<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) of optical fiber based on core/cladding mode coupling using cascaded fiber tapers was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Transmission distance improvement employing simple 60GHz radio-over-fiber system with beat noise mitigation
abstract: We propose a simple 60GHz RoF system using a single-electrode MZM with transmission distance improvement from 3km to 10km. With beat noise mitigation algorithm, SNR can be improved by up to 5.5dB.

articleTitle: Distributed and multiplexed optical sensing by synthesis of optical coherence function
abstract: Distributed and multiplexed optical sensing using continuous wave has been developed by synthesis of optical coherence function. The technique has provided mm-order spatial resolution, kHz-order sampling rate, and random-accessibility to arbitrary point along a fiber.

articleTitle: Performance improvement of space-division multiplexed 128-Gb/s PDM-QPSK signals by constructive superposition in a single-input-multiple-output configuration
abstract: We propose digital constructive-superposition to improve the performance of space-division-multiplexed (SDM) signals, and demonstrate a Q<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-factor improvement of 2.2 (3.6) dB by constructively-superimposing 2 (3) SDM copies of a 128-Gb/s PDM-QPSK signal after 2688-km transmission over a seven-core-fiber.

articleTitle: Fiber couplers for silicon-on-insulator photonic IC's with optimized on-chip return loss
abstract: A novel grating coupler design with a high return loss is demonstrated for silicon-on-insulator photonic IC's. The average return loss is around 10 dB better than that of a commonly used focusing grating coupler.

articleTitle: Data transfer for optical interconnectors using long range-SPP transmission lines
abstract: A flexible long range-SPP optical interconnector is developed for the data lines in mobile devices providing high definition video display and recording without seamless. We show the feasibility from polymer material development to system test.

articleTitle: Polymer fiber Bragg gratings for the THz region
abstract: THz fiber Bragg gratings have been inscribed for the first time in polymer fiber using a KrF excimer laser. A transmission loss of 60 dB is observed. Experimental results and modeling are presented.

articleTitle: A 12.5-Gb/s SiGe BiCMOS optical receiver with a monolithically integrated 850-nm avalanche photodetector
abstract: We demonstrate high-performance 850-nm SiGe BiCMOS Opto-Electronic Integrated Circuit (OEIC) receiver with Si avalanche photodetector. With the fabricated OEIC receiver, 12.5-Gb/s optical data are successfully detected with sensitivity of -7.5 dBm.

articleTitle: Impact of out-of-band interferers on MB-OFDM UWB transmission in radio over fiber systems
