abstract: We experimentally investigate the impact of out of band interferers on the performance of multiband OFDM UWB signal transmission in RoF systems. An acceptable EVM and ACPR of -17 dB and -20 dB can be achieved even after shifting by 30% from the optimum quadrature bias. Further improvement of EVM and ACPR can be achieved by using mixed polarization technique even under strong interference level when the bias is shifted near minimum transmission.

articleTitle: Photonics-electronics convergence — Key technology for WDM
abstract: This paper presents wavelength tunability for on-chip WDM in terms of stress engineering, allowing not only wavelength-locking on an uncooled chip but also wavelength reconfigurability for DWDM implementation.

articleTitle: Mode dispersion compensating optical transmission line composed of two-mode optical fibers
abstract: We fabricated mode dispersion compensating optical transmission line composed of two different kinds of two-mode optical fibers with the opposite signs of mode dispersion. Its mode dispersion was successfully controlled within ±700 ps/km at C-band.

articleTitle: Phase-sensitive optical pre-amplifier implemented in an 80km DQPSK link
abstract: We present the first demonstration of a phase-sensitive fiber optic parametric amplifier successfully implemented over an 80 km dispersion managed link. We measure 1.3 dB higher sensitivity with this amplifier system against a comparable conventional EDFA-based link.

articleTitle: G-PON interoperability since 2006 until today
abstract: G-PON interoperability is becoming a reality, a certification program has just been launched during ITU-T Telecom World in October 2011 by Broadband Forum in coordination with ITU-T and FSAN. The goal of the presentation is to describe the different actions that have been necessary to reach that goal. This presentation will also describe how this knowledge will be used to have XG-PON1 interoperability from day one.

articleTitle: Coherent optical long-haul system design
abstract: A collection of slides from the authors' conference presentation was given. The authors discusses the components of coherent transmission system i.e multilevel modulation, polarization division multiplexing/demultiplexing, coherent detection, digital signal processing, and link design. the presentation also gives examples of their recent long-haul experiments.

articleTitle: 7×1.12-Tbit/s, 200-GHz-spaced, PDM-16QAM transmission over all-EDFA 400-km SSMF and 2 ROADMs
abstract: We have successfully demonstrated the first terabit-class WDM transmission (7 × 1.12 Tb/s PDM-16QAM) over all-EDFA 400-km standard single mode fiber (SSMF) and 2 ROADMs. Q factors larger than 9.4 dB are found for all channels.

articleTitle: Comparison of intra-channel nonlinearity tolerance between reduced-guard-interval CO-OFDM systems and nyquist single carrier systems
abstract: Attributed to the higher intra-channel nonlinearity tolerance, reduced-guard-interval CO-OFDM systems achieve approximately 25% longer maximum reach than Nyquist single carrier systems for 56 Gbaud QPSK modulations.

articleTitle: Optical networking for data centers across wide area networks
abstract: Data centers have taken on a central role in network architecture as they represent one endpoint of a substantial portion of communications sessions. Agile optical networks will become increasingly important in data center networking.

articleTitle: Cognitive genetic algorithms to design impairment-aware virtual topologies in optical networks
abstract: This paper demonstrates the advantages of using cognition when solving impairment-aware virtual topology design problems. Two new multiobjective cognitive genetic algorithms are presented and a performance comparison between them and a non-cognitive method is shown.

articleTitle: Transmission performances of differential 6-ary PSK signal with 10.7-Gb/s NRZ-OOK neighboring channels over SMF and DSF links
abstract: We demonstrate a differential 6-ary PSK-based transmission system with 10-Gb/s NRZ-OOK neighboring channels over 320-km long SMF with in-line dispersion compensation and DSF links and compare its performances with that of a classical PDM-DQPSK-based system.

articleTitle: Mitigation of reflection-induced crosstalk in multi-wavelength TDM-PON using spectral red-shifted, tunable fiber ring laser based upstream source
abstract: We proposed a gain-saturated RSOA and TOF based spectral red-shifted, directly-modulated tunable fiber ring laser as upstream laser source to suppress the reflection-induced crosstalk in a single-fiber bidirectional multi-wavelength TDM-PON system.

articleTitle: Directions of next generation transport network development
abstract: Next generation optical networks have to deal with four major areas of interdependency between optical technologies and network architecture: (1) the increase of capacity and improvement of efficiency (2) the optimization of traffic structure; (3) the optimization of architecture and topology (4) the minimization of complexity.

articleTitle: Novel FIR-filter configuration tolerant to fast phase fluctuations in digital coherent receivers for higher-order QAM signals
abstract: We propose a novel configuration of FIR filters adapted by the decision-directed LMS algorithm in the digital coherent receiver. Simulations and experiments show its high tolerance to phase noise and frequency offset for 16-QAM signals.

articleTitle: Simultaneous and self-referenced amplitude and phase measurement of two frequency combs using multi-heterodyne spectroscopy
abstract: We present a new type of multi-heterodyne spectroscopy that does not require separate reference field characterization and use it to demonstrate simultaneous, full-field characterization of two 40-line by 10-GHz optical frequency combs in line-by-line pulse shaping and fiber transmission applications.

articleTitle: Fourier analysis method for asymmetric polarization-maintaining fiber alignment
abstract: A new method for alignment of asymmetric polarization-maintaining (PM) fibers has been developed. It improves alignment accuracy for PM fibers with asymmetric stress applying parts. It provides a fast and accurate universal method for splicing recently developed PM fiber types.

articleTitle: Linearization of copy-and-sample photonics analog to digital converter based on a multidimensional look-up table
abstract: We present a novel linearization method for parametric copy-and-sample processor based on a multidimensional look-up table. The method is demonstrated experimentally on a photonics parametric analog-to-digital converter. A 27dB improvement in Total Harmonic Distortion is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Extremely Advanced Transmission with 3M technologies (multi-level modulation, multi-core & multi-mode)
abstract: We review the latest advances in “3M” technologies, i.e. multi-level modulation, multi-core fibers (MCF), and mode-division multiplexing with MIMO. We describe our recent activities on coherent 1024-QAM and OTDM-RZ/QAM transmissions and mode-coupling measurement along MCF.

articleTitle: All-optical WDM-to-OTDM conversion using a Raman amplification-based multi-wavelength pulse compressor
abstract: An all-optical format conversion from 4×10 Gb/s WDM channels to one 40 Gb/s OTDM channel by using Raman amplification-based multi-wavelength pulse compressor is demonstrated. Less than 2-dB power penalty is obtained after the OTDM demultiplexing.

articleTitle: Characterisation of MC fibers: New techniques and challenges
abstract: The various types of MCFs with very low crosstalk, large A<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</inf> and low micro-bending loss were discussed. A 10-core MCF with two-pitch layout and a moderate cladding diameter was proposed.

articleTitle: Set/reset operation of a monolithically-integrated InP SOA-MZI-type all-optical flip-flop circuit with a feedback loop
abstract: We investigated a monolithically integrated InP all-optical flip-flop (AOFF) circuit using a semiconductor optical amplifier based Mach-Zehnder interferometer with a feedback loop. We successfully achieved AOFF operation with 31-ps wide set/reset pulses.

articleTitle: TITLE: FTTP in Africa — IT's not just technology
abstract: FTTx is generally accepted as the utopian “last mile” technological means to ensure the optimal exploitation of content rich applications. Africa, a continent with varied user requirements, presents some unique challenges to realise FTTx deployments.

articleTitle: New avenues of revenues — Open access and infrastructure virtualization
abstract: Today's optical access networks hardly leverage the full networking potential offered by fibers. By merging the metro and access segments into a common open infrastructure a versatile grid can be established for providing multiple parallel services over optics in an efficient and flexible way. A suitable network approach is outlined.

articleTitle: Low temperature wafer bonding of silicon to InP and silicon to LiNbO3 using self-assembled monolayers
abstract: Procedures for wafer bonding between silicon and InP and between silicon and LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> at temperatures below 120 °C are reported. The bonding is based on the deposition of functionalized, organic self assembled monolayers.

articleTitle: Optical sub-QPSK symbol information extraction from 16-QAM signal using optical phase erasure
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate optical sub-QPSK symbol information extraction from a 16-QAM signal using optical phase erasure in HNLF. Partial symbol information of one QPSK channel in a 10-Gbaud/s 16-QAM signal is extracted successfully based on four wave mixing.

articleTitle: About the differential group delay of spooled spun fibers
abstract: We numerically and experimentally analyze spooled spun fibers showing that spin and bending birefringence interact, originating peculiar PMD behavior. Actually, DGD of spooled spun fibers may be larger than that of the equivalent unspun fibers.

articleTitle: An electrically pumped Ge-on-Si laser
abstract: We present the first CMOS compatible, electrically pumped Fabry-Perot Ge laser with larger than 1mW output power and a gain spectrum width of nearly 200nm in the range from 1520nm to 1700nm.

articleTitle: On chip plasmonic enhanced silicon Schottky detector for telecom wavelengths
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated on-chip plasmonic enhanced Schottky detector for telecom wavelengths based on the internal photoemission process. This CMOS compatible device may serve as a promising alternative to the Si-Ge detectors.

articleTitle: Experimental validation/evaluation of a GMPLS unified control plane in multi-layer (MPLS-TP/WSON) networks
abstract: A validation of the GMPLS unified control plane deployed within the ADRENALINE testbed for dynamic provisioning in multi-layer networks is presented. We experimentally compare two on-line path computation mechanisms aiming at exploiting the grooming functions.

articleTitle: Co-existent downstream scheme between OOK and QAM signals in an optical access network using software-defined technology
abstract: We propose a flexible multiplexing system that assigns bit of symbol in multi-level modulation and time slot dynamically in PON. And we demonstrated successfully a simultaneous downstream scheme for the proposed ONU and GE-PON/10G-EPON ONU.

articleTitle: Short-pulse amplification in a phase-sensitive amplifier
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate amplification of picosecond pulses in a PSA, discuss the tolerance on residual delay and dispersion on the signal and idler, and also show the first demonstration of pulse compression in a PSA.

articleTitle: Everything you always wanted to know about cascaded parametric amplifiers, but were afraid to ask
abstract: I will review briefly the properties of optical amplifiers and attenuators, and how they affect the information carried by signals. I will then describe in detail the properties of cascaded parametric amplifiers and transmission links, and explain why such links are signal-phase-insensitive, but have noise figures that are 6-dB lower than standard phase-insensitive links.

articleTitle: Fiber performance comparison in all-EDFA 112 Gb/s PDM-QPSK systems
abstract: We quantify performance of 112-Gb/s PDM-QPSK WDM systems using TrueWave REACH, AllWave, and Ultra-Large Area fibers. Experimental results identify linear and nonlinear transport regimes and yield margin and OSNR penalties against to FEC BER limits.

articleTitle: Active devices in passive optical networks
abstract: Next-Generation PONs will likely contain one or more of: Optical amplification, WDM, Advanced modulation techniques. Physical layer will grow in importance. N-G PON variants will require wide array of active components: WDM-PON: RSOAs/REAMs, Tunable Lasers and Filters, Comb Seed Lasers. Long-Rance: SOAs, Raman Pumps. Electronic processing (DSP) will grow in importance to support advanced modulation formats.

articleTitle: Pilot-aided sampling frequency offset compensation for coherent optical OFDM
abstract: A sampling frequency offset compensation based on pilot-aided phase noise mitigation scheme is proposed. SFO tolerance up to 1000 ppm for CO-OFDM is shown. An estimation deviation of 0.5 ppm is observed.

articleTitle: Coherent friendly dispersion Map for direct detection transmission formats
abstract: A dispersion map that meets the conflicting needs of coherent and direct detection transmission is presented. Performance improvements over a conventional map are verified for coherent transmission by experiments and simulations.

articleTitle: Integrated polarization divers coherent receiver based on polymer PLC with high polarization extinction ratio for 100G ethernet applications
abstract: A dual-polarization quadrature phase-shift key coherent receiver based on polymer planar lightwave circuit is presented. Polarization beam-splitter, optical 90° hybrids and photodiodes are hybridly integrated on one chip. Basic characteristics of the receiver are given.

articleTitle: Fast feed-forward polarization tracking in a DP-mPSK coherent receiver employing blind SOP estimation
abstract: Novel feed-forward polarization tracking is proposed using differential detection of the X and Y polarizations. An experiment showed that the proposed method mitigated 2.6 dB penalty caused by 10 MHz polarization rotation for 43G DP-QPSK.

articleTitle: kW fiber lasers
abstract: We describe a monolithic (fully fused), 1.2-kW, Yb-doped fiber laser with single-mode beam quality. This laser employs a new generation of 100-W, high-brightness, fiber-coupled pump sources based on spatially multiplexed single emitters and a simple, end-pumped design for high efficiency, reliability, and environmental stability.

articleTitle: Integrated in-band optical signal-to-noise ratio (OSNR) monitor implemented in SOI platform
abstract: Based on the different coherence properties of signal and noise, we measured the in-band optical signal-to-noise ratio using integrated thermally tunable Mach-Zehnder optical delay interferometer in SOI platform. The experimental results show good bit-rate-independent property.

articleTitle: Transmission performance of mixed line-rate and format DWDM traffic using a 10×10Gb/s photonic integrated transceiver array for low-cost metro networks
abstract: We report on the transmission performance of a 10×10Gb/s low-cost photonic integrated transceiver comprising a reflective SOA-based laser array and a reflective EAM array over 825km under mixed 10G/40G traffic conditions at 50GHz grid.

articleTitle: A high power 60 GHz photoreceiver
abstract: We report on a 60 GHz photoreceiver with 1 dB compression output power of +14 dBm and saturated power exceeding +16.5 dBm. Inside a frequency range of 57-64 GHz, the output power variation is about 3.2 dB.

articleTitle: Fiber deployment in Latin America: An emerging market for FTTx technology
abstract: No longer constrained to backbone and long haul networks, fiber has moved from a rarity to a staple in broadband access networks worldwide. With ever increasing demand for bandwidth, parts of the world have seen rapid adoption of Fiber based access technologies. The rates at which these technologies are adopted vary widely across regions based on regulation, consumer demand economics and competitive environments. For Latin America, slow fixed broadband growth has resulted in equally slow adoption of FTTx. With government broadband agendas, increased consumer demand and service provider modernization efforts, Latin America is becoming an emerging market for FTTx technology.

articleTitle: 310GHz gain-bandwidth product Ge/Si avalanche photodetector by selective epitaxial growth
abstract: We report a normal incident Ge/Si avalanche photodiode by selective epitaxial growth. By eliminating germanium impact-ionization at high gain, high responsivity of 12A/W and large gain-bandwidth product of 310GHz have been achieved at 1550nm.

articleTitle: Optical networking in smarter data centers: 2015 and beyond
abstract: Advantages of optical networking for highly virtualized data centers are discussed, including lower power, improved scalability and port density, and tighter I/O integration with processors. Use cases include enterprise infrastructure underlying software-defined networking, supercomputing, and multi-site backup applications.

articleTitle: Real-time implementation of packet-by-packet polarization demultiplexing in a 28 Gb/s burst mode coherent receiver
abstract: We experimentally show a real-time coherent receiver operated in burst mode. Enabled by special headers, 28-Gb/s PDM-QPSK packets with random states of polarizations are successfully demodulated, and the sensitivity to optical noise is reported.

articleTitle: Low latency and large port count optical packet switch with highly distributed control
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time 40 Gb/s operation of a modular large port count optical packet switch with highly distributed control. The switch shows 25ns latency and record low energy consumption of 76.5 pj/bit.

articleTitle: Constellation manipulation for optical multicasted hexadecimal coding/decoding of 10-Gbaud/s 16-QAM using non-degenerate FWM in HNLFs
abstract: By exploiting non-degenerate four-wave mixing in highly nonlinear fibers assisted by two phase-modulated pumps, we report optical multicasted hexadecimal coding/decoding of 16-QAM. Constellation manipulation for a 10-Gbaud/s 16-QAM signal is demonstrated with OSNR penalties of <;2.4 dB for multicasted coding and <;1.6 dB for decoding.

articleTitle: 40×117.6 Gb/s PDM-16QAM OFDM transmission over 10,181 km with soft-decision LDPC coding and nonlinearity compensation
abstract: Transmission of 117.6Gb/s optical PDM-16QAM OFDM signals over 10,181km is demonstrated at 25-GHz channel spacing with 4.7 b/s/Hz spectral efficiency. All the errors have been corrected by using 25% overhead QC-LDPC after multi-band nonlinearity compensation.

articleTitle: Highly scalable OXC-based contentionless ROADM architecture with reduced network implementation costs
abstract: We present a novel OXC-based colorless/directionless/contentionless ROADM architecture that resolves many of the issues of previous OXC-based solutions. We show cost savings of up to 52% over typical WSS-based architectures in a reference BT network.

articleTitle: Interchannel nonlinearity compensation for 3λ×114-Gb/s DP-8QAM using three synchronized sampling scopes
abstract: We investigate interchannel nonlinearity compensation in a 3×114-Gb/s WDM system at 50-GHz channel spacing. Three sampling oscilloscopes simultaneous capture the waveforms at the three wavelengths, and the signals are jointly backpropagated to undo XPM.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s real-time all-VCSEL low complexity coherent scheme for PONs
abstract: Real time demodulation of a 10 Gb/s all-VCSEL based coherent PON link with a simplified coherent receiver scheme is demonstrated. Receiver sensitivity of -33 dBm is achieved providing high splitting ratio and link reach.

articleTitle: Spectrum compactness based defragmentation in flexible bandwidth optical networks
abstract: This paper proposes a novel Spectrum Compactness based Defragmentation scheme to maximize the profitability of defragmentation. Numerical simulation shows that there exists an optimum load region to operate defragmentation.

articleTitle: On the limitations of IM/DD WDM-FDMA-OFDM PON with single photodiode for upstream transmission
abstract: We experimentally assess the limitations of IM/DD WDM-FDMA-OFDM with a single photodetector. We show that the laser chirp will influence the minimum separation between wavelengths and also the frequency response of a dispersive channel.

articleTitle: Flexible-format optical modulator using silica-LiNbO3 hybrid integration technology
abstract: We describe our flexible-format optical modulators using hybrid integration technology with a silica-PLC and LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> phase-modulator array. The modulators can optically change carrier number and modulation level combinations adaptively according to transmission distance.

articleTitle: A novel architecture to provide super-broadband optical wireless access service
abstract: We demonstrated a novel optical wireless architecture to provide 12.5Gb/s wireless signal at 60GHz mm-wave and 100Gb/s symmetrical wireline service. Some novel enabling techniques are employed to overcome fiber dispersion, reduce the cost and provide super-broadband service.

articleTitle: Capacity limits in single-mode fiber and scaling for spatial multiplexing
abstract: We present nonlinear fiber capacity estimate calculations for various types of single-mode fibers and introduce an analytic formula that closely matches simulations. We discuss capacity scaling from spatial multiplexing in multicore and multimode fibers.

articleTitle: Adaptive MIMO signal processing for mode-division multiplexing
abstract: The fiber-optic multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) channel is analyzed. For a 6×6 MIMO experiment over 96 km few-mode fiber it is found that the mode dependent loss is 3 dB, with negligible temporal fluctuations and almost no impact on capacity.

articleTitle: 20-Gb/s injection locked FP-LD in a wavelength-division-multiplexing OFDM-PON
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, an injection-locked Fabry Perot laser operating at 20-Gb/s. This laser can be deployed in wavelength-division-multiplexing OFDM-PONs. Intensity modulation and direct detection are used and 0.5-dB SNR penalty is observed after 52-km fiber.

articleTitle: Optimized four-dimensional mapping for high-speed optical communication systems
abstract: We propose an optimized mapping rule for the 32-point four-dimensional cross-constellation for high-speed optical communications based on bit-interleaved coded-modulation with iterative decoding. The optimized mapping outperforms its random counterpart by 1 dB in terms of OSNR sensitivity.

articleTitle: DSP aspects for deployment of 100G-DWDM systems in carrier networks
abstract: This paper reviews carriers' requirements for 100G based DWDM systems, and indicates some of the key functions needed by coherent Digital Signal Processors (DSPs). A proof-of-concept DSP is fabricated and subjected to a technical feasibility study of its functions and real-time performance. This reasonably power efficient device will advance the maturity of 100G coherent DWDM systems.

articleTitle: Side-tap modal channel monitor for mode division multiplexed (MDM) systems
abstract: We demonstrate a sidetap modal channel monitor based on a tilted Bragg grating, where different modes radiate at different angles. We qualitatively correlate the observed modal power partitioning with more accurate interferometer-based measurements.

articleTitle: The challenge for the next generation OTN based on 400Gbps and beyond
abstract: The paper reviews recent works and issues on the next generation OTN for the future high-speed Ethernet transport. We demonstrate the feasibility of the over 40 Tbps-class OTN that supports client signals with 400Gbps.

articleTitle: Wide-bandwidth, low-loss, 19-cell hollow core photonic band gap fiber and its potential for low latency data transmission
abstract: A record low loss (3.5dB/km) for a wide operating bandwidth HC-PBGF is reported. Detailed time-of-flight measurements are also presented, enabling first measurements of latency and differential group delay between mode groups in HC-PBGF.

articleTitle: Bend tunable coupling in dual-hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber
abstract: We demonstrate the first measured dual-hollow-core photonic bandgap silica fiber. We examine its bend-induced coupling characteristics both theoretically and experimentally. Varying the bend diameter of the fiber allows control of the resonant coupling wavelength.

articleTitle: Rayleigh noise mitigated 70-km-reach bi-directional WDM-PON with 10-Gb/s directly modulated Manchester-duobinary as downstream signal
abstract: A 70-km-reach bi-directional WDM-PON with 10-Gb/s downstream Manchester-duobinary signal and 1.25-Gb/s upstream re-modulated NRZ-OOK signals is demonstrated, with effective mitigation of Rayleigh backscattered noise.

articleTitle: Attosecond photonics for optical communications
abstract: Recent experiments have demonstrated that low-jitter mode locked lasers enable unprecedented high-resolution high-speed analog to digital conversion. That capability may be leveraged to bring spectral efficiency of optical transport systems to its Shannon limit.

articleTitle: Ge waveguide photodetectors with responsivity roll-off beyond 1620 nm using localized stressor
abstract: We report a novel Ge waveguide photodetector and the fabrication on silicon-on-insulator (SOI) platform. Localized stressor structures were incorporated to tune the responsivity roll-off wavelength. With the localized stressor structure, the roll-off in responsivity is found to be red-shifted from 1520 nm to beyond 1620 nm, i.e., a flat responsivity over the entire C- and L-band is obtained. This technique makes Ge a promising material for fabricating monolithic high-responsivity receivers covering the entire C- and L-band fiber optic communications.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of Tb/s optical transport network based on CO-OFDM superchannel with heterogeneous roadm nodes supporting single-fiber bidirectional communications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a Tb/s optical transport network based on CO-OFDM superchannel employing two types of ROADMs. The functional operations of bidirectional communication over single-fiber links, optical channel switching, and sub-band switching are verified.

articleTitle: Phase sensitive amplification of coherent multi-carrier pair with 3-dB signal-ASE beat noise reduction
abstract: We propose the simultaneous amplification of a coherent multi-carrier pair using χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>-based non-degenerate PSA. We demonstrate a 3-dB reduction in the signal-ASE beat noise and a BPSK signal power penalty improvement for the first time.

articleTitle: Mode-locking dynamics in a quantum-dash fabry-pérot laser diode for packet based clock recovery applications
abstract: We experimentally investigate the locking/unlocking dynamics of a mode-locked QDash laser diode for packet-based clock-recovery applications. Results show 20 ns locking times for the passively and externally synchronized mode-locking mechanisms.

articleTitle: Polarization-diversified DWDM receiver on silicon free of polarization-dependent wavelength shift
abstract: We demonstrate a monolithically integrated, polarization-diversified silicon receiver chip with 10 wavelength channels at 100-GHz spacing. It has <1.8 dB polarization-dependent loss and zero polarization-dependent wavelength shift. 10 Gbps operation is demonstrated for all channels.

articleTitle: Mode division multiplexed transmission with a weakly-coupled few-mode fiber
abstract: We review mode-division multiplexing highlighting the possibilities of weakly-coupled systems: hybrid optical/digital mode separation and reduced receiver complexity. A recent experiment of 5 mode transmission over 40km demonstrates the potentials of this technology.

articleTitle: Discrete spectrum-scan routing based on spectrum discretization in flexible optical networks
abstract: We propose a novel discrete spectrum-scan routing scheme in flexible optical networks. Based on spectrum discretization, this scheme achieves optimal routing in a gridless network scenario while reducing the routing complexity from exponential to polynomial.

articleTitle: Spectrally-efficient elastic optical path networks toward 1 Tbps era
abstract: We present spectrally-efficient elastic optical path networks for the 400 Gbps and 1 Tbps era. They enable rate/distance-adaptive spectrum allocation in a highly spectrum-efficient manner, and IP traffic offloading to an elastic optical layer.

articleTitle: Physical impairment aware planning of next generation WDM backbone networks
abstract: We discuss and illustrate the evolution of the "Quality of Transmission" estimators suitable for optimized planning of next generation WDM networks featuring coherent detection, elastic spectral efficiency, and flexible optical network nodes.

articleTitle: 0.2-dB gain excursion AGC-EDFA with a high speed VOA for 100-channel add/drop equivalent operation
abstract: We have developed a digitally controlled AGC-EDFA by combining an FF-controlled pump-LD and an FF-controlled VOA. We realized a gain excursion of less than 0.2 dB at a 100-channel add/drop equivalent operation.

articleTitle: Generation and FEC-decoding of a 231.5-Gb/s PDM-OFDM signal with 256-iterative-polar-modulation achieving 11.15-b/s/Hz intrachannel spectral efficiency and 800-km reach
abstract: A 231.5-Gb/s PDM-OFDM signal with 256-iterative-polar-modulation, outperforming 256-QAM by 1.2 dB in required OSNR after soft-FEC decoding, is generated, FEC-decoded, and transmitted over a record distance of 800 km with 11.15-b/s/Hz intrachannel spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Wideband photonic compressive sampling
abstract: We discuss the potential benefits of combining the high speeds, broad modulation bandwidths and precision timing of photonic sampling techniques with recent advances in the theory and algorithms of compressive sampling.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of multicast traffic over spectrum elastic optical networks
abstract: We analyze the multicast performance over spectrum elastic optical networks. Results demonstrate the flexible spectrum allocation provides lower blocking probability for multicast compared to that in ITU-T grid-based WDM networks.

articleTitle: Demonstration of correlation-based OTDR for in-service monitoring of 64-split TDM PON
abstract: We demonstrate a correlation-based OTDR for the in-service monitoring of the 64-split TDM PON. For this purpose, we improve its dynamic range by using the pseudo-random noise sequence superimposed on the data signal.

articleTitle: Photonics-assisted multiple RF frequencies recognition based on compressive sampling
abstract: Recognition of sparse multiple RF tones ranging from 15 to 20 GHz is reported based on compressive sampling. Maximum detection error of 60 kHz is achieved using a single ADC with bandwidth of 826.75 MHz.

articleTitle: Mode-division multiplexed transmission with fiber mode couplers
abstract: We describe the mode-division multiplexing (MDM) transmission using a conventional fiber coupler with negligible modal crosstalk. A 2×10 Gbps MDM transmission was achieved over a 10 km two-mode fiber without any signal processing.

articleTitle: Novel cellular optical access network and convergence with FTTH
abstract: Base station cooperation and infrastructure sharing are highly desirable features in future mobile access networks. We discuss the requirements they pose with regard to the optical network technologies which are likely to be deployed to support these upcoming mobile operator demands.

articleTitle: Silica-based PLC transponder aggregators for colorless, directionless, and contentionless ROADM
abstract: We describe a silica-on-silicon PLC transponder aggregator (TPA) based on splitter-switch architecture. This integrated TPA enables us to realize a colorless, directionless and contentionless multi-degree ROADM cost-effectively with a small footprint.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of all-optical modulation format conversion from NRZ-OOK to RZ-8APSK based on fiber nonlinearity
abstract: All-optical modulation format conversion scheme from 3 channels non-return-to-zero on-off-keying (NRZ-OOK) to return-to-zero 8 amplitude and phase-shifted keying (RZ-8APSK) based on nonlinearity in optical fiber is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. 3 channels 10.7 Gb/s NRZ-OOK signals are converted to 32 Gb/s RZ-8APSK signal by the use of cross phase modulation and optical parametric amplification.

articleTitle: Practical issues and some lessons learned from realization of phase sensitive parametric regenerators
abstract: Practical issues in pump phase synchronization necessary for coherent all-optical processing are discussed, including feed-forward carrier recovery of phase encoded signals.

articleTitle: 50 Gbps class transmission in single mode fiber using discrete multi-tone modulation with 10G directly modulated laser
abstract: We have experimentally demonstrated the highest capacity transmission of 73.2Gbps at back-to-back and 52.8Gbps after 20-km SMF transmission without optical amplifiers and dispersion compensation on discrete multi-tone systems with 10G directly modulated 1550-nm lasers.

articleTitle: Monolithic integrated filtered-feedback multi-wavelength laser
abstract: A novel multi-wavelength laser monolithically integrated on InP is presented. The device consists of four channels of Fabry-Pérot lasers using two-port multimode interference reflectors (MIRs) and a single mode operation for each channel is realized by the filtered-feedback from arrayed waveguide grating(AWG).

articleTitle: Over 4,200km WDM transmission of 80-Gb/s PDM-OFDM-16QAM signals with 12.5-GHz channel spacing employing EDFA only amplification
abstract: We demonstrate transmission of 8×80-Gb/s PDM-OFDM-16QAM signals at a channel spacing of 12.5 GHz over 4,242 km with EDFA only amplification. It achieves the longest transmission distance at the SE >;5 b/s/Hz to date.

articleTitle: Field trial Nyquist-WDM transmission of 8×216.4Gb/s PDM-CSRZ-QPSK exceeding 4b/s/Hz spectral efficiency
abstract: We have achieved the first ever field transmission of 8×216.4 Gb/s Nyquist-WDM signals over 1750-km G.652 fiber consisting of 950km field-deployed and 800km lab fibers with 21.6-dB average loss per span and EDFA-only amplification. Each channel is 54.2-Gbaud (216.4-Gbit/s) PDM-CSRZ-QPSK signal on 50-GHz grid with a record spectral efficiency of 4b/s/Hz. The digital post filter and 1-bit MLSE are introduced at the receiver DSP to suppress noise, linear crosstalk and filtering effects.

articleTitle: Coherent 100G field trial over installed fiber links: Investigating key network scenarios and applications
abstract: We report successful coherent 100G field trial over installed fiber links of total 769km, investigating performance of coherent technology for key network scenarios and applications including upgrade, new DCM-less design, PMD issue and alien wavelength.

articleTitle: Spectrally efficient long-haul transmission of 22-Tb/s using 40-Gbaud PDM-16QAM with coherent detection
abstract: We report on the transmission of 1-Tb/s clusters of channels, composed by four 50-GHz-spaced WDM channels modulated with 40-Gbaud PDM-16QAM. We transmit 22-Tb/s data over 2,400 km, with a spectral efficiency of 5 bit/s/Hz.

articleTitle: 10-Gb/s, 80-km reach RSOA-based WDM PON employing QPSK signal and self-homodyne receiver
abstract: We demonstrate 10-Gb/s, 80-km-reach RSOA-based WDM PON by utilizing the digital coherent detection and electronic phase equalization techniques. The upstream signal is obtained by directly modulating a TO-can packaged RSOA with 10-Gb/s QPSK signal.

articleTitle: All-optical 3R regeneration using fiber optical parametric oscillator and amplifier
abstract: We demonstrate an all-optical wavelength-tunable 3R regenerator based on fiber optical parametric oscillator and amplifier. Regenerated signal with a power penalty of 0.1 dB versus back-to-back at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> BER can be obtained.

articleTitle: Optimization of microring-based optical interconnection configurations for the reduction of power consumption and insertion loss
abstract: With the objectives of reducing power consumption and average insertion loss, optimal configurations for optical interconnection are determined, leveraging the asymmetric behaviors at cross/bar states of microring switching element. Besides, a novel heuristic is proposed.

articleTitle: Channel power excursions in GMPLS end-to-end optical restoration with single-step wavelength tuning
abstract: Power excursions resulting from SRS tilt-induced coupling created >3dB excursion in simulations of GMPLS end-to-end restoration on a continental scale network and the impact of wavelength dependent gain is investigated for different add channel combinations.

articleTitle: Techniques in carrier recovery for optical coherent systems
abstract: Carrier recovery is essential in optical coherent systems to track the phase noises of lasers. Feedback and feedforward schemes are described and the performances are compared. Cycle slips and its remedies are discussed.

articleTitle: Dynamic operation of flexi-grid OFDM-based networks
abstract: Routing in dynamic OFDM-based optical networks by simultaneous optimization of allocated spectrum and transponder reach is proven beneficial when flexi-grid technology is used regarding blocking performance and spectral efficiency when compared to standard-grid counterpart.

articleTitle: Quaternary Duobinary modulation for superchannels with sub-Nyquist subcarrier spacing
abstract: DP-DQDB (Quaternary Duobinary) and DP-DQPSK with Nyquist pulse shaping, both with coherent reception, are compared w.r.t. the achievable spectral efficiency when employed as closely packed subcarriers of a superchannel without optical filtering of the subchannels.

articleTitle: Experimental assessment of transmission reach for uncompensated 32-GBaud PDM-QPSK and PDM-16QAM
abstract: We experimentally compare the transmission reach of PDM-16QAM and PDM-QPSK at 32 Gbaud over an uncompensated transmission link and characterize the impact of the hardware limitations stemming from the practical implementation of PDM-16QAM.

articleTitle: Enabling broadband communication, Deutsche Telekom FTTH deployment architecture, plans, rollout
abstract: This paper describes the Deutsche Telekom's access network evolution to support via multiple technologies broadband services to residential and business customers culminating in the current FTTH rollout in Germany.

articleTitle: 3 × 458-Gbit/s Optical Multi-band OFDM transmission at 50-GHz WDM spacing over 160 km of SSMF with EDFA-only amplification
abstract: We have successfully demonstrated 3 × 458-Gbit/s Optical Multi-band OFDM transmission over 160 km of SSMF with EDFA-only amplification at 50 GHz WDM spacing by utilizing narrowband optical filter.

articleTitle: Generation of square or hexagonal 16-QAM signals using a single dual drive IQ modulator driven by binary signals
abstract: A simple square or hexagonal 16-QAM generation technique using a commercially available dual drive IQ modulator driven by 4 binary signals is proposed. Square or hexagonal polarization multiplexed (PM) 16-QAM signals at 25Gbaud/s are experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: OutageDetection and dynamic re-provisioning in GRIPhoN — A globally reconfigurable intelligent photonic network
abstract: We describe the multi-layer GRIPhoN architecture which provides dynamic bandwidth at the OTN and wavelength layers for private-line customers. We propose and demonstrate an automated restoration approach for wavelength connections using dynamic re-provisioning.

articleTitle: Reception of dual-LP11-mode CO-OFDM signals through few-mode compatible optical add/drop multiplexer
abstract: We report successful reception of dual-LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>-mode CO-OFDM signals traversing few-mode compatible optical add/drop multiplexer (OADM). The power penalties for add, drop and through ports are 2.6, 2.4, 0.7 dB, respectively for 3×318 Gb/s OFDM signals.

articleTitle: How much can colorless, directionless and contentionless (CDC) of ROADM help dynamic lightpath provisioning?
abstract: We evaluate the impact of the colorless, directionless, and contentionless features of ROADM on dynamic lightpath service provisioning. It is found that colorless plays the most significant role in improving lightpath blocking performance.

articleTitle: Fast switching burst mode receiver in a 24-channel 112Gb/s DP-QPSK WDM system with 240km transmission
abstract: We demonstrate the performance of a fast switching (<; 150ns) 112Gb/s DP-QPSK digital burst mode coherent receiver in a 24-channel WDM system. A penalty of 0.5dB is experienced after propagating over 240km of SSMF.

articleTitle: Weakly coupled multi core fibers with optimum design to realize selectively excitation of individual super-modes
abstract: A design of the weakly coupled 7 core fibers was optimized for the mode division multiplexing transmission. By localizing super-modes, high spatial density would be successfully realized with simple setup utilizing the multi core connectors.

articleTitle: The studying on the application of OTN in China Telecom
abstract: The studying and deployment consideration of OTN technologies in China Telecom's network was introduced, including deploying scenarios analysis and deploying suggestions both in backbone network and MAN. IP + OTN joint networking strategies were discussed also.

articleTitle: Highly-efficient ONU power-saving technique with HGW-determined sleep pattern toward next-generation optical access systems
abstract: We propose a novel power-saving technique by interworking with the home network via the home-gateway. Numerical simulations show it is highly effective even if the UNI throughput is 100 Mbit/s; it has moderate buffer size requirement. It is also shown that the optical and electrical components and command processing for the state transitions must offer quick response times for higher power efficiency.

articleTitle: Robust carrier recovery in polarization division multiplexed receivers
abstract: We present a novel carrier recovery which can track fast and large sinusoidal frequency oscillations of commercially available lasers and efficiently compensate for laser noise. Q gain of 0.8 dB is recorded in offline experiments.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of fiber nonlinearity mitigation using digital phase conjugation
abstract: We demonstrate fiber nonlinearity mitigation using mid-link digital phase conjugation in 40-Gb/s CO-OFDM-16QAM transmission over 100-km ultra-large-area-fiber spans, achieving a reach of 10,400 km, and reach and power-tolerance improvements of 53% and 4 dB, respectively.

articleTitle: 25 Gbit/s Error-free wireless on-off-keying data transmission at W-band using ultra-fast photonic transmitter-mixers and envelop detectors
abstract: By combing ultra-fast photonic-transmitter-mixers and envelop detectors with record-high modulation (26 GHz) and video bandwidths (37 GHz), respectively, error-free on-off-keying wireless transmission at W-band with data rate as high as 25 Gbit/sec can be achieved.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of 2xONU 30Gbps digitally-supported-coherent IFDMA-PON uplink
abstract: Coherent Interleaved FDMA (IFDMA)-PON uplink transmission with 30Gbps-8PSK format over 20km SSMF is experimentally demonstrated. Digital carrier frequency offset pre-compensation technique enables coherent orthogonal subcarrier multiple access of 2 ONUs with free-running sources.

articleTitle: Active-passive 4×4 SOA-based switch with integrated power monitoring
abstract: The first monolithically integrated 4×4 switch with power monitoring function using on-chip PIN photodiodes is reported. Using 10Gb/s signals, under active power control an IPDR of 12dB for a 1dB power penalty is achieved.

articleTitle: Doping geometries for 40G carrier-depletion-based silicon optical modulators
abstract: A comparison is preformed between carrier-depletion modulators with different doping patterns to reach low V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</sub>L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</sub> = 0.62 V·cm at DC with interdigitated and lateral PN junctions respectively, but also show modulation at 35 Gbit/s (errorfree).

articleTitle: Chromatic dispersion estimation in 40 Gb/s coherent polarization-multiplexed single carrier system using complementary Golay sequences
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate full-transmission chromatic dispersion estimation with high accuracy in 40-Gb/s coherent polarization-multiplexed single-carrier system using binary complementary Golay training sequences. The technique is verified to be robust against polarization-mode-dispersion and amplified-spontaneous-emission noise.

articleTitle: Upstream transmission of 10-Gb/s QPSK signal generated by directly modulating RSOA with instantaneous injection/depletion currents in coherent WDM PON
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a simple technique to generate 10-Gb/s QPSK signal by directly modulating an RSOA with instantaneous injection/depletion currents. No electronic equalization technique is needed to overcome the limited bandwidth of the RSOA.

articleTitle: WDM-PON fiber-fault automatic detection and Localization with 1 dB event sensitivity in drop links
abstract: Trial of live WDM-PON monitoring based on Optical Time Domain Reflectometry (OTDR) and Optical Transceiver Monitoring (OTM) is presented. The concept of cost-effective, remote and quick operation without drop-line demarcation components is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Recent progress in transmission fibers for capacity beyond 100-Tbit/s
abstract: We discuss the optical fiber properties and system impact of new transmission fibers, including low-loss ultra-large-area fibers for above 100-Gbit/s coherent systems, and multicore fibers for spatially multiplexed DWDM transmissions.

articleTitle: Reflectometric degree of coherence analysis of narrow linewidth laser at continuous delay
abstract: A novel fiber-reflectometric technique using Rayleigh speckle statistical analysis enables us to measure the degree of coherence (DOC) at a continuous delay time. The DOC of a tens of kHz linewidth laser is analyzed.

articleTitle: Hybrid Raman/FBG-based sensing for simultaneous point dynamic strain and distributed temperature measurement
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate an integrated hybrid optical fiber sensing technique that combines distributed Raman-based temperature measurements with a time-domain approach for FBG dynamic interrogation using a shared optical source and receiver block.

articleTitle: Adaptive carrier phase estimation in coherent systems
abstract: We propose an adaptive carrier-phase-estimation (CPE) technique, which automatically optimizes the block length of CPE. It is demonstrated to achieve the best performance in a long-haul 112-Gb/s PDM-QPSK system with and without 10-Gb/s OOK channels.

articleTitle: Extremely small-form 100GbE transmitter optical sub-assembly for future inter data center cloud networks
abstract: An extremely small-form transmitter optical sub-assembly using a novel three-dimensional interconnection technique was developed for 100 GbE for the first time. Error-free transmission is demonstrated through 10 km of single-mode fiber at 100 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Optical carrier distributed network with 0.1 THz short-reach wireless communication system
abstract: We demonstrate a 10-Gb/s optical-carrier-distributed network with wireless communication system. The 10-Gb/s W-band wireless-signal was generated by a near-ballistic-uni-traveling-carrier-photodiode (NBUTD-PD) based transmitter optically excited by 0.1-THz optical pulses. 20-km optical fiber upstream transmission is achieved.

articleTitle: Burst-mode wavelength upconversion using gain-clamped SOA for applying WDM technique to TDM-PON
abstract: We propose a WDM/TDM-PON utilizing AOWC. ~23 nm multiple- to single-wavelength upconversion for 1.25 Gbit/s burst-mode signals is realized by GC-SOA. The measured optical equalization is >8 dB and average latency is <;1.2 ms.

articleTitle: Digital signal processing for coherent systems
abstract: Digital signal processing (DSP) is the technology which has made coherent systems commercially viable. We survey the key DSP algorithms required to realize a coherent system before discussing power consumption and future research directions.

articleTitle: Effective architecture for 10 Gb/s upstream WDM-PONs exploiting self-seeding and external modulation
abstract: We propose a 10 Gb/s WDM-PON architecture that exploits a colorless Optical Network Unit, encompassing a self-seeded broadband uncooled Fabry-Perot laser diode and external modulation. We demonstrate low-penalty transmission over 25 km common fiber.

articleTitle: On shared risk link group optimization
abstract: This paper takes a closer look at the shared risk link group (SRLG) optimization issue and proposes algorithm on how to reduce the size of the SRLGs for different applications with correctness proofs.

articleTitle: High-power photonic transmitter-mixers with integrated Wilkinson power combiner for wireless communication with high data rate (15 Gbps) at W-band
abstract: We demonstrate photonic transmitters-mixers integrated with Wilkinson power-combiners. Compared with single-ended operation, double-ended operation exhibits 5.5-dB higher output power over wide frequencies (65-100 GHz). 15 Gbps error-free wireless transmission with 6.6 dBm output at 93 GHz is achieved.

articleTitle: 40 Gb/s upstream transmission in WDM-PON using reflective electro-absorption modulator and noise predictive maximum likelihood equalization
abstract: A novel equalization technique based on noise predictive maximum likelihood and partial response signaling is proposed to enhance the capacity of WDM-PON using SOA-REAM. We successfully demonstrate 40-Gb/s upstream transmission over 20-km bidirectional fiber.

articleTitle: Migrating Legacy PON Equipment towards Colorless ONU through Hybrid Integrated SOI All-Optical λ-Converter
abstract: We present an ONU featuring a "colorless" DML enabled by a wavelength converter integrated on a 4μm silicon-on-insulator substrate. The photonic chip employs a hybrid integrated SOA and delay-interferometers and supports operation beyond 10Gb/s.

articleTitle: Agile optical frequency synthesis in dispersion-engineered parametric mixers
abstract: We present the concept of extra-cavity frequency synthesis to address the need for high performance frequency-agile light sources. Dispersion-engineered parametric mixers are employed to provide tuning range and speed enhancements to the existing sources.

articleTitle: Volterra based nonlinear compensation on 224 Gb/s PolMux-16QAM optical fibre link
abstract: We demonstrate the performance of a nonlinear compensation scheme based on the Volterra Series on a 224 Gb/s PolMux-16QAM system over 250 km of fibre and comment on its improvement in performance over linear equalization.

articleTitle: Long-haul WDM transmission of PDM-8PSK and PDM-8QAM with nonlinear DSP
abstract: The performance improvement with digital backpropagation using PDM-8PSK and PDM-8QAM formats was experimentally assessed for 7×112Gbit/s. Transmission reach was extended by ~20% compared to 15% for an equivalent PDM-QPSK system.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of cost-effective intensity-modulation and direct-detection optical Fast-OFDM over 40km SMF transmission
abstract: We demonstrate the first experimental implementation of intensity-modulation and direct-detection 7.6Gb/s DBPSK-based DSB optical Fast-OFDM with a reduced subcarrier spacing equal to half of the symbol rate per subcarrier over 40km SMF.

articleTitle: Chromatic dispersion compensation — An energy consumption perspective
abstract: We estimate the energy consumption of digital-signal-processing-based chromatic dispersion (CD) compensation in wavelength-division-multiplexed (WDM) systems and show that energy efficiency of digital electronic compensation is comparable to that of optical fibre-based compensation.

articleTitle: Hybrid silicon micro-cavity light source on silicon-on-diamond substrate
abstract: We review hybrid silicon microring lasers built on silicon-on-insulator substrate and their thermal performance bottleneck. A low-loss silicon-on-diamond (SOD) substrate as the thermal solution and hybrid microring devices on SOD are discussed.

articleTitle: High data rate silicon optical modulator with self-aligned fabrication process
abstract: In this work we present optical modulation at both 40Gbit/s and 50Gbit/s from a carrier depletion based device in silicon. The modulator can be fabricated using a self-aligned process aiding performance reliability and device yield.

articleTitle: 40 Gbit/s (4 × 10 Gbit/s) Y-00 protocol for secure optical communication and its transmission over 120 km
abstract: WDM transmitter and receiver for physical stream cipher based on Y-00 protocol using 64-level intensity modulation are demonstrated for increasing transmission capacity. 40-Gb/s Y-00 signals are successfully transmitted over 120-km amplifier repeater transmission line.

articleTitle: OpenFlow/SDN tutorial OFC/NFOEC
abstract: 1) OpenFlow/SDN is evolving to facilitate an ecosystem for innovation 2) OpenFlow is being deployed in over 100 organizations world-wide - GEC9 in Nov, 2010 showcased nation-wide OF - Internet 2 and NLR starting to serve as the GENI Backbone 3 OpenFlow is essential for Service Providers - Custom control for Traffic Engineering - Combined Packet/Circuit switched networks.

articleTitle: Trunk fiber sharing for CO consolidation using dynamic spectrum management
abstract: For integrated metro-access networks, multiple PONs sharing a single trunk fiber is proposed using dynamic spectrum management. Experimental results demonstrate 4 XG-PONs, each with 40km-reach and 64-split, share a single inter-office fiber in metro network.

articleTitle: Nonlinearity impact on crosstalk effects for a 112 Gb/s PDM-QPSK system
abstract: The impact of fiber nonlinearity on the crosstalk-induced OSNR penalties is experimentally analyzed for a hybrid 112-Gb/s PDM-QPSK transmission system. Both experimental and simulation results reveal an enhanced crosstalk effect in the nonlinear transport regime.
